377YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 377YE the Synod appointed new Cardinals of Prosperity, Courage, Loyalty and Pride, vetoed the Senate's assignment of the Brilliant Shore Bourse seat to Wintermark, and tightened the rules for recognising Exemplars. It also recognised Olga of Miekarova as an Exemplar of Vigilance and rewarded four causes from the Virtue Fund.

377YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: Across three Conclave sessions at the 377YE Winter Solstice, Imperial magicians appointed Vaan of Auric Horizon as Warmage and Concordia as Conclave Liaison to the Senate. They added the Cuckoo's Egg ritual to Imperial Lore, interdicted a Vallorn ritual and drake's eggs, declared two sorcerers and approved numerous ritual gambits, many in support of the war effort.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: Ahead of the 377YE Winter Solstice, a set of early, short Winds of Fortune announced the Highborn Day of the Dead and the League's Masquerade of the Reaper. They also heralded an Axou trade delegation, a rare conjunction of the Three Sisters and the return of the Iron Raptors to Anvil.

377YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: At the Winter Solstice of 377YE, Imperial armies pressed the Thule back in Karsk, drove the Druj back in Holberg and freed Skarsind, while new threats gathered on several borders. These included Lasambrian orcs, Druj raiders and Harak the Red's forces in Hercynia.

378YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In Autumn 378YE, Imperial forces in Holfried repelled a massive Druj siege of Holberg, inflicting perhaps ten thousand casualties. Meanwhile the Thule took the Stonefields in Sermersuaq and pressed the Varushkans back in Karsk, and a supernatural tempest wrecked the Grendel-held port of Apulus in Spiral.

378YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: At the Spring Equinox of 378YE, Imperial armies drove the Thule from Karsk, broke the Lasambrian siege of Anozel in Segura and liberated Treji in Hercynia. Meanwhile Holberg was stalemated, Therunin lost ground to the Druj, and Lasambrian raiders moved unopposed through Liathaven.

378YE Summer Solstice Announcements by t.o: At the Summer Solstice 378YE the Quartermaster General, Janusz Dalibor von Temeschwar, announced the resupply of four Imperial armies: the Freeborn Red Wind Corsairs and Fire of the South, and the Marcher Strong Reeds and Drakes.

378YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: At the Summer Solstice of 378YE the Empire reclaimed the Iron Plains of Segura and drove the Druj out of Therunin, but lost the suburbs of Holmauer to the Druj, fought the Thule to a standstill in Karsk and met a new Thule invasion of Sermersuaq.

378YE Winter Solstice Announcements by t.o: At the Winter Solstice of 378YE the Minister for Historical Research commissioned four pieces of historical research through the civil service, into the Gildenheim runeforge, the Claw of the Heavens spire, Emperor Barabbas' invasion plans against the Grendel, and the origins of the Hallowing ceremony.

378YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 378YE winds reported several opportunities for Imperial champions: boggarts in Morrow, celebrations in Segura, anarchist sabotage in Miekarova and rivalry between the orc legions. They also recorded a strange Winter-tinged prosperity in Miaren, a divisive influence spreading among Wintermark's three traditions, and failing mana in Kallavesa.

378YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In Winter 378YE the Empire pushed forward in the east, retaking Karsk from the Thule with a host of magical aid, clearing Holmauer and besieging the Druj in Rebeshof, and gaining a bloody foothold in devastated Reikos. In the west, the Lasambrian orcs largely withdrew from Segura, while the Thule edged forward in the Silver Peaks at great cost to Wintermark.

379YE Autumn Equinox Announcements by th.o: At the Autumn Equinox 379YE, Palladius of Urizen commissioned follow-up historical research into the Skarsind Runeforge, building on a theory put forward by Peter of Hintown, and the Minister for Historical Research approved it.

379YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: The Autumn Equinox 379YE elections filled seats across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse. Several incumbents kept their posts, while Skarsind's Senate seat fell vacant after Relinquish Skarsind was ratified.

379YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 379YE winds of fortune brought news of many events across the Empire, among them setbacks for the vyig in Sarvos, a curse on Urizen's mountains, a supernatural fog over the Bay of Catazar, Jotun raids driven back in the west and orcs crossing into Segura.

379YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In the season after the Summer Solstice, the Thule peace treaty took effect, with the Thule leaving two regions of Karsk and the Empire ceding the Silver Peaks in Sermersuaq. Meanwhile the Grendel besieged Fort Mezudan in Spiral, five Imperial armies suffered heavily besieging the Druj citadel of Urith Barath in Reikos, and the Jotun overran much of Reinos despite Imperial captains aiding the Lasambrian orcs.

379YE Spring Equinox Announcements by th.o: At the Spring Equinox 379YE the Crystal Architect of the Spires announced two mana sinecures for Urizen: the Caves of the Claw in Morrow and the Tower of the Fall in Zenith, each creating a new national title.

379YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the Spring Equinox of 379YE, the Empire filled a range of elected and appointed offices across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse.

379YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 379YE winds of fortune reported a wave of troubles across the Empire's north. A supernatural rift was dividing Wintermark's three traditions, its mana in Kallavesa and Sermersuaq was failing, a cursed winter had struck the Navarr territories, and husk wolves were gathering in Karsk. Opportunities also arose from a Prosperity miracle in Hahnmark and a strange fungus in Miaren.

379YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring Equinox 379YE winds of war, the Empire won a crushing victory in Holberg that returned the territory to the Empire after thirty years. Imperial forces also held Karsk, liberated more of Reikos, and were slowly pushed back by the Thule in Sermersuaq's Silver Peaks.

379YE Summer Solstice Announcements by t.o: At the Summer Solstice 379YE the Crystal Architect of the Spires announced and commissioned the Storm Vault, a mana sinecure to be built in Proceris in Zenith, which would create the national title of Custodian of the Storm Vault.

379YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: The results of the Imperial elections at the 379YE Summer Solstice named new senators for ten territories, ten generals of the Military Council, and holders of Synod, Conclave and Bourse positions and several other Imperial titles.

379YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 379YE Winds of Fortune gathered news of nearly twenty events facing the Empire, from murdered civil servants and foreign delegations arriving at Anvil to curses, hauntings, sickness and threatened Jotun raids.

379YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In Summer 379YE the Empire held the line against the Thule in Sermersuaq, completed the Liberation of Holberg and inched forward in Reikos, but a major Grendel offensive seized the Legacy in Ossuary and threatened all of Spiral.

379YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: The page set out the Imperial titles up for election or appointment at the 379YE Winter Solstice, including ten Senate seats (among them the first Imperial Orc senator for Skarsind), seven Military Council posts, several Synod and Conclave titles, and a number of Bourse seats.

379YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the 379YE Winter Solstice the Senate passed a long slate of motions, including declaring war on the Barrens orcs, abrogating the Asavean trade ban and authorising numerous constructions, while the civil service sought guidance on the Brilliant Shore bourse seat now that Skarsind is Imperial Orc territory.

379YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 379YE Winds of Fortune summarised the season's events across the Empire. These included the Senate assigning Skarsind to the Imperial Orcs, Reikos being liberated, curses on the Marches and Bastion, a crusade against the vyig, and barbarian delegations travelling to Anvil.

379YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In late 379YE the Empire recaptured Reikos from the Druj and drove the Grendel out of Ateri in Spiral, though Grendel sorcery destroyed Fort Mezudan. Imperial armies also began retaking the Mournwold, while the Jotun conquered southern Liathaven and the Barrens orcs besieged the Towers of the Dawn.

380YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 380YE Autumn Equinox, ten Imperial Senators were elected or returned, alongside new holders of Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse positions.

380YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 380YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire. They included celebrations for Empress Lisabetta's coronation, the reclamation of Spiral, the vanishing of the stars over ten territories, the impending fall of the Stalker comet, and the continuing spread of Holberg's marshes.

380YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In Autumn 380YE the Navarr liberated Beacon Point in Liathaven and the Empire recaptured Serra Briante in Kahraman, but the Jotun overran the last Imperial positions in the Mournwold. At sea a Grendel armada twice defeated the Freeborn Storm, and the Druj reappeared in the Barrens having wiped out the Rahvin.

380YE Spring Equinox Announcement by the.o: The Dawnish Civilian Commissioner approved the construction of a small sinecure, the Gardens of Tiberius' Bequest, in Laroc in Astolat, to produce Cerulean Mazzarine and create the title of Healer of Dawn.

Rhesa of the Scions of Ravensfell, Highguard's Civilian Commissioner, commissioned the School of Exorcism in Tabernacle, Reikos, a sinecure producing liao that would create the Highguard title of Master of the School of Exorcism.

The Imperial Orc Civilian Commissioner approved the construction of a series of great drums in Estermark, Skarsind, to assist in raising the Skarsind cattle herds, creating the sinecure known as the Great Eastern Herd.

The Marcher Civilian Commissioner announced approval of a sinecure at Graven in Gravenmarch, Bregasland, to produce mana crystals, but the commission was never authorised because the maximum number of commissions had already been reached.

380YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 380YE Spring Equinox, the Empire filled a wide range of titles across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, with Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg of the League listed as Empress.

380YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 380YE Winds of Fortune gathered news from across the Empire, including the Grendel sack of Sarvos, an enchanted voyage for Navarr and Varushkan captains, a harsh winter giving way to flooding, and Dogri Thulebane's continued hold on Crow's Ridge. It also reported progress on public works and other ongoing events.

380YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the winter before the 380YE Spring Equinox, Imperial armies took Cinion and Ankra in Spiral and Grey Charge in Reikos, held Dawnguard and were fought to a standstill in the Mournwold. Meanwhile the Jotun overran Liathaven and pushed into Kallavesa and Kahraman, and a Grendel naval invasion seized the city of Sarvos.

380YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: The Summer Solstice 380YE elections filled Senate seats, Military Council generalships, Synod and Conclave titles, Senate sinecures and Bourse positions across the Empire, with many incumbents returned.

380YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 380YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news: the coming coronation of Empress Lisabetta Giacomi von Holberg, worsening celestial omens, curses on several territories, upheaval in Reikos, danger in Zenith and famine in the Marches.

380YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: At the Summer Solstice of 380YE the Empire fought on many fronts. It recaptured Dawnguard in the Barrens, saw Sarvos freed after a citizen uprising drove out the Grendel, and continued its slow push in Spiral. Meanwhile the Jotun all but took Serra Briante, threw the Empire back across the Mournwold, and the Black Thorns began retaking Liathaven.

380YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 380YE Winter Solstice, elections were held across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, with many incumbents returned and new holders chosen for a number of senatorial seats, generalships, Synod and Conclave titles and Bourse positions.

380YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 380YE Winds of Fortune set out the season's developments across the Empire, from a looming schism in the Synod and the vanishing of the stars to the fall of the Stalker in Otkodov and a Druj offer to negotiate peace over the Barrens.

380YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In Winter 380YE the eastern and western fronts were largely quiet, but Imperial armies liberated Serra Damata and advanced in the Barrens, while Lasambrian orcs backed by Grendel ships landed in southern Redoubt. In Liathaven a Jotun force from Kahraman fell on the Black Thorns, killing three thousand and trapping them in the west.

381YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 381YE the Imperial Conclave appointed Pavel as Imperial Magus and Marcus Endsmeet as Archmage of Autumn. It also passed a string of declarations on interdictions, endowments, lore and aid to the Great Forest orcs.

381YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: The Autumn Equinox elections of 381YE filled seats across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, including new senators for several territories and new holders of mithril and other Imperial titles.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The 381YE Autumn Equinox Winds of Fortune gathered a season's worth of developments for the Empire, from Synod quarrels over the cruel Iron Helms army and Highguard's stand with the executed Yael to orc pirate raids on the Bay of Catazar, eternal envoys and a new Conclave order.

381YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 381YE Wind of War reported Imperial victories in Spiral, Weirwater and the Mournwold, a costly naval defeat for the Freeborn Storm, and a slow Highborn retreat before the Druj in Zenith. It also covered the Black Thorns' escape from Liathaven and the Druj invasion of Semmerholm that destroyed the Gate.

381YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 381YE Spring Equinox the Empire filled a wide range of Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse titles, while several titles lapsed or were vacated, including the Senator for Spiral after that territory left Imperial hands.

381YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 381YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news across the Empire. It covered a deepening Synod schism over Yael of Highguard, malign storms in Redoubt, the opening of Oran's Temple of Balo and the Black Bull, a crisis with the orcs of the Great Forest in Therunin, newly opened passes to Otkodov, and the bloody aftermath of the Mournwold campaign.

381YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In Spring 381YE the Black Thorns and the Fire of the South came within a whisker of taking West Ranging, the Iron Helms stormed Crow's Keep and captured Dogri Thulebane, and the Grendel retook Spiral. The Jotun won a ruinously costly victory in the cursed Mournwold, the Druj reclaimed most of the Barrens, and the Grendel withdrew from Redoubt.

381YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: The Summer Solstice 381YE Imperial elections filled Senate seats, generalships, Synod titles, Conclave positions and Bourse seats across the Empire. Several incumbents were returned and a number of new title-holders appointed.

381YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: This was the index of Winds of Fortune for the 381YE Summer Solstice. It summarised a season of upheaval: the Yael schism reaching a climax, a great sinkhole in the north-west, Spring regio failing, Grendel threats at sea, and controversy over Varushka's Iron Helms.

381YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In the run-up to the Summer Solstice 381YE, Imperial armies liberated Naris from the Grendel, held Cinion and pushed into Ossuary, and drove the Jotun from Freemoor and the Chalkdowns. Meanwhile a Navarr raid into Hordalant ended in encirclement in Liathaven, the unliving rose across Weirwater, and the Druj broke their treaty to conquer Dawnguard and overrun eastern Zenith.

381YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: The results of the Imperial elections and appointments held at the 381YE Winter Solstice were recorded, covering the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse, along with titles destroyed when the Druj took Zenith and Grendel struck in Madruga.

381YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: The Senate met over the 381YE Winter Solstice with the Imperial treasury at 1433 thrones and 4 crowns, passing a long list of construction, appointment and funding motions while rejecting several others, including a constitutional power of relinquishment.

381YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 381YE Winds of Fortune reported on a season of upheaval across the Empire. Dawn held Semmerholm against the Druj, the League completed the Blood Red Roads and other grand works, the Jotun left the Mournwold, Spring regio returned in flood, and the Liathaven vallorn began to spread.

381YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: At the 381YE Winter Solstice, the Druj flooded Proceris and stood poised to take Zenith, while Dawn and its allies drove them back in Semmerholm. The Marches completed the liberation of Mournwold, the Empire pushed into Screed under the Black Plateau's maddening influence, elite Jotun bands entered Sermersuaq and Segura, and the Grendel armada destroyed the Freeborn Storm and seized Atalaya.

382YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's major events and opportunities across the Empire, from Dawn and Varushka's capture of two regions of Druj-held Ossium to Highguard's ruinous commitment against the vallorn and the Academy's move to Astolat.

382YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In the season after the 382YE Summer Solstice the Druj overran much of eastern Morrow and burned the Halls of Knowledge, the Jotun completed their conquest of Sermersuaq amid a rising of the dead, and Imperial armies drove the Jotun out of Kahraman. A Grendel armada off Sarvos demanded tribute, and Dawn and Varushka invaded the Druj territory of Ossium, seizing a mithril mine.

382YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: The 382YE Spring Equinox elections filled Imperial titles across the Senate, Military Council, Synod, Conclave and Bourse. Several holders resigned, were revoked, or died in the Sunday battle.

382YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: The Senate met at the Spring Equinox 382YE and passed a long slate of motions, including several ambassador appointments, territorial allocations, the raising of a Highborn army and numerous construction commissions. Only two motions failed.

382YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire. They included Zenith's fall to the Druj, a Suranni incursion into Feroz, Zemress exiles settling in Segura, a rare opportunity to strike the vallorn in Liathaven, and seven Synod mandates being upheld.

382YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring of 382YE the Empire liberated Semmerholm and most of Madruga, turned back the vallorn in West Ranging and conquered Spiral, but lost all of Zenith to the Druj while a Jotun host invaded Sermersuaq. The victory in Spiral woke the Black Plateau.

382YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire, from the Navarr fight against the vallorn in Liathaven and Feni raids in Wintermark and the Marches to unrest in the Brass Coast and new opportunities for Highguard and Wintermark.

382YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In the Summer 382YE Winds of War the Drakes drove the last Grendel from Madruga, Imperial armies took most of Spiral including the Grendel fort at Apulian, and a huge Jotun host invaded Sermersuaq, seized Atalaq and ended its status as an Imperial territory. A fresh Jotun invasion struck Kahraman, and the civil service announced the Summer Solstice conjunctions.

382YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 382YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's events and opportunities across the Empire. Ossium's conquest raised the question of which nation should receive it, while crises, proposals and Synod mandates touched almost every nation.

382YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The 382YE Winter Solstice winds of war covered the Imperial armada's sack of the Grendel city of Dubhtraig, the Lasambrian Jotun conquest of Anduzjasse in Segura, the Drakes' destruction of the Feni village in Alderly, the turning back of the Druj in Morrow, the reconquest of most of Sealtoq, and the conquest of four regions of Ossium.

383YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 383YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 140 judgements, ranging from responses to the Grendel ceasefire and the loss of Feroz to the fight against the vallorn and Druj, and the growing influence of Urizen's sword scholars.

383YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: A temporary out-of-character summary was published after the 383YE Summer Solstice, setting out the effects on military units, fleets and other personal resources ahead of the Autumn Equinox downtime. These effects stemmed from mandates, Senate decisions, foreign sanctions and magic.

383YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Winds of Fortune for the 383YE Autumn Equinox gathered the season's news: the disappearance of Imperatrix Lisabetta and the Imperial Magus, the Hag Queen's curses on the League cities, the vallorn being driven back in Brocéliande, Grendel advances in Feroz and the settlement of newly conquered Ossium.

383YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: In the run-up to the 383YE Autumn Equinox, Feroz fell to the Grendel and Spiral ceased to be Imperial, while the Jotun seized two regions of Bregasland and a Druj host invaded Holberg. The Empire also liberated Kahraman, held Segura, raided the Jotun mithril mine at Ikka's Tears and threw back the vallorn's great surge in Brocéliande.

383YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 383YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 126 judgements, agreeing to pause recognitions and doctrinal changes while differences with Sumaah are resolved. It also enacted mandates ranging from removing Almodin Oktístis's idols to sheltering Urizeni refugees, amid bitter debate over the Grey Pilgrims.

383YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 383YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news for the Empire. Headlines included the vallorn's mounting assault on Brocéliande, Ossium's absorption into Varushka, a Druj ultimatum over the children held in Dawnguard, the plight of refugees freed from Dubhtraig and many trade, faith and foreign opportunities.

383YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring of 383YE the Empire raided Beoraidh, burning the Grendel fortification and coliseum and freeing about 2,500 orc slaves, and liberated Caeli and Peregro in Morrow. It also rescued thousands from Zenith and completed the conquest of Ossium alongside the Thule. Elsewhere the Druj seized much of Spiral, the Grendel conquered the Cazar Straits and Oranseri, and the Jotun swept into West Ranging.

383YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the Summer Solstice, a temporary interlude set out the downtime opportunities, trade conditions and large-scale effects following the Spring Equinox 383YE, pending the full Winds of Fortune.

383YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 383YE winds of fortune gathered the Empire's developments after the Spring Equinox. They included the Sand Fishers settling Misericorde, victory over the vallorn in Westwood, a Feni attack on the Singing Caves and mobs stripping the works of Almodin Oktístis.

383YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: Across the Empire, Imperial armies narrowly held Segura and Brocéliande, liberated Tamarbode from the eternal Llofir, cleansed the Westwood of Liathaven, and broke Grendel dominance of the Bay of Catazar. Elsewhere the Grendel took Bramar and nearly all of Feroz, the Jotun invaded Kahraman again, and the Dawnish-Varushkan invasion of the Barrens was repelled, though a covert mission freed the children of Drycastle and many slaves.

383YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 383YE Winter Solstice summit, the Empire filled a wide range of Imperial titles, from twelve national Senate seats to Senate-appointed generals, Synod and Bourse positions and Conclave grandmasterships.

383YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 383YE the Senate ratified a treaty ceding Miechernya and Webwood to the Thule, made the Ossium spoils of war Varushkan national positions and created six Champions of Virtue. It also passed a long slate of commissions, disbursements and investigations, though no Throne was elected.

383YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 383YE summit the Synod raised 127 judgements, chiefly a General Assembly mandate rebuking the Wisdom assembly for urging opposition to Synod mandates, calls for a crusade against the Druj and a contest to claim the Barrens, and the condemnation of the Whittlefolk for following Hatred.

383YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the 383YE Winter Solstice, a summary set out the effects of the Autumn Equinox on military units, trade and national resources. These included Synod mandates, foreign trade conditions and the Imperial Guerdon.

383YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 383YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's news across the Empire. The fallout of the Grendel peace treaty in Spiral and Feroz, a memory-eroding fog, sudden ageing among the young, koboldi building offers, the settlement of Ossium and many national opportunities were all set out ahead of the summit.

383YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: In the season before the 383YE Winter Solstice, Imperial forces turned back the Heirs of Terunael in Hercynia and Therunin but not in Liathaven, and pushed the Lasambrian Jotun back in Segura while ceding Feroz to the Grendel. They also halted the Jotun in Bregasland, advanced into the Druj Forest of Ulnak, failed to gain ground in Zenith, and held off a Jotun attack on Skarsind.

384YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 384YE Autumn Equinox Conclave the mages passed and rejected a long run of declarations, chief among them Dawn's acceptance of Tharim's bargain of 1000 knights and the declaration of two members of House de Gauvain as sorcerers. Several Conclave titles were also filled.

384YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Autumn Equinox summit, elections and appointments filled Senate seats, Imperial titles, Synod and Conclave positions and Bourse seats. They included eleven senators for territories across the Empire.

384YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 384YE the Senate assigned Zenith to Urizen, lifted sanctions on Thule-held Otkodov and granted it free trade, ratified treaties with the Faraden and the Iron Confederacy, and passed a wide range of commissions and disbursements. Bridget Talbot of the Marches was elected Imperial Administrator.

384YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: Ahead of the 384YE Autumn Equinox, the interlude summarised the effects of the Summer Solstice on downtime. These included special raids on Skallahn, Chalonsio and Lorenzo's Deep Pockets, storms across Imperial territories, a lingering drought elsewhere, and several mandates and curses.

384YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 384YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's developments facing the Empire. They covered the archmages' plenipotentiaries, proposals for Holberg, Astolat and Temeschwar, the Druj evil in Zenith, the aftermath of the Great Storm, new opportunities at sea and in the vallorn, and the outcomes of the Summer conjunctions.

384YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 384YE Winds of War summarised the Empire's campaigns. Jotun Lasambrians were driven back in Kahraman, Sermersuaq was finally liberated from the Jotun, Zenith was retaken from the Druj and the Druj withdrew from Ossium, while Bregasland stayed under Jotun-backed rule.

384YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Spring Equinox summit, Imperial titles were filled through elections and appointments across the Senate, Synod, Military Council, Conclave and Bourse. Six senators were also chosen, for Holberg, Karsk, Miekarova, Mournwold, Reikos and Segura.

384YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 384YE the Senate debated a long slate of motions. It raised a new Brass Coast army, outlawed the Hand of Dumon, appointed several ambassadors and an Imperial Spymaster, and commissioned many great works across the Empire.

384YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: The Spring Equinox 384YE interlude set out the effects carried into downtime from the Winter Solstice, covering military bonuses and penalties, a special campaign to secure Ossium, changed trade conditions with foreign nations, and nationwide magical and religious effects.

384YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 384YE winds of fortune set out the season's developments across the Empire: the replies to six archmages' plenipotentiaries, an evacuation opportunity in Grendel-held Feroz, cautious cooperation with the Grendel in Spiral, a planned Marcher raid on Jotun Skallahn, a Highborn offensive in Zenith, Varushkan settlement of Ossium and a threat beneath Lorenzo's Deep Pockets.

384YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the run-up to the 384YE Spring Equinox, the Jotun withdrew from Segura but struck into Kahraman, collapsed part of Pakaanan's Pass in Skarsind, and were pushed back across Sermersuaq. In the east the Druj retook the Forest of Ulnak while Imperial armies made headway in Zenith.

384YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Summer Solstice summit, a wide range of Imperial titles changed hands through national elections, Senate appointments, Synod judgements, Bourse auctions and votes, and other processes, including eight new senators.

384YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 384YE the Senate assigned Sermersuaq and the Pride of Ikka's Tears to Wintermark, legalised Imperial participation in a Liberty Pact raid on an Asavean trade centre, declared neutrality between Jarm and the Commonwealth, and passed a long slate of new titles and commissions.

384YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Following the Spring Equinox 384YE, a round-up of effects and opportunities shaping the coming season was set out. These included the Imperial Guerdon allocation, special military and fleet missions in Feroz, Skallahn, Karsk, Liathaven and the Twisted Woods, and various national and Synod-driven effects.

384YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 384YE Winds of Fortune gathered the season's major developments across the Empire, including the covert evacuation of Feroz, a drought and Spring conjunction, a flood at Syrene's Wisdom, Dawn's advance in the Barrens and an opportunity for a Grendel raid on Tsark.

384YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: In the summer of 384YE the Jotun took Gambit and Jade Range in Kahraman and seized Bregasland, while an alliance of the Empire and Otkodov liberated Sermersuaq. In the east the Druj retook Echofell in Ossium, the Empire carved a causeway through the Barrens, and fighting in Zenith ground to a standstill.

384YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 384YE Winter Solstice summit the Conclave passed a string of declarations, among them requests for the Shuttered Lantern to investigate Agramant's influence in Sermersuaq, protection for interdicted Urizen lore texts, acceptance of Tharim's warding of the Hall of Worlds, and an endowment of 150 mana to Sadogua. Andronikos of the Lighthouse of Nikephoros was appointed Imperial Warmage.

384YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 384YE Winter Solstice summit, Imperial titles across the Empire changed hands through national elections, Senate and Cardinal appointments, Synod judgements, Conclave votes and Bourse auctions and votes.

384YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 384YE the Senate passed a wide slate of motions, including raising a fourth Wintermark army, clearing Druj miasma from Zenith and commissioning many new constructions. It also elected several ambassadors, though no one was elected to the Imperial Throne.

384YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 384YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 168 judgements. It rejected a proposal to accept Freedom/Anarchy as a virtue, narrowly refused a mandate to exterminate the Druj, and enacted mandates on the Free Folk, the Vyig, the Great Forest Orcs and Blood-on-the-Snow.

384YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: The interlude following the Autumn Equinox 384YE set out the effects shaping the coming season, from the Imperial Guerdon and special expeditions to curses, enchantments, mandates and trade arrangements across the Empire.

384YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 384YE winds of fortune set out the Empire's situations and opportunities, including restoring a liberated Zenith, freeing Sermersuaq from the Jotun, and the Imperial strategy in the Barrens. The page also reported the outcomes of the Autumn conjunctions of the Sentinel Gate.

384YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: This was the Winter Solstice 384YE summary of the Empire's campaigns. The Jotun were pushed back in the west, the Druj were driven from Zenith but held the line in the Barrens, and Imperial heroes razed the slaver city of Rachensgrab and delved into the vallorn of Brocéliande.

385YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the Autumn Equinox summit of 385YE, the Empire filled a wide range of titles through national senatorial elections, Senate and Military Council appointments, Synod judgements, Conclave votes and Bourse auctions and votes.

385YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 385YE the Senate passed a heavy programme of motions, declaring war on the Grendel, electing Vesna Borkovna Prochnost as the Throne pending ratification, and commissioning many new ministries, sinecures and great works across the Empire.

385YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 385YE the Synod raised 202 judgements, most significantly replacing the Doctrine of Human Destiny with a new Doctrine of Enlightenment that holds Virtue exalts orcs and humans alike. It also passed major mandates on Spiral, the sword scholars of Urizen, the Barrens and the Mournwold Orcs.

385YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: Between the 385YE Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox, a round-up set out the season's special downtime options and large-scale effects. These included adventures against Cold Sun, caravan guarding in Kahraman, training the Dreamers sept and thwarting the Asavean blockade, alongside enchantments, curses and mandates affecting production across the Empire.

385YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 385YE winds of fortune summarised the season's developments across the Empire, from the final Dawnish conquest of the Barrens and rebellion in Spiral to Jotun overtures of honour, Day-realm heralds and new mineral wealth in Kahraman. They also recorded the outcomes of the Summer Solstice Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

385YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 385YE Winds of War summarised the Imperial military situation, setting out three possible battle opportunities through the Sentinel Gate against the Druj and the Jotun, twenty smaller conjunctions across the Empire, and the special military considerations then in force.

385YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 385YE Spring Equinox summit, elections and appointments filled a wide range of Imperial titles, including eight territorial senators, generals, ambassadors, Synod and Conclave positions, and Bourse seats.

385YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 385YE the Senate assigned Bregasland to the Marches and the Barrens to Dawn, declared war on Asavea, and passed a raft of commissions across the Empire. It also made several appointments, though nobody was elected to the Throne.

385YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: Ahead of the Spring Equinox 385YE, an interlude summarised the effects shaping the coming season. These included mandates against the Vyig, monster-hunting work in Varushka, the Black Frost in Dawn, Great Forest Orc settlement among the Navarr, Spring magic across the Empire and changes to congregation income.

385YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 385YE winds of fortune summarised a season shaped by the Hallow of the Green World, Grendel treaty talks, new Varushkan roads and ports, the restoration of Zenith, and many Sentinel Gate missions against the Druj and Jotun.

385YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: This was the Spring Equinox 385YE summary of the Empire's wars. It covered the Jotun invasion of Kahraman, the liberation of Bregasland and the costly victory over the Druj in the Barrens, along with smaller conflicts, the battle opportunities and the Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

385YE Summer Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Imperial Conclave filled several titles, endorsed two throne candidates, changed its stance towards several eternals and dispatched orders to investigate Grendel spies in Sarvos and Druj disease experiments in the Barrens.

385YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 385YE Summer Solstice summit, the Empire filled a broad slate of Imperial titles. Nine senators were returned by national election, alongside Senate appointments, Synod judgements, Bourse auctions and votes, and several other posts.

385YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Senate passed a large slate of motions, commissions and appointments, from funding a Dawnish army and lifting sanctions on the Iron Confederacy to new sinecures, follies and spy networks across the Empire.

385YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Imperial Synod raised 217 judgements. It rejected a bid to strike out the Doctrine of Human Destiny and passed a wide range of statements, mandates and sanctions on Spiral, the Apulian Orcs, the Barrens, the sacred city at Bastion, the heralds of Cold Sun and more.

385YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Following the Spring Equinox 385YE, the Summer Solstice interlude set out the effects shaping that season's downtime, including military adventures, the Imperial Guerdon, curses and boons on various nations and territories, and a cardinals' contest to transform Bastion.

385YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 385YE winds of fortune gathered the season's major developments across the Empire. Dawn's conquest of the Barrens, the Jotun withdrawal from Bregasland, the breaking of the vyig, the League's acquisition of Spiral and the restoration of Zenith all sat alongside many new opportunities for Imperial citizens.

385YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 385YE summary of the Empire's campaigns recorded Imperial armies consolidating in the Barrens, advancing into Kahraman amid widespread Jotun raids, and launching the first invasion of the Jotun jarldoms in Skallahn. It also set out the season's battle opportunities, conjunctions and military considerations.

385YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the Winter Solstice summit of 385YE the Empire filled a wide range of Imperial titles, most notably the Senate's appointment of Vesna Borkovna Prochnost to the Throne, alongside eleven senatorial elections and many Synod, Bourse, military and Conclave posts.

385YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the 385YE Winter Solstice the Senate passed a broad slate of motions, appraisals, commissions and appointments, while Imperial title-holders announced further constructions. Highlights included recognising Thule dominion over several territories, creating the title of Arcane Inquisitor and funding Wintermark and Dawnish armies.

385YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 385YE the Imperial Synod raised 227 judgements, dominated by the crises of the Cold Sun scions, the blight in Madruga, the war with the Grendel on the Bay of Catazar, the aftermath of Imperial actions in the Barrens and the new Doctrine of Enlightenment.

385YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the 385YE Winter Solstice, a summary set out the effects of the Autumn Equinox on Imperial military units, fleets and personal resources. These included special adventures, Grendel raids on shipping, curses and rituals on several territories, and shifts in the fortunes of congregations and businesses.

385YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 385YE winds of fortune set out the situations facing the Empire as Empress Vesna Borkovna Prochnost prepared for her coronation. They range from the Madruga blight and Grendel raids in the Bay of Catazar to Cold Sun's attacks, the Barrens bloodletting and a newly found way to destroy the vallorn.

385YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The Winter Solstice 385YE campaign summary recorded the scions of Cold Sun ravaging the heart of the Empire, manoeuvring against the Jotun in the west, Imperial armies in the Barrens and marching into the Broken Shore, and a Grendel armada taking Madruga, where Siroc was burned and the territory lost to the Empire.

386YE Autumn Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial Conclave, drawing on a font of 239 mana, passed declarations on eternal relations, order expeditions, appointments, interdictions and ritual disseminations, including a trade of ritual texts with the Black Sand Circle in Mareave.

386YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox summit, Imperial elections and appointments filled a wide range of titles, including ten senatorial seats, army generalships, Synod positions, Military Council posts and Bourse seats.

386YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the 386YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial generals issued their orders, sending a dozen armies against the Jotun in the Mournwold, three to defend Redoubt and four against the Druj in Therunin. The Gryphon's Pride was ordered to attack the Rahvin of the Barrens despite the Senate's protection of those orcs.

386YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 386YE the Senate passed a large slate of motions, including the assignment of Feroz to the Brass Coast, a ban on hunting turtles in the Bay of Catazar and the creation of the Watcher of the Semmerlak. A long list of new constructions, funding disbursals, appointments and research projects was also passed or announced.

386YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 386YE the Imperial Synod raised 216 judgements, most notably vetoing the Senate's ban on preaching the Way in Asavea by greater majority and stripping Vardas of his recognition as a paragon of Vigilance.

386YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.o: The Civil Service published the timetable for the Autumn Equinox 386YE summit. It listed national senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections for national titles, and the Friday-to-Sunday schedule of Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse, Synod, Academy and militia sessions.

386YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: Between the Summer Solstice and Autumn Equinox 386YE, a summary set out the season's special opportunities and Empire-wide effects. These included hunts for followers of Agramant, fleet adventures, and a series of mandates and curses affecting resources, congregations and fleets.

386YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Autumn Equinox 386YE winds of fortune gathered the season's developments across the Empire. They covered Navarr's decision to begin the final battle against the vallorn, the crisis of faith over Vardas, the rising of the Scorrero in the Brass Coast, and diplomacy with foreign powers, along with trade conditions and the outcomes of the Summer Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

386YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 386YE Winds of War summarised a turbulent season of campaigning across the Empire, from an Asavean raid on Meade and war over Madruga and Feroz to the Jotun in Mournwold, the Druj in Therunin and the Imperial invasion of Ayereed. It also set out the season's battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

386YE Spring Equinox Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox the Conclave, drawing on a font of 190 mana, appointed several titles, approved expeditions and investigations, accepted offers from eternals, licensed an interdicted Urizen ritual and endorsed Foam and Spittle of the Furious Sea against the Grendel navies.

386YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox summit, a wide range of Imperial titles changed hands through national elections, Senate and Cardinal appointments, Synod judgements, Military Council appointments, Conclave votes, Bourse auctions and votes, and a Civil Service appointment.

386YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the 386YE Spring Equinox the Senate assigned Mareave to the Imperial Orcs, ratified peace treaties recognising Beoraidh and the Urizen of the Silver Flame as foreigners, and created the Throne power Face of the Empire. It also approved a wide slate of titles, constructions and ambassadorial appointments.

386YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 386YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 210 judgements, spanning statements on the Cold Sun, the vallorn, Spiral, Mareave and missionary work in Asavea, as well as enacted mandates, inquisitions, sanctions and appointments.

386YE Spring Equinox event schedule.o: The Spring Equinox 386YE schedule set out the summit's new player meetings, senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the timetable of official and citizen-organised meetings across the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse, Synod and Academy.

386YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: In the interlude after the Winter Solstice 385YE, a range of effects took hold across the Empire ahead of the Spring Equinox 386YE. They included national mandates opening new military adventures, curses and rituals cutting production, and bonuses to congregations, sinecures and farms.

386YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 386YE winds of fortune gathered the season's news across the Empire. Empress Vesna's inaugural address called for unity, and the round-up also covered curse-driven storms, rebellion in Spiral, the conquest of Clisearn, an undying horror rampaging in the north-east, and the outcomes of the Winter Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

386YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: At the Spring Equinox of 386YE the Empire's war continued on several fronts: against the Cold Sun's scions, the Lasambrian Jotun invading Kahraman, and the Grendel in Mareave and Madruga, while Imperial armies withdrew from Skallahn. Four major battle opportunities and dozens of Sentinel Gate conjunctions were identified for Imperial heroes.

386YE Summer Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 386YE Summer Solstice the Imperial Conclave appointed several titles, sent ritual texts to the Sumaah Republic, endorsed a Freeborn ritual to wash the blight from Madruga, and committed orders to expeditions in Mareave and Asavea. It worked from a font of 246 mana.

386YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Summer Solstice summit, Imperial elections filled senatorial seats for eleven territories along with a wide range of Senate, Synod, Military Council, Conclave and Bourse titles.

386YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 386YE the Senate passed treaties with Skoura and the Iron Confederacy, renounced the Empire's claim to several lands now held by Otkodov, and approved or announced a long list of commissions. It also elected several Imperial titles, including Jarrigk Orzel as Imperial Consul and Bernard Dugdale as Imperial Spymaster.

386YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 386YE summit the Imperial Synod raised 216 judgements. Navarr was committed to war against the vallorn, missionaries were sent to Asavea, and Bohemond de Rondell was revoked as Senator for Astolat.

386YE Summer Solstice event schedule.o: The Civil Service published the timetable for the Summer Solstice 386YE summit at Anvil. It set out senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections for national titles, and the sessions of the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Synod, Bourse, Academy and Militia across the weekend.

386YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Ahead of the Summer Solstice 386YE, a set of opportunities and ongoing effects shaped the Empire's coming season. These included new tasks for military units and fleets, rat-plagued Temeschwar, storms over Madruga, Dho'uala's grip on the Semmerlak and shifts in congregation fortunes.

386YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 386YE winds of fortune gathered the season's briefings on foreign diplomacy, eternals, appraisals, national opportunities and threats. They also recorded the outcomes of the Spring Equinox Sentinel Gate conjunctions and the current state of foreign trade.

386YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 386YE Winds of War summarised a stormy season of fighting across the Empire, against the Cold Sun's scions, the Jotun, the Grendel and the Druj, and listed the battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

386YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 386YE Winter Solstice summit, Imperial elections and appointments filled a wide range of titles. These included senators for thirteen territories, Senate-appointed ambassadors and generals, Synod and Bourse positions, and several Military Council and Conclave offices.

386YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.o: After the 386YE Winter Solstice, Imperial generals launched two offensives, sending five armies into Jotun-held Reinos and four into the Druj-held Sarangrave. Most other armies regrouped in Astolat, Upwold, Reikos, Tassato and Bregasland.

386YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 386YE the Senate assigned Mournwold to the Marches, ceded Bitter Strand to the Rahvin, raised third League and Varushkan armies, and levied tolls on the Blood Red and White Roads. It also created the Imperial Apothecaries' Guild and the Stipulator of Stipends, and set the Imperial Guerdon at 150 thrones.

386YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 386YE the Imperial Synod raised 212 judgements, dominated by the Druj conquest of Therunin, the fallout from General Archavion Wolfborne's attack on the Rahvin at the Fangs, and the crisis over cardinals carrying a hallow of the false virtue of Peace.

386YE Winter Solstice event schedule.o: The civil service published the timetable for the Winter Solstice 386YE summit at Anvil. It set out national senator elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the weekend's official and citizen-organised meetings.

386YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: The Winter Solstice interlude opened downtime after the 386YE Autumn Equinox. It set out the Gryphon's Pride's illegal attack on the Rahvin in the Barrens, new adventures for military units and fleets, changes to foreign trade, and a range of magical and religious effects across the Empire.

386YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 386YE winds of fortune gathered dozens of developments across the Empire, from Emperor Vesna's message on the Barrens and the coming war with the vallorn to foreign diplomacy and the results of the Autumn Equinox Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

386YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The Winter Solstice 386YE winds of war summarised a stormy season of campaigning: battles against the Jotun in the Mournwold, the Grendel and Children of Wrecks in Redoubt, the Druj in Therunin, and Imperial fighting Imperial over the Fangs. The page also set out the battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

387YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: The Autumn Equinox summit of 387YE saw a wide round of Imperial elections and appointments, filling Senate seats, generalships, Synod titles, Military Council posts, Conclave offices and Bourse seats.

387YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the 387YE Autumn Equinox the Imperial generals issued their orders. Major offensives were launched against the Jotun in Bregasland and Skallahn, against the Grendel in Mareave and Redoubt, and against the Druj at the Tower of the Skink in newly Imperial Sarangrave.

387YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the 387YE Autumn Equinox the Senate passed a wide range of motions: it assigned the Sarangrave to Urizen, ratified a treaty with Axos, criminalised the Disciples of Sulemaine and set the Guerdon at 500 thrones. Eight commissions were also passed and several titles appointed.

387YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 387YE the Imperial Synod raised two hundred and nine judgements, covering statements of principle, mandates, inquisitions, sanctions, appointments and rewardings. Major themes were the war against the Druj and the vallorn, false virtues, Grendel espionage and the rift within Highguard.

387YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.o: This was the published schedule for the Autumn Equinox summit of 387YE, setting out the times of senatorial elections, national title elections by Tally of the Votes, and the meetings of the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse, Synod and Academy across the weekend.

387YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: This interlude after the 387YE Summer Solstice set out the downtime opportunities and seasonal effects across the Empire. It covered the Imperial Guerdon, new military unit and fleet options, a special Wisdom lecture, and a range of enchantments and economic changes.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: For the 387YE Autumn Equinox, twenty-three winds of fortune were released, alongside reports on the Free Folk, the Silent Bell's costly spying on the Druj, the Southern Herd, Big Icebarn's hunt and the outcomes of the Summer Solstice conjunctions across the Empire.

387YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 387YE Winds of War summarised a season in which the Marches retook all of the Mournwold, the Jotun destroyed Schogsfestnir and reclaimed Liathaven, and the Grendel returned to seize Elos in Redoubt. It also set out the battle opportunities and Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

387YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 387YE Spring Equinox summit, a wide range of Imperial titles were filled by election and appointment, including senators for eight territories, Senate-appointed generals and ambassadors, Synod positions, Bourse seats and Military Council posts.

387YE Spring Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Imperial generals sent nine armies against the Druj in Sarangrave and seven against the Jotun in Liathaven. Two more armies pushed into Madruga, while others defended, dug in or rested elsewhere.

387YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Senate passed a large slate of motions, raising new Navarr, Urizen and Highborn armies, ratifying treaties with the Rahvin and the Thule of Otkodov, establishing the Magpies and Vallornguard sodalities, and commissioning numerous sinecures, edifices and appraisals.

387YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 191 judgements. Dominant themes were the false virtues, the wars against the Druj and the vallorn, preaching in Faraden and Asavea, and the hallowing of the seven coronation bells.

387YE Spring Equinox event schedule.o: The schedule for the Spring Equinox 387YE summit listed the times for senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections for national titles, and the timetable of meetings, sessions, battles and deadlines across the weekend at Anvil.

387YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: The Spring Equinox 387YE interlude set out the opportunities and effects in play after the Winter Solstice 386YE. These included Guerdon shares, new ventures and lectures, toll roads, and many enchantments and curses across the Empire.

387YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 387YE winds of fortune gathered the season's news for the Empire's champions. They covered diplomacy with foreign powers, appraisals, magical developments, opportunities and threats, and the outcomes of the Winter Solstice conjunctions.

387YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: In the Spring Equinox of 387YE, Imperial armies withdrew from Therunin and lost the Ayereed beachhead and most of Bregasland, but advanced into Reinos, freed the Ore Hills and won ground-level victories in the Sarangrave. The page also listed three battle opportunities and many Sentinel Gate conjunctions for the coming summit.

387YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 387YE Summer Solstice summit, a large round of Imperial elections and appointments filled senatorial seats, Senate-appointed posts, Synod titles, Military Council positions, Bourse seats and various other offices across the Empire.

387YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.o: At the Summer Solstice 387YE the Imperial generals issued orders to thirty armies, concentrating twelve of them against the Druj in Sarangrave. Others pressed the Jotun in Mournwold, fought the Druj in Zenith and the vallorn in Therunin, or rested and guarded the Empire's interior.

387YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 387YE the Senate assigned Madruga to the Brass Coast, outlawed the Cult of the Falconer and cannibalism, accepted the Empire's responsibility for its conduct in the Barrens, made several appointments and approved or announced numerous constructions.

387YE Summer Solstice Sodality resolutio.o: At the 387YE Summer Solstice, the Imperial sodalities recorded their appointments and bequests, and the Sun Chamber chose its Door of the Chamber, The Hidden Possibilities.

387YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 255 judgements. A veto of the Thule treaty failed heavily, priests declared the destruction of the Druj the Synod's greatest ambition, and the cult of the Falconer was condemned across the north.

387YE Summer Solstice event schedule.o: The Civil Service published the timetable for the Summer Solstice 387YE summit at Anvil. It set out when each nation would elect its senators, when national titles would be decided by Tally of the Votes, and when the summit's official and citizen-organised meetings would be held.

387YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: The Summer Solstice 387YE interlude set out the opportunities open to fleets, military units and congregations after the Spring Equinox, and catalogued the enchantments and other large-scale effects at work across the Empire that season.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 387YE winds of fortune gathered thirty briefings on matters facing the Empire, from new armies, sodalities and appraisals to diplomacy and magic. They also reported further developments and the known outcomes of the Spring Equinox conjunctions.

387YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 387YE Winds of War summarised Imperial military activity, linking to campaign reports for Liathaven, Mournwold and Bregasland, Therunin, the Bay of Catazar, and Sarangrave and Zenith. It also set out four battle opportunities, dozens of Sentinel Gate conjunctions and the standing military considerations affecting the nations.

387YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice the Conclave, drawing on a font of 364 mana, elected new title-holders and sent several orders to oppose the Cold Sun in the Commonwealth and the Principalities of Jarm. It also condemned sharing Imperial lore with the Silver Flame and declined commitments regarding the Druj and the Sarangrave.

387YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice summit, Imperial elections and appointments were held across the Empire's institutions. Eleven territorial senators were chosen, alongside generals, ambassadors, Synod titles, Bourse seats and other offices.

387YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.o: At the 387YE Winter Solstice the Imperial generals issued orders for thirty armies, concentrating forces against the Druj in Sarangrave, the Jotun in Bregasland and the Grendel in Redoubt and Mareave, while also defending Mitwold.

387YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Winter Solstice 387YE the Imperial Senate passed a broad slate of motions, including the expulsion of the Grendel embassy from Redoubt, the relinquishing of the Tassatan Hills mine, numerous self-funded commissions, and several appointments of ambassadors and generals.

387YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Winter Solstice 387YE the Imperial Synod raised 160 judgements, among them a wave of proscriptions against false virtues and idolatry, several assemblies' highest callings, and national calls touching the Barrens, Spiral, Livardz, the Jotun border and the Grand Inspiration of the Way.

387YE Winter Solstice event schedule.o: The Winter Solstice 387YE schedule set out when and where the summit's senatorial elections, Tally of the Votes elections, and official and citizen-organised meetings would take place at Anvil.

387YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: After the 387YE Autumn Equinox, a seasonal summary set out the new downtime opportunities and the large-scale magical and political effects shaping the Empire ahead of the Winter Solstice. These included raids on the Disciples of Sulemaine, new fleet voyages, pilgrimage lectures, and many regional enchantments.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Winter Solstice 387YE winds of fortune set out thirty-eight briefings on events across the Empire. They covered Emperor Vesna's call to turn on the Jotun, the new Anvil arena, a failing Imperial regio, diplomacy with foreign powers and orc nations, national highest callings, Sarangrave's assignment to Urizen and the outcomes of the Autumn Equinox Sentinel Gate conjunctions.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of war.o: The Winter Solstice 387YE Winds of War summarised Imperial military activity, pointed to seven conflicts with their own Winds, and set out four battle opportunities and dozens of conjunctions through the Sentinel Gate for the coming summit.

388YE Autumn Asavean ambassador briefing.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE Ambassador Herminius received a reply from Lady Madrianna of the Blue Stones in which the Asavean Plenum reaffirmed its support for the Grendel, hinted at a far larger military involvement in the Bay of Catazar, and set out peace demands the civil service judged tantamount to unconditional surrender.

388YE Autumn Axos ambassador briefing.o: Prepared for Ambassador Thanmir Hrafnar at the Autumn Equinox 388YE, this briefing set out Axou positions on the defence of Sarangrave, the remodelling of the Tower of the Skink, a possible role in conquering Sanath, fortification work, the vallorn and several diplomatic grievances. Asthore Autumngale succeeded Thanmir as ambassador during the summit.

388YE Autumn Beoraidh ambassador briefin.o: The civil service prepared an Autumn Equinox 388YE briefing for Melkior of Balthazar's Vineyard, Ambassador to Beoraidh. It covered the city-state's replies on Sarcophan diplomats, the planned basilica, espionage, a requested assurance on curses, and an offer of magical plants from Sinfoyard.

388YE Autumn Commonwealth ambassador bri.o: An ambassadorial briefing for Cyrus of Ebon's Hall at the Autumn Equinox 388YE set out the Commonwealth's furious response to the Empire's revelation of the source of Cold Sun in Lantir. It also covered a threatened leak about Imperial mana, the Liberty Pact, the ceasefire with Jarm, the Lyceum and Highborn ties.

388YE Autumn Equinox Imperial elections.o: At the 388YE Autumn Equinox summit, the Empire filled a wide range of Imperial titles, including eight territorial Senate seats, Senate-appointed generals and ambassadors, Synod and Military Council positions, and Bourse seats and offices.

388YE Autumn Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Imperial generals sent nine armies to assault the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath and seven to attack the Jotun in Reinos. They also massed seven armies to defend Mareave against an expected Grendel invasion and kept six holding Bregasland.

388YE Autumn Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Senate assigned Bregasland to the Marches, ratified treaties with the Karass, the Iron Confederacy and the Nesustak Forest rebels, and passed a long run of commissions, amendments and appointments, while Imperial title-holders made many announcements.

388YE Autumn Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Imperial Synod raised 169 judgements, most notably replacing the Doctrine of the Howling Abyss with the Doctrine of the Final Challenge by a greater majority of the General Assembly.

388YE Autumn Equinox event schedule.o: This was the published schedule for the 388YE Autumn Equinox summit, setting out the Saturday senatorial elections, the Tally of the Votes for national titles, the definition of dusk and the timetable of meetings across Anvil.

388YE Autumn Equinox interlude.o: The Autumn Equinox 388YE interlude opened downtime after the Summer Solstice. It set out the season's Imperial Guerdon, new ventures for military units, fleets and congregations, and the enchantments and other effects now at work across the Empire.

388YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune.o: The 388YE Autumn Equinox winds of fortune gathered the season's briefings for the Empire, from national highest callings, eternal offers and diplomatic updates to the results of the Summer Solstice conjunctions.

388YE Autumn Equinox winds of war.o: The Autumn Equinox 388YE summary of military activity pointed to Winds of War in Bregasland, Mareave, Therunin, Sarangrave, the Salt Flats of Sanath and the Mallum. It also listed four battle opportunities, dozens of Sentinel Gate conjunctions and a wave of desperate Druj tunnel raids.

388YE Autumn Faraden ambassador briefing.o: The civil service prepared this Autumn 388YE briefing for Mina i Yashum i Riqueza, Ambassador to Faraden. It warned that the Synod's proscription against Justice had damaged Faraden confidence in the Empire, and it reported the new Faraden–Jotun peace treaty and the Asavean withdrawal from Faraden.

388YE Autumn Grendel ambassador briefing.o: A civil service briefing for the Imperial Ambassador to the Grendel, presented at the Autumn Equinox 388YE, reported that the Salt Lords rejected calls to cede Mareave and Ayereed, floated reciprocal pilgrimages and proposed both powers build embassies in neutral Beoraidh.

388YE Autumn Iron Confederacy ambassador.o: This civil service briefing was prepared for Tethros i Zuhri i Erigo, Ambassador to the Iron Confederacy, at the Autumn Equinox 388YE. It covered a Suranni treaty delegation, an offer for Imperial warbands to fight in Reinos, the Hand of Dumon in Kalino, and a Suranni inquiry about Brother Luke.

388YE Autumn Jarmish ambassador briefing.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE the Ambassador to Jarm, Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll, was briefed on Jarmish reactions to the Empire exposing Commonwealth agents behind the Cold Sun incursion at Lantir. The briefing also covered an invitation for Imperial mercenaries, trade with Zemelslo, and the work of the Celestial Arch and Sevenfold Path in Jarm.

388YE Autumn Sarcophan ambassador briefi.o: A civil service briefing was presented to Dino i Riqueza, Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves, at the Autumn Equinox 388YE, covering trade partners, Sarcophan investors in Hahnmark, the collapse of the Cathedral of the Navigators' reputation, and the Ilium Jackals' mercenary contract.

388YE Autumn Sumaah ambassador briefing.o: At the Autumn Equinox 388YE, Ambassador Accalon of Felix's Watch received a briefing on relations with the Sumaah Republic, covering retaliatory tariffs, a proposed purchase of weirwood and mithril, a Sumaah offer to review Imperial eternal rituals, Sumaah anxiety over the Liberty Pact after the Commonwealth's withdrawal, and questions about Zemress of the Isles.

388YE Autumn Thule ambassador briefing.o: An ambassadorial briefing presented at the Autumn Equinox 388YE to Kindra Surefoot, Ambassador to Otkodov, reported that the Thule had agreed a six-month peace treaty with the Druj in Ulnak and that the Dragons would deal personally with the Circle of Zulgan Tash. It also offered guidance on coordinating magic in territories shared with the Thule.

388YE Spring Equinox Imperial elections.o: The results of the Imperial elections held at the 388YE Spring Equinox summit were recorded, covering new senators for eight territories alongside a wide range of Senate, Synod, Military Council, Conclave, Bourse and other appointments.

388YE Spring Equinox Military Council or.o: At the Spring Equinox 388YE the Imperial generals issued orders to thirty armies, concentrating forces in Mitwold to retake Meade, in Sarangrave against the Druj and the waking Vallorn, and in Mareave against the Grendel.

388YE Spring Equinox Senate sessions.o: At the Spring Equinox 388YE the Imperial Senate passed a wide slate of motions. These included new and amended titles, a treaty with the Protectorate of Morajasse, a statement on the Nesustak Forest rebels, many commissions and several ambassadorial appointments.

388YE Spring Equinox Synod judgements.o: At the Spring Equinox 388YE the Imperial Synod raised 179 judgements, most notably amending the Doctrine of Seven, adding several new proscriptions of heresy and idolatry, and declaring a wave of assembly 'highest callings'.

388YE Spring Equinox event schedule.o: This was the published schedule for the Spring Equinox 388YE summit, setting out the times of senator elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the meetings held across the Senate, Military Council, Conclave, Synod and other venues.

388YE Spring Equinox interlude.o: The interlude opened the season's downtime after the Winter Solstice, setting out where the Imperial Guerdon would be paid, special opportunities for military units, fleets and congregations, and the enchantments and mandates shaping the Empire that season.

388YE Spring Equinox winds of fortune.o: The Spring Equinox 388YE winds of fortune set out the season's opportunities and problems across the Empire, from a manticore's claim to the Dawnish throne and Emperor Vesna's call for a final push against the Druj to diplomatic updates and the results of the Winter Solstice conjunctions.

388YE Spring Equinox winds of war.o: The Spring Equinox 388YE Winds of War summarised the Empire's campaigns in the Bay of Catazar, Mareave, Mitwold, Bregasland, Therunin and Sarangrave. It also set out five battle opportunities, of which the generals would choose two, along with a long list of Sentinel Gate conjunctions across the Empire.

388YE Summer Solstice Imperial elections.o: At the 388YE Summer Solstice summit a wide range of Imperial titles were filled. Senators were chosen for ten territories, and posts were settled through Senate and Throne appointments, Synod judgements, Conclave votes, Bourse auctions and votes, and sodality votes.

388YE Summer Solstice Military Council o.o: At the Summer Solstice 388YE the Imperial generals sent twelve armies against the Jotun in Bregasland and six against the Druj in the Salt Flats of Sanath. Other armies resisted the Grendel in Mareave, assaulted Madruga and Therunin, and held Zenith.

388YE Summer Solstice Senate sessions.o: At the Summer Solstice 388YE the Senate raised new Navarr, Varushkan and Marcher armies, created the religious crime of Moral Injury and redefined idolatry. It also commissioned a range of buildings, docks and great works across the Empire and made several key appointments.

388YE Summer Solstice Synod judgements.o: At the Summer Solstice 388YE the Synod considered over 170 judgements, rejecting the attempt to strike the Doctrine of the Howling Abyss and upholding mandates, proscriptions, inquisitions, appointments and rewards across the Empire. The Navarr and Imperial Orc assemblies named the leaders of the raid to rescue the Great Forest Orcs from the Druj.

388YE Summer Solstice event schedule.o: The schedule set out the senator elections, Tally of the Votes elections and the timetable of meetings and sessions for the Summer Solstice summit of 388YE.

388YE Summer Solstice interlude.o: Downtime after the 388YE Spring Equinox opened, setting out the Imperial Guerdon allocations, new opportunities for military units, fleets and congregations, and the enchantments, curses and other effects at work across the Empire that season.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of fortune.o: The Summer Solstice 388YE winds of fortune set out forty situations facing the Empire, from national and assembly highest callings to foreign diplomacy. The page also reported a highly successful Freeborn raid on Leen that freed thousands of Druj slaves, along with the outcomes of the Spring Equinox conjunctions.

388YE Summer Solstice winds of war.o: The Summer Solstice 388YE Winds of War summarised Imperial military activity, pointing to fuller Winds for Madruga, Mareave, Sarangrave and the Forest of Ulnak. It also set out three possible Sentinel Gate battles, many smaller conjunctions across the Empire and the special rules affecting Imperial armies.

388YE Winter Solstice interlude.o: The interlude after the Autumn Equinox 388YE set out the downtime opportunities and effects for the coming season. These included new ventures for military units, fleets and congregations, the completion of the Calvos docks, the closure of Jakhalsmarkt, and a range of enchantments and curses across the Empire.

A Blight in Miaren.o: In Spring 379YE a blight of Armillaria, a Spring-touched parasitic fungus that attacks marrowort but benefits livestock, broke out across the herb gardens of Miaren. The Conclave, rallied by Mari, Archmage of Day, gathered ambergelt to destroy the fungus.

A Crown in Winter.o: The Senate elected Varushkan senator Vesna Borkovna Prochnost as the twenty-first Empress in Autumn 385YE, and an Assembly of Nine veto was unanimously voted down. Her coronation was set for the Winter Solstice summit, with a tour of the nations, national presentations and gifts from foreign dignitaries.

A Miracle in Hahnmark.o: In spring 379YE, weltsilver mines in Hahnmark spontaneously generated auras of Prosperity that made mining feel deeply rewarding, boosting mine output and congregations while drawing labour away from other businesses. The Synod responded by spreading the miracle to Skarsind and extending its benefit to all mines.

A Sparrow in Spring.o: After the Senate chose Senator Vesna Borkovna Prochnost as the new Empress, citizens across the Empire, especially in Ossium, began preparing to celebrate. The Senate had the opportunity to fund coronation festivities that, with a clear inaugural address, could leave a lasting legacy.

A banner of Thorns.o: In Summer 380YE the Black Thorns' fight to liberate Liathaven from the Jotun drew Navarr survivors and volunteers to their banner, and the nation was offered several opportunities to press the campaign. The Navarr seized the hidden Paths of Lan Thúven, began enlarging the Black Thorns and waged a merciless campaign against the orcs.

A beacon of smoke.o: When the two-year peace treaty expired, the Grendel armada, backed by Asavean warships, broke the Salt Guard and sacked and burned Siroc. It went on to seize Lightsea and Free Landing, leaving Madruga contested and the Brass Coast unable to supply its armies.

A better future.o: In Summer 387YE Ambassador Fintan Nighthaven exposed an Axou war-magic school run with Jarm in breach of the Liberty Pact. Axos forced Ilarch Maxatios to resign as their ambassador, formed a formal Grand Council and appointed Ilarch Kario Skopos of Solokha in his place.

A big sleep.o: After League citizens struck at a vyig gathering in Sarvos during the Summer Solstice, the magistrates and a swelling militia dismantled vyig operations in the city, and at the Autumn Equinox the Vigilance assembly appointed three priests to lead active opposition to the vyig in Holberg, Tassato and Temeschwar.

A bit of peace.o: In spring 382YE a Jotun delegation under a flag of truce walked south from Sermersuaq towards Anvil, while the Thule, the Great Forest orcs and their briar allies all announced visits of their own. The Great Forest orcs also delivered more than a hundred and fifty Dawnish captives freed from a Druj labour camp to Reikos.

A blessing in disguise.o: After the Highborn Assembly upheld Kerem, Daughter of the Chantry's mandate calling citizens to an extended pilgrimage on the trods against the vallorn, the civil service judged the cost ruinous. Other national assemblies were offered the chance to share the burden by supporting the pilgrims, and Highguard was offered a cheaper way to enlarge an existing army.

A box for a sword.o: In Spring 387YE the City of Lead and Gold's herald Crown, now working for the Waning Circle, set out falling prices for wains and brokered an offer from the City of Chains to sell Urizen an Autumn mercenary army, the Argent Sword. He also put the Immaculate Architect ritual text up for sale and passed on a foreign client's bid for cow bonds.

A bridge too far.o: In Spring 387YE the prognosticator Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra delivered her appraisal on destroying the Kongegőr, the bridged chain of islands linking the Jotun territories of Skallahn and Hordalant. She found that it could only be done with armies, and proposed a risky naval assault by the Red Wind Corsairs.

A bright cerulean flame.o: In Spring 388YE the Highborn army the Pilgrim's Defiance marched through Zenith into East Ashes in Therunin, broke Druj defences and fought the risen vallorn at Mudlark's Haven, stopping it from claiming the region at the cost of some 1,500 dead.

A broken frame.o: Ahead of the Autumn 383YE summit, the civil service listed the Sentinel Gate conjunctions its prognosticators had found. They offered chances to fight marshwalkers, break Druj miasma pillars in Ossium, rescue captives from the Grendel and Jotun, help Jotun thralls escape, counter the vallorn and the Heirs of Terunael, and explore the sewers of Sarvos.

A business like any other.o: In Winter 380YE, black-sailed Axou merchants began visiting Imperial ports in large numbers for the first time in decades, and their appetite for liao briefly drove up its price.
