Chords.o: After the Grendel of Spiral under Salt Lord Kaliact switched allegiance to the Empire and sought to join the League, their priests asked the Imperial Synod to rule on four non-Imperial virtues they follow: audacity, cunning, fidelity and retribution.

Church of your heart.o: In Winter 385YE, Highborn veterans answered calls from Ira of the Flame Beneath the Earth and General Asenath to return to arms against the scions of Cold Sun. This gave the Highborn Assembly two mandate opportunities for new army orders, with alternative versions offered to the Varushkan Assembly.

Cities of the Iron Labyrinth.o: In Spring 386YE the Autumn cities answered the Archmage of Autumn's call for aid in the Empire's wars. Estavus offered mystic scrolls, bourse surveys, magical items and a cheaper Hand of the Maker, Ephisis reported volatile prices, and the Lictors arranged to meet Ashborn Trosk's representative.

City folk and country folk.o: In Winter 380YE about a hundred Whittlefolk fled their Jotun-held village in Freemoor and camped outside Tassato Mestra. Their steward, Margaret Steward, asked the Tassatan Chamber of Commerce to sell them two streets for a closed enclave, and the Chamber postponed its decision to a meeting at Anvil.

City lights.o: In Spring 382YE the Blood Red Roads brought a short-lived boost to incomes across the Empire, while the addictive drug bite fuelled violence among League bravos and mountebanks. Madruga's defiance of the Grendel raised trade and opened opportunities for a shipyard and sea defences at Siroc, and Hahnmark merchants proposed a runehall at Kalpaheim.

Civil tongue.o: In Summer 382YE the Empire's foreign relations were surveyed nation by nation: a Sumaah envoy returned seeking a formal Senate reception, Axos offered scouts to help map the Mountains of the Moon, Jarmish jewellers proposed a trading exchange, and the Iron Confederacy made fresh demands.

Claim Sungold Pass.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion declaring that the Sungold Pass and the mountain called the Traveller lie within Opascari in Volodmartz, and that foreigners exploiting resources on Imperial land without the Empire's direct invitation is unacceptable.

Clarification on the Brilliant Shore.o: The Senate ruled that the Brilliant Shore, a national bourse seat in Skarsind, should stay with its current holder until it next came up for election rather than passing at once to the Imperial Orcs to elect.

Climb every mountain.o: Herminius' Urizen Assembly mandate calling on Urizeni to turn out the Disciples of Sulemaine failed to move the spires sheltering them, since they harbour in places that reject the Synod's authority. The wind set out two further options: an illegal Synod mandate to hunt the Disciples down by force, or a Senate motion criminalising their fraternity.

Cloud waves break.o: In Winter 383YE an Empire-wide supernatural fog clouded and subtly altered memories and invaded dreams, accompanied by masked tulpas of the Door that offered to take unwanted memories. The phenomenon, tied to a conjunction of the Wanderer with the Lock and the Door, abated after the Winter Solstice.

Colourblind.o: The Silver Chalice, working with Freeborn hakima and kohan and friends of Lord Rain, uncovered the nature of the Winter blight on Madruga's Great Grasses. It was spread by desiccated monsters, led by the cursed Aldea di Tutamen family, and an opportunity arose to destroy some of them through the Sentinel Gate.

Come back to stay.o: After Zenith fell to the Druj, rumours spread across the Empire that the spirit of Empress Varkula, whose first conquest was Zenith, was stirring in her tomb in Necropolis, accompanied by shared nightmares, a haunted Senate and strange events at the tomb itself.

Come together.o: Inspired by the completion of the City of Dreams, the dreamspeaker Bronwen of the Silver Falls proposed the Gardens of the Heart, a great work in Serenael that would boost Miaren's herb gardens and let the Imperial Apothecaries Guild direct new potion research. The cost could be cut sharply if great works in Reikos, Holberg, Ossium and Skarsind were redirected to help.

Comes a time.o: After the Navarr Assembly called for a new army to strike at the vallorn and the General Assembly recognised Seren as a city equal to those of other nations, two sets of opportunities opened: raising a vallorn-fighting army, with or without Arhallogen's aid, and three rival great commissions to raise Seren's standing. The Navarr later raised the Thornbound army Isaella's Dance and built the redesigned Temple of Waking Dream.

Coming home.o: A major conjunction opened into the heart of the Kallavesa Marsh, letting the whole Wintermark nation make a rare pilgrimage to honour and inter its heroic dead. The Wintermark Assembly also sent Gunnbrand Ironwill with 50 doses of liao to make its call to fight the Jotun as heroes permanent.

Commission report on Morrow evacuation.o: The Senate passed a motion directing the civil service to determine possible routes for evacuating civilians from Morrow, and to present proposals on how this might be achieved if feasible.

Concede territory of Segura to Lasambria.o: In Spring 383YE a Senate motion proposed conceding the Brass Coast territory of Segura to the four tribes of the Lasambrian Jotun; the motion failed.

Concord and accord.o: On the second anniversary of Imperatrix Lisabetta's disappearance, with the Throne still unfilled, Imperial magicians broadly accepted the Imperial Magus's Spring Equinox Declaration of Concord that Throne candidates must engage with the Conclave.

Conduit to destiny.o: Wintermark was offered the chance to build a new runeforge at the Runegrott beneath Northspires to reclaim its lost prestige in crafting magic items, with several ways to reduce the enormous cost. By the resolution, the ruins of the Gildenheim runeforge had been dismantled and moved to Runegrott, allowing a new forge to be built there at a significant discount.

Construct A Fair Price.o: The Legion Engineer Groza announced the commission of 'A Fair Price', a farm sinecure in Iteri, Zenith, intended to fund the Champion of Prosperity so they could pay deserving citizens for their work.

Construct Abbey of Reconciliation.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Abbey of Reconciliation in Necropolis, a sinecure producing 10 weirwood herbs and forming part of the Network of the Proffered Hand.

Construct Academy Religious Studies sine.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate approved the construction of a sinecure at Canterspire in Morrow to supply liao to the Academy, requested by the Academy Junior Council.

Construct Adelaarskade.o: In Autumn 387YE the Chair of the Wolf announced the construction of Adelaarskade, a series of dykes in Holberg meant to drain the wetlands of Rebeshof and Utterlund, commissioned at the behest of Otmar von Holberg of Adelaarsgilde.

Construct Alchemical Workshop in Miaren.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Miaren and seconded by Hercynia, to build a potion laboratory in Miaren dedicated to Murit.

Construct Angelica Memorial House of Hea.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Sarvos and seconded by Skarsind, to commission a herb garden sinecure in Riposi called the Angelica Vergo di Sarvos Memorial House of Healing.

Construct Anvil Library Scriptorium.o: The Bearer of the Second Imperial Wayleave, Claus Friedrich von Holberg, announced the construction of the Anvil Library Scriptorium, a self-funded sinecure in Rodez, Foracci, Sarvos, providing liao and Synod votes.

Construct Apstrus Dam.o: In Winter 387YE the Legion Engineer, Firesong Arachas, announced the construction of a dam in Apstrus, Spiral, to divert water into Icarion in Mareave. The motion was self-funded and later completed, turning Icarion into an oasis.

Construct Arbor of the Twin Roses.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Arbor of the Twin Roses, a sinecure in Ferrond, Semmerholm, honouring the exemplar Elayne Silverlark and creating the position of the Voice of the Twin Roses.

Construct Archives of the Advisor.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 388YE to commission the Archives of the Advisor in Solvihill, Skarsind, a sinecure producing 12 measures of iridescent gloaming each season, attached to the existing title of Advisor on Orc Affairs.

Construct Arsenal in Sarvos.o: In Winter 381YE the senator for Sarvos proposed a self-funded Great Work, an arsenal in Sarvos, to enrich the port fleets and give the League the option of raising a navy. The motion failed.

Construct Art Museum of Tassato.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Tassato's senator and seconded by Astolat's, to build a great work in Tassato dedicated to the virtue of Pride, taking advantage of a recent surge of inspiration in Pride and the arts.

Construct Asavean Embassy.o: In Winter 377YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Sarvos and seconded by Temeschwar, to construct an embassy to the Asavean Archipelago in Sarvos, approving it at 35 Thrones.

Construct Asavean Temple.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion granting Asavea permission to build a major temple to their gods in Feroz, on the understanding that it would be used only by non-Imperial citizens.

Construct Ashen Tears Wayhouse.o: In Summer 387YE a Senate motion commissioned the Ashen Tears wayhouse in Skogei Glens, Skarsind, and it was completed, with its keeper to be appointed by the senators of Navarr.

Construct Atalaq Tradehall.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 388YE, proposed by Sermersuaq's senator, to build the Atalaq Tradehall, a great work in Sealtoq meant to boost business investment in Sermersuaq. It required 50 wains of weirwood and 150 crowns and was seeking funds.

Construct Atalaya Harbour.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion to rebuild Atalaya Harbour in Madruga, letting Freeborn fleets based there be upgraded more cheaply without the harbour counting as a shipyard.

Construct Aurelie's Garden.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build Aurelie's Garden, a herb-producing sinecure in Grovesyard, Miaren, beside the hospital Aurelie's Rest, to be contested each year between Dawn and Navarr.

Construct Autumn's Boon.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to construct a mana sinecure called Autumn's Boon in Wood Heath, Hahnmark, creating the Imperial title Collector of Prosperity's Boon.

Construct Axos Embassy.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build an embassy to Axos in Redoubt, with the ambassador to be appointed by the Senate. Construction began in Limus after the materials and labour were privately supplied.

Construct Bakers' Bowl.o: Lula Kleist von Ennerlund announced, under an Imperial Wayleave, the commissioning of the Bakers' Bowl, a stadium in Holmauer, Holberg, as a sinecure creating the League national position of Sponsor of the Holberg Hammers.

Construct Barossa University of Dramatur.o: In Summer 387YE the Master of Rings, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, announced a Senate motion to construct the Barossa University of Dramaturgical Arts, a college of magic in Apulian dedicated to the study of dramaturgy.

Construct Barrens Spy Network.o: In Spring 378YE the Senate approved the construction of a spy network in The Barrens, proposed by the Volodmartz senator and seconded by the Skarsind senator; it was later destroyed by the Druj after the Summer Solstice 382YE.

Construct Basilica of the Seven Doors.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 383YE to restore the Basilica of the Seven Doors in Bastion with the aid of the Custodes Clavium, re-creating the title of Speaker of the Highborn Assembly as a sinecure.

Construct Beacon of Sermersuaq.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 387YE to construct the Beacons of Sermersuaq in Sealtoq, completing the final set of the Beacons of Wintermark and drawing on a boon from the eternal Cathan Canae.

Construct Bears Rest.o: In Summer 388YE the Legion Engineer, Firesong Arachas, announced the construction of Bears Rest, a mana sinecure in Northspires, Hahnmark, whose steward collects mana flowing down the river from a melting glacier upstream.

Construct Beneficiary of the Golden Casc.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 387YE to construct the Beneficiary of the Golden Cascade, a sinecure in Proceris, Zenith, which was completed and became available for appointment by the Urizen Assembly from the Summer Solstice 387YE.

Construct Beoraidh Trading Post.o: In Spring 388YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Mareave and seconded by The Barrens, to build a trading post in Icarion, Mareave, so that salt could be traded for beef with Beoraidh. The trading post was later completed.

Construct Black Canal.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate commissioned the Black Canal, a great westward waterway named for Gerraint Black and linking Meade in Mitwold with Sarcombe in the Mournwold, built with the help of the Mournwold orcs.

Construct Black Obelisk.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build "The Black Obelisk" on the Guildenstern estate in Stockmarch, Upwold. It was to be a memorial to the herald Obligatus and the landskeeper Geraint Black after cultist activity in Upwold.

Construct Blackfield Market.o: A Senate motion in Autumn 383YE proposed spending Imperial funds to build the Blackfield Market in Mitwold, with a new Blackfield Bailiff title to oversee it, but the motion failed.

Construct Blade of Thorn.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to commission Llafndrián, the Blade of Thorn, a self-funded great work in Old Ranging in Hercynia that produces mana for the owners of mana sites.

Construct Bladeroot Sinecure.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a bladeroot-producing herb garden sinecure in Old Ranging, Hercynia, which will create the Imperial title of Steward of the Nabarr, appointed by the senators of Navarr.

Construct Bleak Tower.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Bleak Tower, a self-funded great work in Ravion, Morrow, to house the refugees of the herb garden of Pallas and their herbalist researchers.

Construct Boar's Market.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate passed a motion to fund and construct the Boar's Market, a market-fayre at Boar's Hollow in Astolat where Dawn could purchase weirwood, mithril and white granite.

Construct Botanical Gardens of First Voi.o: In Autumn 388YE the Senate passed a motion to restore the Botanical Gardens at the First Voice Glade School in Oakways, Miaren. The gardens would support the study of herb-lore with the Navarr and strengthen the Empire's prosperity and health.

Construct Bounders Hall in Bregasland.o: A Senate motion commissioned a Bounders Hall in Ottery, Bregasland, to create the Marcher title Bailiff of the Fens. The construction later lapsed for lack of funds and because the Jotun conquered Bregasland.

Construct Bounders Hall of Meade.o: The Legion Engineer announced the commissioning of a Bounders Hall in Meade, Mitwold, at Autumn Equinox 386YE. The hall was built and created the Marcher national title of Bailiff of Meade.

Construct Brenna’s Gift.o: The Senate passed a motion, raised by Imperial Wayleave by Jorgen Brenna, to construct a great work in Hahnmark called Brenna's Gift that increases farming revenue.

Construct Bright-Threads Brass Works.o: The Legion Engineer Groza announced the construction of the Bright-Threads Brass Works, a sinecure producing orichalcum in Valasmark, Hahnmark. Once completed, it created the Wintermark title of Bright Threadweaver, first appointed at the Winter Solstice 385YE.

Construct Bulgakov Memorial.o: Ada Droon, Mistress of Monuments, announced a memorial in Bulgakov, Duzekani, to commemorate the Varushkan citizens killed in the Cold Sun's attacks and the knights-errant who died fighting the scions so that many people of the vale could escape. The work was funded and completed, and warding stakes now stand around Bulgakov.

Construct Carmine Fields Trading Post.o: In Summer 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Wordes, Numbers, Figures and Knotes Trading Post, a ministry at Carmine Fields in the Barrens, and to create the title of Envoy to the Karass.

Construct Cascade of Living Flame.o: In Autumn 386YE a mana sinecure, the Cascade of Living Flame, was commissioned in Peregro, Morrow, and has since been completed, creating a new Urizen-appointed position.

Construct Cathedral of Courage.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a Cathedral of Courage in Astolat, a sinecure granting votes in the Synod, to fortify the virtue of the Dawnish people against malign influences and auras. A small cathedral was subsequently built near the tourney grounds of Laroc in The Chase.

Construct Celestial Library at Canterspi.o: The Senate passed a motion to transform the Grand Library of Canterspire into a Celestial Library and cede it to the eternal Phaleron, creating the institution of Urizen Lore as a monument to the nation's magical Ambition and Pride.

Construct Cerulean Balmhouse.o: In Spring 388YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Cerulean Balmhouse, a fully funded herb sinecure in Fontargenta in Feroz, with help sought from the Sumaah Republic. It was completed, with its first Herb Tender to be appointed by the Freeborn Assembly at the Summer Solstice 388YE.

Construct Challenger in Waiting.o: Valentin Ivarovich Orzel, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Challenger in Waiting, a liao sinecure without tenure based in Weirwater, appointed by the Dawnish National Assembly. Construction was completed and the first Challenger in Waiting was elected at the Autumn Equinox 385YE.

Construct Chamber of Euphony.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 387YE to build and cede the Chamber of Euphony, a fane to Sung in Apulus, Spiral, along with a new Imperial title, the Map to the City Below. It was funded through donations over the following year and completed.

Construct Church of the Roads.o: A commission was announced to build the Church of the Roads in Woodbury, Bastion, creating a liao sinecure, the Chaplain of the Roads, responsible for protecting the souls of those travelling on Highguard's roads.

Construct Churnspire.o: In Spring 384YE the Imperial Senate passed a motion commissioning the Churnspire, a magical tower in Peregro in Morrow, built with the help of the eternal Meraud and ceded to her. Once complete, it creates the national position of Churnspire Adjutor.

Construct Cinderpath Exchange.o: A Senate motion to construct the Cinderpath Exchange, a self-funded ministry in Mareholm, Casinea, allowing the purchase of white granite, failed in Summer 382YE. A follow-up administrative motion to reconsider it also failed.

Construct Cinderpath Exchange II.o: In Spring 383YE the Senate considered a motion to build the Cinderpath Exchange, a self-funded ministry in Mareholm, Casinea, and the motion failed. It was a second attempt, following an earlier motion that had also failed.

Construct Cinderpath Exchange III.o: In Spring 383YE a bearer of an Imperial Wayleave announced the commissioning of the Cinderpath Exchange, a white granite ministry in Mareholm, Casinea. It followed two earlier failed motions for the same project.

Construct Circo del Topo.o: In Winter 387YE the Chair of the Wolf, Lucrezia Corvinascura, announced the construction of the Circo del Topo, a self-funded sinecure in Hanuri, Temeschwar. It was completed after the Winter Solstice, and the Temeschwari Topolino title became available for appointment at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Construct City of Dreams.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Miaren's senator and seconded by Bastion's, to commission the City of Dreams in Serenael, Miaren, using the opportunity set out in the Comes a Time wind of fortune.

Construct City of Wonders.o: Firesong Arachas, the Legion Engineer, announced the construction of the City of Wonders edifice in Anduzjasse, Segura, following the example of Dust, Glass, and Flame and taking up the opportunity of the On the road ahead wind of fortune.

Construct Clattering Curtain Theatre.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to build Martim de Tassato's Clattering Curtain Theatre in Mestra, Tassato, a money-producing sinecure with its own Imperial title.

Construct College of Engineering and Arc.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to commission a college of engineering and architecture in Temeschwar, to be ceded to the eternal Adamant and creating the Imperial title of Master of the Koboldi.

Construct College of Maykop.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build a campus for the Halls of Maykop in Casinea, as set out in the A mountain of vipers Wind of Fortune.

Construct College of Summer Magic.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate was asked to approve a College of Summer Magic in Miekarova, built to designs provided by the Eternal Cathan Canae. Once completed, it became The Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun and created the Imperial title of Master of Ice and Darkness.

Construct College of the Liberated.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion to build the College of the Liberated in Sarvos, a great work to help former Jarmish slaves integrate into the Empire through education and apprenticeships, and created the title of Dean of the Liberated.

Construct Commonwealth embassy.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build an embassy to the Commonwealth in Madruga, though no funds were allocated at the time.

Construct Compassion Without Expectation.o: In Winter 386YE the Mistress of Monuments, Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov, announced the construction of "Compassion Without Expectation", a restful garden in Applefell, Weirwater, honouring the late Lady Eleanor Novarion for founding the Proffered Hand network.

Construct Crimson Drummers of Madruga.o: Ahraz i Guerra of the Celesti, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Crimson Drummers of Madruga, a sinecure in Torres producing liao and Synod votes. Its holder, the Crimson Sutannir, would be chosen by the Freeborn National Assembly.

Construct Crucible of Fate.o: In Winter 384YE Sagua i'Ezmara, Master of the Koboldi, announced that season's project as the reconstruction of the Crucible of Fate, a foundry in Iteri in Zenith where the ushabti were first created. All the required materials were supplied after the Winter Solstice.

Construct Crystal Fruit Garden.o: The Senate passed a motion to build the Crystal Fruit Garden, a mana sinecure in Serenael, Miaren, creating the title Keeper of the Crystal Fruit to coordinate Navarr farmers.

Construct Curstag's Way.o: In Autumn 386YE the Master of Rings, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, announced a great work in Spiral: Curstag's Way, a Grand Highway linking Redoubt, Spiral and Mareave, named for the first League orc to die in battle for the Empire. It was later completed, boosting Spiral's businesses and developing Icarion in Mareave.

Construct Dancer's Rest.o: The Legion Engineer, Firesong Arachas, announced the construction of the Dancer's Rest, a money sinecure in Seren in Miaren built with 10 wains of weirwood. It was completed, creating the title of Hand to the Dance.

Construct Defence of the Broch.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Defence of the Broch in Brocéliande, using an opportunity presented by the people of the steadings, to protect the Broch, yield bladeroot and act as a spy network.

Construct Delev Grand Market.o: In Spring 388YE the Master of the Koboldi announced a commission to build a grand market in Delev, in the Duzekani region of Karov, following the Outside the Wall Wind of Fortune. The people of Karov pledged to fund it themselves, and citizens donated money and white granite over the following seasons.

Construct Department of Architecture.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Temeschwar's senator and seconded by Semmerholm's, to build the Temeschwar University Department of Architecture in Hanuri, creating the Imperial title Master of Rings.

Construct Dima's Light of Ossium.o: Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, announced the commissioning of Dima's Light of Ossium, a grand beacon on the Bittershore, in Autumn 388YE.

Construct Diplomatenschloss.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Diplomatenschloss, a new fortified embassy for the Commonwealth in Hedrossan, Necropolis, following the For the Common Good Wind of Fortune.

Construct Drusila's Obelus.o: Lukash, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of Drusilla's Obelus, a sinecure in the Morass, Holberg, producing 18 drams of bladeroot each season.

Construct Dunfrith.o: In Autumn 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark approved the construction of Dunfrith, a herb sinecure in the forests of Wood Heath in southern Hahnmark, which will create the Wintermark national position of Guardian of Dunfrith.

Construct Eastern Spring Farm.o: Palerictus Krunk, bearer of an Imperial Orc Wayleave, announced the commissioning of a sinecure in eastern Skarsind to benefit the nation's spring ritualists, creating the title Farmer of Eastern Spring Farm.

Construct Eels Landing.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion to develop the docks at Eels Landing in the North Fens of Bregasland, ceding them to House Greywater and granting the town a market charter. The charter was ratified by Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost.

Construct Effervescent Brook.o: In Autumn 388YE Wistan Goodledger, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Effervescent Brook, a ministry in Grovesyard, Astolat, commissioned on behalf of Enchantress Areloe. It diverts the Whitesmoke Brook to the Phoenix Flame to provide tonics against the vallorn.

Construct Embassy to the Thule.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to construct an embassy to the Thule, for the Ambassador to the Thule, in the Varushkan territory of Miekarova.

Construct Emilio's Herbarium.o: The Imperial Orcs used an Imperial Wayleave, announced by Palerictus Krunk, to commission Emilio's Herbarium, a weirwood-herb sinecure in Foracci, Sarvos, in Winter 382YE.

Construct Ethengraw Armoury.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build a smithy and armoury folly in Gildermark and cede it to the Ethengraw sept of Ossium. This followed the All too well Wind of Fortune.

Construct Eye of Heavens.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 388YE to commission the Eye of Heavens, an observatory in Occursion, Zenith, under the Sound and Vision Wind of Fortune, presented as part of the assurance to build the Arch of the Sky and the Skyways.

Construct Faraden embassy.o: In Winter 378YE the Senate passed a motion, at 80 Thrones, to build an embassy to the Faraden in Anduz in the Freeborn territory of Segura.

Construct Feldspar Distillery.o: In Spring 386YE the Legion Engineer Groza announced a commission to build the Feldspar Distillery, a herb garden sinecure in Solvihill, Skarsind, creating the title of Wise Arborist. Once funded and completed, the title became available for appointment by the Imperial Orc senators from the Winter Solstice 386YE.

Construct First Voice Glade.o: An Imperial Wayleave was used to announce the construction of First Voice Glade, a herb garden sinecure in Miaren commemorating Gerallt the bard, First Voice of the Navarr, who died at Return, and serving as a gathering place for Navarri bards.

Construct Floerstrand.o: In Autumn 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build Floerstrand, a "Hot Spring Hall", in Tanikipari in Sermersuaq, following the Farm, fur, and fish Wind of Fortune.

Construct Flood Defences in Caricomare.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build flood defences at Caricomare in Sarvos with the help of the Vandersar, following the Sound the bells Wind of Fortune. The defences were completed.

Construct Forest of Defiance.o: A commission to build a mana sinecure called the Forest of Defiance in Skarsind was announced in Autumn 383YE. It would create the title Dauntless Warrior, though the Speaker noted that the Imperial Orc Wayleave cited by the announcer was vacant at the time and that the matter was under investigation.

Construct Forge of Bonds.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Forge of Bonds in the Fingers, Hahnmark. The edifice created the position of Keeper of Oaths, an office elected with tenure by the Loyalty Assembly.

Construct Fortification in Peregro.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Morrow, to build a citadel in Peregro to stand watch over the border of Therunin, where the Druj and the vallorn hold sway. It was completed as the fortification Quicksilver's Flame.

Construct Freya's Garden.o: In Winter 382YE a Great Work named Freya's Garden was commissioned in Hahnmark under an Imperial Wayleave held by Tyr Brennan, to provide herbs to heal the Empire.

Construct Gallery of Memories.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Gallery of Memories in Lomaa, Ossium: a permanent exhibition to the former cultures of Ossium's freed peoples, which also creates the money sinecure title of Curator of Memories.

Construct Garden City in Holberg.o: The Senate commissioned the transformation of Holberg into the City of Flowers, a folly arising from The greatest city in the world Wind of Fortune, proposed by the Senator for Holberg and seconded by Redoubt. The work was funded and completed, turning Holmauer into a garden city.

Construct Garden of Falling Snow.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate considered a motion from the senator for Hahnmark, seconded by Sermersuaq, to build the Garden of Falling Snow, a herb garden sinecure in Hahnmark. It was later completed, creating the Imperial title of Gatekeeper of Falling Snow.

Construct Garden of Glory.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to build the Garden of Glory in Therunin, creating a liao sinecure with the title Keeper of the Garden.

Construct Garden of Hope.o: In Autumn 388YE the Legion Engineer, Firesong Arachas, announced construction of the Garden of Hope, a great work in Gildermark designed by the Black Tillers of Skarsind to give the Empire's orcs a new way to access Hearkener's Hope.

Construct Garden of Imperial Auxiliaries.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Garden of the Imperial Auxiliaries, a herb garden sinecure in Coursmouth, Necropolis, which will create the title Legate of the Imperial Auxiliaries.

Construct Garden of Peaceful Quietitude.o: A sinecure called the Garden of Peaceful Quietitude was commissioned in Kalpamark, Hahnmark, announced by Hilda Sirens Scream Ursan as Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave under the Poet lights but lamps wind of fortune. It was completed, creating the title of Seeker of Quietitude.

Construct Garden of the Grim II.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a herb sinecure in Miekarova called the "Gardens of the Grim", but the commission was never authorised because the season's maximum number of commissions had already been reached.

Construct Gardens of High Chalcis.o: Rhesa, Exarch of the Scions of Ravensfell and Highguard Civilian Commissioner, commissioned the rebuilding of the Gardens of High Chalcis in Chalcis Mount, Reikos, during Summer 380YE, and the gardens were completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 380YE.

Construct Gardens of Morrow.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Urizen approved the construction of the Gardens of Morrow, a great work to produce herbs in Morrow.

Construct Gardens of the Grim III.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Miekarova and seconded by Karov, to build the Gardens of the Grim, a self-funded herb sinecure in Miekarova that would also serve as the Courage artefact 'The Chains of Chernebog'.

Construct Gardens of the Perfect World.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Gardens of the Perfect World in Occursion, Zenith, a ministry enabling trade with the hermit kingdom of Tsark, exchanging weirwood and/or liao for white granite.

Construct Garrison of the League.o: In Summer 385YE a Senate commission was announced to build a business sinecure, the Garrison of the League, in Hanuri in Temeschwar, with its holder appointed annually by the League's generals. It was later completed.

Construct Gate in Semmerholm.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to rebuild the Gate, a fortification in Semmerholm, by accepting the Eternal Adamant's offer to rebuild it and make it Unbreakable. The project was self-funded and needed no Imperial Surveyor.

Construct General Estana's Repository.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the Brass Coast approved a folly, General Estana's Repository, a grand library of contracts in Oran, Feroz, to be dedicated to the Eternal Callidus. No contract with the Eternal was ever signed, so work never began and the commission lapsed by Summer 381YE.

Construct Georgies' Home for Goodest Dog.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a business sinecure in Holberg called "Georgies Home for Goodest Dogs", to be assigned annually by the League Senators.

Construct Giant's Well.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by the senator for Mitwold and seconded by Bastion, to build a self-funded folly in Mitwold: a white granite menhir to cap the "Giant's Well".

Construct Giritane's Gaze.o: In Autumn 384YE Sagua i'Ezmara, Master of the Koboldi, announced the construction of Giritane's Gaze, a great white mandowla statue with glowing eyes built in Weirwater to support the territory's miners.

Construct Glen of Shadows Trading Office.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Hercynia's senator and seconded by Feroz, to build a trading office in the Glen of Shadows in Hercynia to help trade with the orcs of Skarsind.

Construct Golden Bee Assayer's Office.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct the Golden Bee Assayer's Office in Duzekani, Karov, taking up the opportunity offered by the Outside the Wall Wind of Fortune.

Construct Golden Causeway.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Golden Causeway across the Semmerlak, a magical golden crossing offered by the Lady of the Semmerlak that gives passage to Druj lands.

Construct Golden Orchards of Miaren.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Golden Orchards of Miaren, a mana sinecure near Seren that provides mana crystals. It was later completed.

Construct Good Leaf Gardens.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion to construct Good Leaf Gardens, a wayhouse folly in Upwold that, backed by a Navarr National Assembly mandate, functions as a sinecure sharing Navarri herbs with the Marches in thanks for their support against the vallorn.

Construct Good Walder's Orchard.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to commission Good Walder's Orchard, a sinecure beside the Walder's Oak in Mitwold, to produce apples and liao each season. It was overseen by a new Keeper of the Orchard title appointed by the Marcher Assembly.

Construct Grand Art Gallery of Sarvos.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Great Work in Sarvos: a grand art gallery dedicated to Pride, taking advantage of an opportunity that arose during the recent period of inspiration.

Construct Grand Conservatory of Music.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 381YE to build the Grand Conservatory of Music in Redoubt, a great work celebrating Urizeni pride in music and magic, raised during a period of inspiration.

Construct Grand Guildhouse of the Printe.o: In Spring 388YE Taddea Ginori, Chair of the Wolf, announced the commissioning of a Grand Guildhouse of the Printers' Guild in Tassato Mestra. The building was meant to cement the guild's legacy as the Torchbearers of Truth, following the opportunity raised by the wind of fortune The truth but tell it slant.

Construct Grand Inspiration of the Way.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 385YE to commission the Grand Inspiration of the Way in Bastion, a great temple-city edifice arising from the Blood will thicken wind of fortune. Once complete, it is meant to establish the Empire as the undisputed source of spiritual guidance for all followers of the Way in the known world.

Construct Grand Lodge of Sevenfold Path.o: In Autumn 388YE Galene Netherwatch announced the construction of the Grand Lodge of the Sevenfold Path, with an extended basilica, in Sanctuary Sands, Necropolis, built with the aid of the eternal Adamant, the Shaper of Mountains, through a personal boon.

Construct Grand Lodge of the Golden Pyra.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a commission to build the Grand Lodge of the Golden Pyramid, a great work in Clisearn, Mareave, as set out in the Lit up Wind of Fortune. It also created the Imperial Orc title Bonesetter of the Delving Market.

Construct Great Aqueduct of Eoradal.o: In Winter 386YE the Legion Engineer, Protectorate Thenrik, commissioned the Great Aqueduct of Eoradal in Mareave, an edifice built in Clisearn to bring water to Eoradal under the Million Miles of Water Wind of Fortune. The aqueduct was later completed.

Construct Great Hall of Fabric Arts.o: In Summer 386YE the Master of the Koboldi announced the construction of a Great Hall of Fabric Arts in Delev, Karov, celebrating Varushka's industry as set out in The Deer in the Sun wind of fortune.

Construct Great Harbour of Elos.o: In Spring 384YE the Senate passed a motion, at a cost of 300 Thrones, commissioning the restoration of the Great Harbour of Elos in the Naris region of Redoubt. The great work was to be overseen by a new Imperial title, the Elosian Architect.

Construct Great Library of Hacynian.o: The Senate passed a motion to expand the Library of Hacynian in Hercynia into a Great Library collating the world's lore on the vallorn, taking up an opportunity from the Wind of Fortune 'The bones of what you believe'.

Construct Greenwood Manor.o: In Summer 384YE Bertrand, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the commission of Greenwood Manor in Elvette, Semmerholm, together with the renovation of the Greenwood Market, a unique opportunity drawn from a Wind of Fortune.

Construct Grendel Embassy.o: In Spring 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build an embassy to the Grendel at Cargo in Redoubt, attached to the title of Imperial Fleetmaster. It declined the larger embassy offered in the Everything has a price wind of fortune.

Construct Guildhouse of the Artisans.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 385YE to build a guildhouse for the Artisans Guild near Runegrott and the Runeforge in Hahnmark, creating a sinecure, an Imperial title and a sodality.

Construct Hall of Rund.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Hall of Rund in Rundhal, Kallavesa, a sinecure granting liao, to be held by a new Speaker of the Crows chosen by the Wintermark National Assembly.

Construct Hall of the Hunters.o: The Legion Engineer Groza announced construction of the Hall of the Hunters, a sinecure at Lake Atkonaroq in the Suaq Wastes of Sermersuaq, creating the title Banner-bearer of Atkonaroq.

Construct Hall of the Krampus.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Skarsind and seconded by Karsk, to build a folly honouring the Krampus in Skarsind, which was subsequently completed as the Krampushall.

Construct Hall of the Seven.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate commissioned the Hall of the Seven in Miaren, a ministry creating the post of Spear of the Seven, a military counterpart to the Advisor on the Vallorn. Construction was completed with materials and money donated by many citizens.

Construct Hall of the Soturi.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 388YE to commission the Hall of the Soturi, an edifice in the Kallavesa Marsh that would allow Wintermark to raise a new army with the unique fearless quality.

Construct Hall of the Unbroken.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 384YE to commission the Hall of the Unbroken, a mana sinecure in the East Floes of Sermersuaq intended to give sanctuary and healing to those who have endured slavery.

Construct Happiston Mana Exchange.o: Vivane Knotes, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, commissioned a mana ministry at Happiston in the Chalkdowns of Mournwold, creating a new Marcher national title, the Reeve of the Happiston Mana Exchange.

Construct Haros Riverpatrol.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Haros Riverpatrol, a sinecure in Haros Water, Reikos, tied to the opportunity described in the Wind of Fortune "The price is great".

Construct Harps of Astolat.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Astolat and seconded by Sarvos, to build the Harps of Astolat, a mana great work in Astolat costing 150 thrones.

Construct Hartford Brewery.o: Edmund Forster, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Hartford Brewery, a money-producing sinecure in Hartford, Stock March, Upwold, whose holder is appointed by the Marcher senators.

Construct Healing House of Wittal Grove.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Healing House of Wittal Grove, a great work in Wittal Grove, Kallavesa, arising from the All life together wind of fortune and intended to benefit herb garden owners.

Construct High Path to Otkodov.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build a high path through the mountains to Otkodov, opening a ministry through which food could be exchanged for ilium and strengthening northern trade.

Construct Highwatch Citadel.o: In Summer 384YE the Legion Engineer Ka'bal commissioned the expansion of Highwatch Citadel in Altis, Morrow, to make room for heralds of Zakalwe. This took up a time-limited offer from Zakalwe that had been given a one-season extension.

Construct Holberg's Melodious Cascade.o: In Autumn 385YE the Master of Rings, Laughlan vi Temeschwar, announced the commission of Holberg's Melodious Cascade, a sinecure in Holmauer producing nine mana per season. Funded by League citizens, it was completed with a new League national position attached.

Construct Holberg's Phantasmagorical Mem.o: Bernhard Kleist von Ennerlund, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the legitimisation of a souvenir stall in Holmauer Park as "Holberg's Phantasmagorical Mementoes", a new business sinecure created under the In the Garden of Defiance Wind of Fortune.

Construct Home of the Broken Shield.o: The Civilian Commissioner of the Imperial Orcs commissioned the Home of the Broken Shield, a communal home for Imperial Orcs of the Broken Shield, as a herb-producing sinecure in Skogei's Glen, Skarsind.

Construct Honour's Rest.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion to build Honour's Rest, a congregational sinecure in Overton in the Mournwold, funded by the people of Wintermark as a gift to the people of the Mournwold. It was meant as a reminder that the Empire makes mistakes and should acknowledge them.

Construct Hordalant spy network.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate considered a motion, proposed by Therunin and seconded by Mitwold, to build a spy network based in Jotun-held Hordalant to explore the lands west of the Empire. The network was completed shortly before the Autumn Equinox 379YE.

Construct Hounds Hall.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Karsk's senator and seconded by Bastion's, to build the Hounds Hall edifice in Ivarsguard, Karsk. The hall let the newly raised Varushkan army, the Boyar's Hasta, use its sellsword quality.

Construct House Bourné School of Couture.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the House Bourné School of Couture in Sarvos, a folly creating the Imperial title of the Mirrored Maschieri and opening the way for Sarvos to be rebuilt as the City of Masks.

Construct House of Barbs.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the House of Barbs in Hercynia, a sinecure whose title, the Voice of Barbs, is elected by the Navarr national assembly and carries 12 votes in the Imperial Synod.

Construct House of Guerra.o: The Senate passed a motion to commission the House of Guerra, a ministry in Madruga that would allow the purchase of liao, arising from an opportunity to support refugees.

Construct House of Healing.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build the House of Healing, a ministry in Therunin described in the Rain King wind of fortune, creating a title appointed by the Imperial Conclave.

Construct House of Illumination and Ligh.o: In Winter 385YE the Master of the Koboldi announced a commission to build the House of Illumination in Cargo, Redoubt, and the Light Market in Essk, Miekarova, creating two Imperial titles. After nearly two years of donations the work was completed after the Autumn Equinox 387YE.

Construct House of the Proffered Hand.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build the House of the Proffered Hand, a liao sinecure in Astolat whose holder is appointed for life by the Dawn National Assembly. The site, first given as Winterbourne, was later corrected to Caer Faucon.

Construct Hufi's Garden.o: The Senate passed a motion, at 80 Thrones, to commission Hufi's Garden, a herb-garden sinecure outside Masi in Kallavesa Marsh that would carry the new Imperial title of Woundbinder of the Mark.

Construct Hylje Dolmen.o: In Spring 387YE the Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, Logan Dunning, announced the construction of a white granite marker dolmen on the northern shores of the Rikkivessi in Sealtoq, so that the Hylje could return the bones of Imperial Orc heroes who fell defending Sermersuaq. The work was completed and created a new position, the Custodian of Bones.

Construct Hyljehal.o: In Spring 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build Hyljehal, a floating hall for the Hylje on the lake of Rikkivesi in Skymark, creating the Imperial title of Mediator of the Hyljehal.

Construct Icarion Qanat.o: In Summer 387YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion, proposed by the senator for Mareave and seconded by Zenith, to build the Icarion Qanat in Mareave. Once completed, it removed the arid quality from Icarion.

Construct Imperial Consulate.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Tassato and seconded by Hercynia, to fund the construction of an Imperial Consulate building in Tassato.

Construct Imperial Cord Brokerage II.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct the Invisible Cord Brokerage, a weirwood ministry in Seren, Miaren, offering guaranteed prices as a hedge for independent weirwood traders.

Construct Invisible Cord Brokerage.o: In Spring 383YE the Senate considered a motion to build a Weirwood ministry in Seren, Miaren, as a National Bourse position, but the motion failed.

Construct Iron Confederacy embassy.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Sarvos, to construct an embassy to the Iron Confederacy in Sarvos.

Construct Iron Grove.o: Wren Ironclaw, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Iron Grove, a herb garden sinecure in Skymark, Kallavesa. It was completed, creating the title Keeper of the Iron Grove.

Construct Iron Qanat.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to employ the Asavean Architect to build the fortified Iron Qanat in Segura, but the commission was never completed and lapsed by Spring 383YE.

Construct Iron Qanat II.o: In Summer 383YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Iron Qanat, a great work in Segura that would let the Freeborn support an additional army and secure supply for their existing ones, taking advantage of an opportunity offered by settlers from the Isle of Zemress.

Construct Iron Roads.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Ossium and seconded by the senator for Miekarova, to build the Iron Roads across Varushka using skilled Varushkan roadbuilders.

Construct Iron Roundtower.o: Dragomir Dragovich, bearing an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Iron Roundtower, a Varushkan ministry dealing in mithril, in Delev near Temeschwar. He supplied the materials and money after the Summer Solstice of 383YE.

Construct Jarmish Docks.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Jarmish Weirwood docks in Cargo, Redoubt: a ministry for buying weirwood from Jarm, to be designed by the Asavean Architect.

Construct Jarmish Embassy.o: In Winter 377YE the Senate passed a motion at 40 Thrones to construct an embassy for the Principalities of Jarm in Cargo, Redoubt. It was later completed and became a trading ministry.

Construct Jarmish Jewellers.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to construct the Jarmish Star Jewellery exchange in Seren, Miaren, but the motion was abrogated at the Winter Solstice 382YE before anything was built.

Construct Jarmish trade hub in Tassato.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Tassato's senator and seconded by Holberg's, to build a trade hub in Enterio for Jarmish traders wishing to use the city's mana exchange.

Construct Jonas' Legacy.o: In Summer 387YE Bertrand, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced a Senate commission to build a tower called Jonas' Legacy in Elvette, Semmerholm. It was completed and created the Imperial title of Emerald Arcanist.

Construct Journeymage Towers.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build Journeymage Towers, follies in Lacre (Semmerholm), Malimorzi (Karov) and Bittershore (Ossium), to remove the threat Dho'uala posed to shipping on the Semmerlak.

Construct Kallavesa Marshways.o: In Autumn 388YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Kallavesa Marshways, a great work in Kallavesa intended to boost local businesses and herb gardens and create a guarding venture for military units.

Construct Kalpaheim Tradehall.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Kalpaheim Tradehall, a ministry connected to the Northern Trade Network and requested by the artisans and traders of Wintermark.

Construct Kauppahall.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build Kauppahall, a trading hall in Hahnmark, along with a new title, the Talon of Kauppahall, which allows the purchase of white granite and a small amount of ilium.

Construct Kennels of Hay.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 387YE to construct a money sinecure, the Kennels of Hay, in Golden Downs, Mitwold, self-funded by the Carefoot and Shaw Trading Company.

Construct Kespoena's Nadir.o: The Senate passed a motion to build Kespoena's Nadir, a new mithril seat in Occursion in Zenith, exploiting a fresh mithril vein uncovered by the Argent Sword.

Construct Ketsov Trade Exchange.o: Irina Vasileva Dukov, bearing an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of a trading exchange ministry in the town of Ketsov in Galath Fields, Ossium, to sell magical weapons and armour.

Construct Kleist's Winter Gardens.o: Using the authority of an Imperial Wayleave, Bernhard Kleist von Ennerlund announced the construction of Kleist's Winter Gardens at the Holberg University Duelling Grounds in Winter 384YE. The commission was a herb-producing sinecure that channels the Winter magic Skathe the Hag Queen left on Holmauer Park.

Construct Kobarid Jewelers.o: A Senate motion to commission the Jarmish Jewellery Exchange, a fortified premises for the Kobarid family of Jarm in Miaren, Navarr, failed in Winter 382YE.

Construct Kostjyas Respite.o: Kostjya of Cabal Lyktan, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, commissioned the port-town of Kostjyas Respite on the Bittershore in Ossium, on the shores of the Semmerlak. Cabal Lyktan and the people of Varushka pledged to fund it entirely themselves.

Construct Kragg's Hollow.o: In Spring 385YE the Arcane Architect, Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad, announced the construction of Kragg's Hollow, a mana sinecure in Skarsind. With construction complete, it created the Imperial title Scholar of Kragg's Hollow, appointed through the Imperial Conclave.

Construct Kruidenkenner warehouse.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a warehouse ministry at Crown's Quay in Necropolis. It was intended to let the Empire buy Cerulean Mazzarine from the Kruidenkenner herbalists of the Sarcophan Delves.

Construct Kurstrozi's Lumbermill.o: Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, commissioned Kurstrozi's Lumbermill in Drownbark, Ossium, in Autumn 385YE: a great work meant to increase the prosperity of Ossium's forests.

Construct Landskeeper's Study.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 386YE to build the Landskeeper's Study, a mana ministry in Oakwood, Ashbrook, Upwold, creating the Marcher title of Keeper of the Study.

Construct Laroc Tournament Grounds.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the Senator for Astolat and seconded by Tassato, to build the tournament grounds of Laroc in Astolat, as set out in the Good old smooth red wine wind of fortune.

Construct Last Battle Wayhouse.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 386YE to build the Last Battle Wayhouse in the Bleaks, the Barrens, to provide reconnaissance into Druj-held Sarangrave; it was completed after donations of weirwood and money.

Construct Legacy of Wisdom.o: Edmundo, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced a great work in Morrow, 'Lorenzo's Legacy of Wisdom', to enhance mana production; it was funded but destroyed by the Druj invasion of Morrow before completion.

Construct Lepidean University.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Lepidean University in Bastion, drawing on the plans of Frederick di Sarvos, creating the title of Lepidean Librarian and producing a dose of true liao to be distributed by a Synod judgement of rewarding.

Construct Leshun Market.o: Borys Vardovich Straskovich, Boyar of the Iron Roads, announced the construction of the Leshun Market in Karsk in Winter 385YE, creating a ministry as offered by the Pride and Prejudice Wind of Fortune.

Construct Liathaven spy network.o: In Autumn 377YE the Senate passed a motion to build a spy network in Liathaven, with an upkeep of 2 Thrones per season from the Senate budget, so that Imperial citizens could gather intelligence on the territory.

Construct Library of Worth.o: In Autumn 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Library of Worth, a folly in Guildenheim in Skarsind, funded by the Imperial Orc nation, to preserve history through a growing collection of words and symbols.

Construct Lisabetta Docks.o: In Spring 388YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Holberg and seconded by Sarvos, commissioning the Lisabetta Docks as a great work in Utterlund, Holberg, under the Any port in a storm Wind of Fortune.

Construct Lorenzo's Great Game.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to have the Asavean Architect build Lorenzo's Great Game, a white granite gaming house and casino in Temeschwar intended to benefit business owners.

Construct Lorenzo's Legacy of Ambition.o: The Senate passed a motion to have the Asavean architect build a great work in Tassato to boost mana production, named "Lorenzo's Legacy of Ambition". It was funded by Lorenzo "La Volpe" Macelliao von Temeschwar and completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 381YE.

Construct Lorenzo's Legacy of Courage.o: Lorenzo Macelliao von Temeschwar, holding an Imperial Wayleave, commissioned a great work in Holberg called Lorenzo's Legacy of Courage to boost mana production. It was completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 381YE.

Construct Lorenzo's Legacy of Loyalty.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 381YE to have the Asavean architect build a great work in Temeschwar to boost mana production, to be known as "Lorenzo's Legacy of Loyalty".

Construct Lorenzo's Legacy of Pride.o: Silas di Sarvos, holding an Imperial Wayleave, commissioned a great work in Sarvos called Lorenzo's Legacy of Pride to boost the city's mana production; it was completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 381YE.

Construct Lorenzo's Legacy of Prosperity.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to construct a great work in Casinea, known as Lorenzo's Legacy of Prosperity, to enhance the production of mana.

Construct Lorenzo's Legacy of Vigilance.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct 'Lorenzo's Legacy of Vigilance', a great work in New Dunhall in Hahnmark designed to enhance mana production, funded by Lorenzo 'La Volpe' and the Bloody Butchers Guild of Temeschwar.

Construct Lowther's Lift.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build Lowther's Lift, a folly in the Singing Caves near Overton in Mournwold that would open rich new veins of mithril, as described in the Wildest Dreams Wind of Fortune.

Construct Lumi's Legacy.o: In Spring 387YE the Master of Rings announced the construction of Lumi's Legacy, a herb sinecure in the East Floes of Sermersuaq devoted to bladeroot cultivation, paid for entirely by Lumi Warmthbringer.

Construct Lyceum Schloss.o: The Senate passed a motion permitting the Commonwealth to build a schloss on the island east of Siroc in Madruga for its citizens visiting the Lyceum, and ceding the structure to the Commonwealth.

Construct Madruga shipyard.o: In Winter 376YE the Senate passed a motion to build a new Imperial shipyard in Madruga, intended to increase the wealth produced by Freeborn fleets sailing from that territory.

Construct Mana Sinecure in Kallavesa.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Hahnmark and seconded by Bregasland, to build a sinecure in Kallavesa that produces mana crystals. It was finished after donations up to the Spring Equinox 387YE.

Construct Meeting Place.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 387YE to build a feasting hall on Gull Island in Kallavesa as a new meeting place for diplomacy between the Empire and the Jotun. The work was completed as Gull's Isle Hall in the West Marsh.

Construct Menagerie.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build an Imperial Menagerie in Holmauer, Holberg, to house the tame rakshasa 'Flocki' gifted to Empress Lisabetta by the Eastern Principalities of Jarm.

Construct Mercantile Exchange in Temesch.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate defeated a motion to build the Lukash Biessek von Temeschwar Mercantile Exchange, a Great Work intended to boost the profitability of businesses in Temeschwar.

Construct Micah's Stand.o: The Senate passed a motion to build Micah's Stand, a wayhouse in High Chalcis in Reikos, following the Wasp nest Wind of Fortune; it was funded by individual donors and has since been completed.

Construct Mines of Gulhule.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to commission the Mines of Gulhule, a large ministry in Skarsind to recruit and organise the territory's miners and let the Imperial Orcs purchase ingots.

Construct Ministry for Bursar of the Con.o: In Winter 385YE the Arcane Architect, Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad, announced the construction of a ministry for the Bursar of the Conclave in Moresvah, Karsk, letting the Bursar buy crystal mana at standard costs. It was later completed.

Construct Ministry in Sybella.o: In Autumn 380YE Rhesa of the Scions of Ravensfell, Civilian Commissioner for Highguard, commissioned a herb garden ministry in Sybella Cross, Bastion, to be overseen by a new High Herbalist of Sybella.

Construct Misericorde Market.o: Tristan Exile's End, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of a covered market in Holberg to facilitate trade between Holberg's citizens and the Sand Fishers orcs, and the commission passed in Summer 383YE.

Construct Mithril Block.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Spiral and seconded by Bastion, to commission the Block, a mithril ward over the spires of Spiral, to be built in Cinion.

Construct Mithril Sculptures.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build a folly of two mithril statues, one in southern Proceris in Zenith and one in the peaks of Optarion in Redoubt. It also created the Urizen national title of Oblivion Sentinel to keep watch over the Black Plateau.

Construct Monument in Bastion.o: In Autumn 386YE the Mistress of Monuments, Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov, announced a folly in Sybella, Bastion, celebrating Brother Olyvar of Esther's Sanctum, Lady Josephine of Adina's Charge, Hazelelponi of the Shattered Tower and countless others for their work to end discrimination against lineaged people in Highguard and the wider Empire.

Construct Monument to Silent Bell.o: In Winter 387YE Ada Droon, Mistress of Monuments, announced an edifice in Broken Ride, Reikos: an engraved white granite pillar celebrating the Silent Bell sodality for their tireless work defending the Empire and the Way.

Construct Mountains of the Moon spy netw.o: A Senate motion proposed by Casinea and seconded by Therunin to build a spy network in the Mountains of the Moon, the unknown territory east of Urizen, failed in Autumn 381YE.

Construct Mudlark's Haven.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build "Mudlark's Haven", a fortified steading in the Feverwater, Therunin. The work expanded the Feverwater Docks.

Construct Municipal Docks.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to raise a commission building the Municipal Docks in Calvos Sound, Madruga, a great work that was subsequently funded and completed.

Construct Naval Academy of Blood and Bra.o: A Senate motion to commission the Naval Academy of Blood and Brass, a school of shipbuilding and international trade in Siroc, was put forward in Winter 382YE but failed.

Construct Nightingale Chorus.o: The Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, Mharen Splitroot, announced the construction of the Nightingale Chorus, a wayhouse in Brightway in Grovesyard, Astolat, during Summer 388YE. It was intended to aid the fight against the Vallorn, raise Astolat's taxes and create a new Imperial title.

Construct Nostos Docks.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to build the Nostos Docks in Morrow, following the opportunity in the An angry blade Wind of Fortune. The docks were completed and created the new title of Architect of the Conscious River.

Construct Oath's Roots.o: A Senate motion proposed commissioning the Oath's Roots, a weirwood Bourse seat in Liathaven, but it was withdrawn before taking effect.

Construct Oathwright Press.o: Ergot di Cevia, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Oathwright Printing Press, a sinecure in Cevia, Tassato, in Winter 386YE. The project was completed, creating the title of Printmaster of Cevia.

Construct Office of Fire and Stone.o: In Winter 387YE, Edmundo of Damakan's Forge, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the self-funded construction of the Office of Fire and Stone, an edifice in Iteri, Zenith. The work was completed and created a new Urizen national position.

Construct Office of the Lantern Wolf.o: Gustavus Tolski van Temeschwar, Chair of the Wolf, announced in Winter 385YE the commission of the Office of the Lantern Wolf, a new sinecure within the walls of Tassato arising from the Battle cries Wind of Fortune. After donations spanning 386YE the work was completed.

Construct Offices of the Iron Roads.o: At the Summer Solstice 385YE the Master of the Koboldi announced the construction of the Offices of the Iron Roads, a folly spread across five Varushkan territories that creates the title of Boyar of the Iron Roads.

Construct Open Fan Cicisbeo Academy.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 386YE to construct the Open Fan Cicisbeo Academy in Cigno, Sarvos, a self-funded money sinecure creating the title of Headmistress of the Open Fan Academy.

Construct Open Hand of the Ancestors.o: In Summer 385YE the Legion Engineer, Bleakshield Groza, announced the construction of the Open Hand of the Ancestors, a congregation sinecure in northern Solvihill, Skarsind. Once completed it created the Imperial Orc national title of Guide to the Lost.

Construct Orchard of the Watch.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Orchard of the Watch, a folly in Greensward, Mournwold, following the Let the day die wind of fortune. Friar John of the Mourn paid for it in full.

Construct Ossuary Temple.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Ossuary Temple, a folly in Southpine, Skarsind, to house the bones the Illarawm sept had recovered from Ossium, with the temple to be ceded to the Illarawm.

Construct Ossuary of Reikos.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build a great ossuary in Reikos, intended to lay thousands of highborn dead to rest and allow the territory to be rebuilt.

Construct Otkodov spy network.o: In Summer 377YE the Imperial Senate secretly passed a motion, proposed by Morrow and seconded by Hahnmark, to build a spy network in Otkodov at a cost of 10 weirwood. It was intended to gather intelligence on the neighbouring Thule territory of Verthandi.

Construct Ozren Orzel Inspirational Tomb.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by Weirwater's senator and seconded by Astolat's, to commission a self-funded inspirational tomb to Ozren Orzel, exemplar of Pride, in Sandling, Weirwater.

Construct Palace of Flowers.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build a folly, the Palace of Flowers, in Solvihill in Skarsind, and to cede it to the Yerende sept, as set out in the All too well Wind of Fortune.

Construct Parador of Dust.o: The Senate passed a motion to refurbish the Parador of Dust in the Jade Range of Kahraman as a mithril ministry, creating the title Mistress of the Dust Parador. The project drew on an opportunity presented by the merchants of the Brass Coast.

Construct Parador of Salt and Sand.o: In Winter 384YE Bakar i Riqueza, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Parador of Salt and Sand, a mana ministry in Quzar, Madruga, taking up the opportunity presented in the wind of fortune The power behind our moves.

Construct Parador of the Kindled Flame.o: In Summer 385YE Laughlan, Master of the Rings, announced the construction of the Parador of the Kindled Flame, a folly in Siroc, Madruga, intended as an orphanage where Brass Coast children would be cared for and taught their traditions by hakima and kohan.

Construct Path to the Lyceum.o: In Spring 388YE the Arcane Architect, Amalia Vicente, announced the construction of the Path to the Lyceum in Oranseri, Feroz, under the Sound and Vision Wind of Fortune. Once completed, it restored the connection between Oranseri and the Lyceum.

Construct Peak Edge trading enclave.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build Peak Edge, a large self-funded trading enclave in Therunin arranged with the Axou, to allow trade for exotic herbs and resources.

Construct Pegasus Respite.o: In Autumn 383YE Nathaniel of Balthazar's Vineyard announced the construction of the Pegasus Respite, a sinecure in Chalcis Mount, Reikos, to be overseen by a Medical Officer appointed by the Highborn national assembly.

Construct Pelican Tower.o: Achille di Sarvos, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced a self-funded commission in Spring 384YE to build the Pelican Tower, a sinecure in Foracci in Sarvos.

Construct Pilgrim's Trail.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Pilgrim's Trail, a great work of roads across Kallavesa meant to ease the movement of pilgrims and improve attendance at its congregations. The work was later completed.

Construct Pit of Revelations.o: In Spring 383YE a bearer of the Imperial Orc Wayleave, Skywise Laika, announced by proxy the construction of the Pit of Revelations, a mana sinecure in south-west Skogei Glens in Skarsind, creating the Imperial title Marshal of the Pit of Revelations.

Construct Potato Fields of Happiston.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build a mana sinecure in Happiston in the Chalkdowns of Mournwold, creating the title Keeper of the Prosperous Potato Fields of Happiston.

Construct Printers' Guild Bibliopole.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct the Printers' Guild Bibliopole in Betovering and Leerdam in the Commonwealth, making Printers' Guild publications held in Tassato accessible to citizens of nations across the world.

Construct Printers' Guild Mausoleum.o: In Spring 386YE Gustavus Tolski van Temeschwar, Chair of the Wolf, announced the commission of the Printers' Guild Mausoleum in Tassato, a sinecure paid for by the Printers' Guild to create a legacy for its members.

Construct Printers' Guild Museum of Wond.o: The Senate commissioned the Printers' Guild Museum of Wonders, a sinecure in Tassato to house and display the printers' guild's collection of relics and artefacts for any interested citizen to view and research.

Construct Printers' Guild Stadium.o: Taddea Ginori, Chair of the Wolf, announced the construction of the Printers' Guild Stadium, a sinecure in Tassato Regario, home of the Regario Byliners sports team. The materials and labour were provided after the Autumn Equinox 388YE.

Construct Prosperity of Afal.o: Vilkas Blake, bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Prosperity of Afal, a mana sinecure in Ashrook, Upwold, yielding 9 mana per season. He paid the full materials and labour after the Summer Solstice 382YE.

Construct Prosperous Counting House in H.o: In Summer 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Reikos and seconded by Segura, to commission a Prosperous Counting House in Holberg, an edifice intended to add 15 crowns a season to the Virtue Fund.

Construct Prosperous Counting House in K.o: In Spring 386YE Laughlan, Master of Rings, announced the commission of a Prosperous Counting House in Karsk under the Forwards and Rewards wind of fortune. The building was completed, and it now adds 12 crowns to the Virtue Fund each summit.

Construct Proud Quill Parcel.o: A Senate motion announced by the Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, Cormack Dun, commissioned the Proud Quill Parcel, a herb sinecure in Kalpamark, Hahnmark. It was later completed.

Construct Publishing Clearing House.o: Taddea Ginori, Chair of the Wolf, announced the construction of the Great Publishers' Clearing House in Tassato Mestra. It was funded by six great guilds of Tassato and intended to make the city the printing capital of the world.

Construct Quartermaster's ministry.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a mana ministry in Casinea, to be placed in the custody of the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies.

Construct Ratibor's Gate Shrine.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 384YE to consecrate Ratibor's Gate in Temeschwar as an inspirational tomb honouring the exemplar Ratibor of Temeschwar, creating the title Watcher of Ratibor's Torch.

Construct Reapers' Repose.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Reapers' Repose, a sinecure in Melfort, Temeschwar, creating the title of Chatelaine of the Reapers' Repose to be appointed by the League's senators.

Construct Rebellion's Ridge.o: Alfred Eawulfson, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of Rebellion's Ridge in Autumn 387YE, a great work in Boon County, Ore Hills, honouring the leaders of the Ore Hills Rebellion as exemplars of Pride. Once completed, it gave Mournwold's congregations two additional doses of liao each season.

Construct Reckoners Reward.o: In Autumn 379YE the Senate passed a motion to commission Reckoners Reward, a sinecure in Sarvos providing mana crystals and to be held by a new League title, The Book Keeper. The commission was never completed and had lapsed by Autumn Equinox 380YE.

Construct Red Wind Wharfs.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to add the Red Wind Wharfs to the Municipal Docks at Calvos, in Calvos Sound in Madruga. Once complete, the wharfs let armies with the Forayer quality move freely between Free Landing and the mainland.

Construct Reeds Roost.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build Reed's Roost, a self-funded sinecure in Bildewold, Bregasland, that produces mana each season and creates the Marcher national position of Roost's Reeve.

Construct Reikos Counting House.o: The Senate passed a motion at the Winter Solstice 385YE to build a prosperous counting house in Reikos, creating the Highguard national title of Benefactor of High Chalcis to oversee the Gardens of High Chalcis and use their herbs for the virtuous of the Empire.

Construct Reinos Spy Network.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate considered a motion to construct a spy network in the Lasambrian Hills, in the Jotun-held territory of Reinos. The motion failed.

Construct Rhydian Sepulchre Memorial Hos.o: In Spring 387YE the Rhydian Sepulchre Memorial Hospital was commissioned as a sinecure in Winterbourne, Astolat, creating the title of Warden of the Weary. It was later completed.

Construct Ritual School of the White Sha.o: The Civilian Commissioner of the Imperial Orcs approved the construction of a mana sinecure, the Ritual School of the White Shaman, in Pakaanan's Pass, Skarsind, using construction powers delegated by the Senate.

Construct Roads of the Sky.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Spiral and seconded by Astolat, to build the Arch of the Sky, the Southern Skyways and the Bridge of the Air, creating a white granite seat and roads throughout Spiral and Urizen. The work was completed in 387YE.

Construct Root and Stem Apothecarium.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by Mitwold's senator and seconded by Mournwold's, to build the Root and Stem Apothecarium, a Kruidenkenner warehouse in the town of Meade trading specifically in Bladeroot.

Construct Rose Towers.o: In Winter 381YE Sandro Visconti di Sarvos, bearing an Imperial Wayleave, announced a commission to build the Rose Towers in Semmerholm, a sinecure providing 12 doses of liao and 24 Synod votes; the commission passed.

Construct Rose's Respite.o: In Autumn 388YE the Master of Rings, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, announced the construction of Rose's Respite, a self-funded herb sinecure in The Chase in Astolat.

Construct Runeforge in Hahnmark.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Hahnmark and seconded by Sermersuaq, to build a runeforge in Hahnmark as set out in the Snow might fall wind of fortune. The runeforge was completed, and its first Keeper of the Runegrott was due to be chosen at the Spring Equinox 386YE.

Construct Runesmith's Caution.o: In Spring 388YE the Imperial Senate commissioned Runesmith's Caution, a white granite school for Wintermark artisans in Kalpamark, Hahnmark. The sinecure honours Wayland Runesmith's Caution, who died fighting the Druj in Summer 386YE.

Construct Runic Hearth of Adamant.o: In Winter 383YE Sagua i'Ezmara, Master of the Koboldi, announced that the Koboldi would build the Runic Hearth of Adamant, a door to seal the bottom of Lorenzo's Deep Pockets against the trogoni. It was commissioned as a ward under the Stone and stone wind of fortune.

Construct Sakari's Legacy.o: Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, announced the construction of Sakari's Legacy, a rank two fortification in Anduzjasse, Segura, built with Adamant's Aid to be unbreakable.

Construct Sanctuary for Justicars.o: In Spring 384YE the Senate passed a motion, at 70 thrones, to build a sanctuary for justicars on the Isle of the Osseini in Feroz, following the opportunity described in the Bones in the ocean wind of fortune.

Construct Sarcombe Metal Market.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to commission a ministry in Sarcombe, Mournwold, allowing the purchase of metals. It was later built as the Sarcombe Metal Market.

Construct Sarcombe Register.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate considered a motion to commission a folly called the Sarcombe Register in the new market town of Sarcombe, Mournwold, to register orphans and find them new families; the motion failed.

Construct Sarcombe Register II.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 382YE to commission a folly called the Sarcombe Register in the new market town of Sarcombe, Mournwold, to register orphans and find them new families.

Construct Sarcophan Delves Embassy.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Mitwold and seconded by Kahraman, to build an Imperial embassy to the Sarcophan Delves. The embassy was completed in the City of Cargo in Redoubt.

Construct Sarvos Mana Exchange.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Tassato's senator and seconded by Astolat's, to build a mana ministry in Sarvos for buying and selling crystal mana, assigned as a League national position.

Construct Scholars of the Sword Academy.o: Achille di Sarvos, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the self-funded construction of the Scholars of the Sword Academy, a white granite sinecure in the city of Holberg, which was completed after Giacomo Corvinoscuro supplied the materials and money.

Construct Semmerholm Counting House.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Semmerholm and seconded by Temeschwar, to build a Prosperous Counting House in Semmerholm, a folly that increases the Virtue Fund under the Forwards and Rewards wind of fortune.

Construct Seren's Whispering Garden.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build Seren's Whispering Garden, a great work in Miaren meant to harness the Eye of Serenael to boost mana sites and herb gardens. The commission was never built and lapsed by the Autumn Equinox 382YE.

Construct Sergio's Kitchen.o: The Senate commissioned Sergio's Kitchen, a self-funded sinecure providing coinage, to be built in Cigno, Sarvos, under the supervision of an Executive Chef appointed by the League's senators. The motion was announced by Lucrezia Corvinascura, Chair of the Wolf.

Construct Sermersuaq Spy Network.o: In Summer 387YE the Imperial Spymaster, Rahmah i Darwisj i Erigo, commissioned a spy network in Sermersuaq to watch for the growing threat of "the claw", and it was funded after the Summer Solstice.

Construct Shchaslyvyy Outpost Sappery.o: In Spring 386YE Borys Vardovich Strascovich, Boyar of the Iron Roads, announced the construction of the Shchaslyvyy Outpost Sappery, a mana ministry in Ossium, which was funded and completed.

Construct Silver Fox Mines.o: In Summer 387YE a commission was announced to build the Silver Fox Mines, a great work in Locul, Temeschwar, meant to support the territory's businesses and mines. It received only partial funding and had lapsed by the start of the Summer Solstice 388YE.

Construct Skarsind College of Pitfightin.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate commissioned the Skarsind College of Pitfighting, a business sinecure in Skogi, Skarsind, which creates the title of Pitmaster. Palerictus Dura, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced it.

Construct Smith of Ashes.o: Palerictus Krunk, holder of the Imperial Orc Wayleave, announced the construction of a mana sinecure in the Skogei Glens of Skarsind, which will create the Imperial title of Smith of Ashes.

Construct Smokehouse of Atalaq.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion, at 215 thrones, to commission the Smokehouse of Atalaq, a great work in Sermersuaq meant to restore prosperity to the territory's farms and hunters and to let the fourth Wintermark army be raised with a focus on Suaq traditions.
