Construct Smuggler's Cove in Salt Flats.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build a smuggler's cove in the Druj-held Salt Flats of Sanath, following the wind of fortune "An angry blade", to strike at the Druj heartland and improve Imperial intelligence gathering.

Construct Smugglers Cove in Ayereed.o: In Summer 386YE the Imperial Spymaster, Bernard Dugdale, announced the construction of a smugglers cove in the Grendel-held territory of Ayereed. Work was abandoned after mercenaries overran the area that winter, and a fresh attempt was announced in Spring 387YE.

Construct Smugglers Cove in Tromsa.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Smugglers' Cove in Tromsa, along with the funds to pay for it. The cove was later completed.

Construct Smugglers Cove in Tromsa Summe.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a smugglers' cove in Tromsa, proposed by Mel Bleak, Senator for Mournwold, and seconded by Ramos i Inigo i Raqueza, Senator for Kahraman.

Construct Sorrowful Tunnels.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Sorrowful Tunnels, a mithril mine in Gildermark in Skarsind, limited explicitly to the upper levels. The motion was proposed by the senator for Mareave and seconded by the senator for Skarsind.

Construct Spark of Ignition.o: In Autumn 388YE the Senate authorised construction of the Spark of Ignition, a mana sinecure in Whisperwood, Sarangrave, built as a memorial to those who fell defending the territory. It carries the title Lighter of the Forge.

Construct Spider's Dream Bridge.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate passed a motion to repair the Spider's Dream Bridge, damaged as described in the Dreaming in Strands Wind of Fortune. Once the work was complete, Imperial armies could again march quickly between Sarvos and Tassato and Madruga.

Construct Spooner's Rest.o: Under an Imperial Wayleave, Eldrid 'Phoenix Flame' Vestardottir commissioned Spooner's Rest, a liao sinecure in Dunhearth Hall at Wood Heath in Hahnmark, to be held by the Conscience of the Dunnings. It was completed in 388YE.

Construct Spy Network in Forest of Ulnak.o: In Summer 385YE the Imperial Spymaster, Bernard Dugdale, announced the construction of a spy network in the Forest of Ulnak, intended to hasten the destruction of the Druj.

Construct Spy Network in Mareave.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to construct a spy network in Mareave, the Grendel-held territory south of Spiral. Ematius 'Icebreaker' Ankarien, Archmage of Winter, agreed to fund it.

Construct Spy Network in Reinos.o: Imperial Spymaster Bernard Dugdale announced the construction of a new spy network in Reinos, intended to hasten the end of the war with the Jotun on the western front.

Construct Spy Network in Tsirku.o: At the Winter Solstice 387YE the Imperial Spymaster, Rahmah i Darwisj i Erigo, commissioned a spy network in Tsirku, and it was completed once private donors met its costs.

Construct Starlight Drift of Shimmering.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed a motion to build a sinecure called the Starlight Drift of Shimmering Snow in Zenith, producing 9 crystal mana each season. Cato, senator for Zenith, paid the full cost himself.

Construct Statue Commemorating Conquest.o: In Summer 386YE the Mistress of Monuments, Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov, announced a statue at Lomaa in the Galath Fields to commemorate the liberation of Ossium, the first new Imperial territory in 300 years. The statue was completed as the Pride of Ossium.

Construct Statue of Eleonaris.o: In Summer 384YE the Master of the Koboldi, Sagua i'Ezmara, commissioned a statue of the eldritch Eleonaris at the Semmerholm end of the Golden Causeway in Lacuve, celebrating victories won alongside the Knights of Glory. The Senate ceded the folly, and the Queen of the Fields of Glory claimed it.

Construct Statue of Murdered Researchers.o: In Summer 388YE the Mistress of Monuments, Ada Droon Drifting Bough, announced the construction of a statue in Apulus, Spiral, honouring the researchers killed by the Whisper Gallery in their search for the truth.

Construct Statue of Umbar.o: The Mistress of Monuments, Ada Droon Drifting Bough, announced a statue of Umbar Elba Stado in the Lightsea, Madruga, in Spring 388YE, honouring his Pride and his virtuous acts. The statue was completed.

Construct Statue of that Cockscroft Lad.o: The Mistress of Monuments announced the construction of the "Statue of that Cockscroft Lad" in Maiden Downs, Mitwold, celebrating Johnathan Piper of the Cockscroft and memorialising the massacre of the Wayford Wanderers and their supporters. The statue was completed.

Construct Statue of the White Bear.o: In Autumn 386YE the Master of the Koboldi announced a commission for a statue of the White Bear amid the ruins of the Towers of the Dawn in Dawnguard, the Barrens. Once completed, it secured Cathan Canae's favour for the Eastern Sky.

Construct Stockland Bounders Hall.o: In Summer 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Bounders Hall in Stockland, Upwold, creating the title of Bailiff of the Heath, appointed by the Marcher senators. The work was self-funded by prosperous Marcher citizens and has since been completed.

Construct Stone Smith's Workshop.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Mitwold and seconded by the senator for Upwold, to build the Stone Smith's Workshop, a sinecure in the Woldstone in Ashbrook, Upwold. Once completed, it created the Stone Smith position.

Construct Sumaah embassy II.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Upwold and seconded by Necropolis, granting permission to construct an embassy to the Sumaah Republic in Necropolis.

Construct Sweetwater Springs.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Sweetwater Springs, a great work of wells and fountains in Sarvos intended to protect the city against fire.

Construct Swords of Nearweald.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Ossium's senator and seconded by Mournwold's, commissioning the Swords of Nearweald, a fortified barracks in Ossium arising from the Thousands or more Wind of Fortune.

Construct Sylvihrafn Crystal Henge.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 378YE to build the Sylvi Hrafn Crystal Henge, a new sinecure in Skarsind that produces nine crystal mana each season.

Construct Tassato Counting House.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a Counting House in Tassato, a folly that adds to the Virtue Fund under the Forwards and Rewards wind of fortune.

Construct Tekupala's Hives.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to commission Tekupala's Hives, a sinecure in Wittal, Kallavesa, which produces unique drugs. It was built with the permission of Varushka's Keeper of the Bones Hives, whose bees would build the hives.

Construct Temeschwar Counting House.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion, proposed by the senator for Temeschwar and seconded by Kallavesa, to construct a prosperous counting house in Temeschwar that would add 14 crowns to the Virtue Fund each summit.

Construct Temeschwar Mana Exchange.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a ministry in Temeschwar to oversee the purchase and sale of crystal mana, with its title holder to be appointed by the Senators of the League.

Construct Temeschwar Otkodov Mana Exchan.o: In Spring 385YE the Chair of the Wolf, Elsha Bertolf, announced the construction of the Temeschwar Otkodov Mana Exchange, a new ministry in Hanuri, Temeschwar, arising from the Don't blame me Wind of Fortune.

Construct Temeschwar Superlative Citizen.o: Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, Master of Rings, announced the construction of the Temeschwar Superlative Citizen Sinecure, a distillery in Hanuri, Temeschwar, creating the title the Jewel of Anvil. The work was completed, with the title first available for auction at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

Construct Temple of the Way in Nemoria.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Feroz, to build a Temple of the Way in Nemoria, the capital of Asavea. It followed an opportunity tied to the Temple of Balo and the Black Bull.

Construct Temple of the Winds.o: The Senate commissioned the Temple of the Winds in Morrow, a sinecure giving the sword scholars a central spire and permanent home from which to spread their philosophy. The first construction was destroyed by the Druj invasion, but work began again after Peregro was recaptured.

Construct The Gloaming Forum.o: In Winter 385YE a self-funded ministry, the Gloaming Forum, was announced for Operus in Morrow. It creates a new bourse seat, the Gloaming Merchant, able to buy weirwood, following the Bright yellow blooms wind of fortune.

Construct The Legion's Rookery.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 381YE to transform Cardinal Atla's congregation, the Hall of White Ravens, into a great work called The Legion's Rookery in Skarsind. The work was later completed, giving Skarsind congregations a seasonal share of Synod votes and liao.

Construct The Unbound Steel Hall of Lost.o: In Spring 381YE Ella, Daughter of Zemira, of Reumah's Redoubt announced the construction of a Pride museum, the Unbound Steel Hall of Lost Chapters, in Tabernacle in Reikos. She commissioned it using the Senate's construction powers delegated to holders of an Imperial Wayleave.

Construct The Wellspring of Jade.o: In Winter 380YE Lorenzo 'La Volpe', Civilian Commissioner of The League, used his delegated power to commission a sinecure, the Wellspring of Jade, in the countryside of Sarvos, to be funded privately by himself and Giacomo Corvinoscuro.

Construct Thornsong House.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion to construct Thornsong House in Therunin, a unique hospital college honouring the territory's healers and apothecaries and allowing the Empire to research new potions. After two years of donations of weirwood and money, the building was completed.

Construct Three Hands' Stand.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate commissioned a weirwood-producing bourse seat in Holberg at the request of the Sand Fishers, creating the Imperial title of the Red-Eyed Reaper of Three Hands' Stand, to be appointed by League national auction.

Construct Timbermill and Sorting Yard.o: In Winter 386YE the Master of Rings announced construction of the Temeschwar Drovers' Guild Timbermill and Sorting Yard in Vardstein Vale, a great work arising from the Don't blame me Wind of Fortune. It was fully funded and completed, creating the new Vardstein Vandal position.

Construct Tolvoli Slaughterhouse.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Tolvoli Slaughterhouse in Miekarova, a ministry intended to sate the dubik of the territory, following the opportunity offered by the Wind of Fortune "The horror and the wild".

Construct Torfast Trading Post.o: The Senate passed a motion to commission Torfast Trading Post, a ministry in the town of Torfast in Southpine, Skarsind, to repair the roads and open trade with the rest of the Empire. It was completed, creating the Imperial title Bonesetter of Torfast Trading Post.

Construct Tower of the Dragon.o: In Spring 387YE the Master of the Koboldi, Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, announced the commission of the Tower of the Dragon in Nearweald, Ossium, an official residence of the Archmage of Summer that functions as a ministry. It was later completed.

Construct Tower of the Wheel.o: The Arcane Architect announced the construction of the Tower of the Wheel, a sinecure in Tassato built to designs by Richard of Holberg, intended to produce mana from the realms of Spring, Autumn, Winter and Night.

Construct Townsend Treasury.o: In Autumn 385YE Bertrand, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Townsend Treasury, a money sinecure in Sarcombe in the Mournwold. It created the Marcher national title of Town Clerk of Sarcombe.

Construct Trading Hall at Wreck.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 384YE to commission the Trading Hall at Wreck, a self-funded ministry in the East Floes of Sermersuaq, letting the Empire trade food to the Thule for ilium.

Construct Trading Post of Karov.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Varushka approved construction of a trading post in Karov, using powers delegated by the Senate. The motion was raised to take advantage of an opportunity to improve the wealth of Skarsind.

Construct Treasure Ship.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Folly, an Imperial treasure ship named 'Adventure', laden with valuables in the port of Siroc, to be sailed into a ferocious tempest and scuttled as an offering to Rhianos.

Construct Trees and Hills merchant hall.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build a merchant hall in Karsk, the Trees and Hills, to organise refugees from Ossium settling there and to trade forest or mine resources for coin.

Construct Trencher's Shining Ambition.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 387YE to build a great lighthouse, Trencher's Shining Ambition, in West Marsh, Kallavesa, intended to restore Westerhal as a hub of western commerce.

Construct Twilight Demesne.o: In Spring 384YE the Legion Engineer, Palerictus Ka'bal, announced the commissioning of the Twilight Demesne, a mana sinecure in Skarsind to be overseen by a new Curator of the Twilight Demesne.

Construct Vales Might.o: In Winter 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark commissioned Vales Might, a sinecure in Wood Heath, Hahnmark, to produce crystal mana.

Construct Valley of Pride.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Wintermark approved the construction of the Valley of Pride, a herb sinecure in Wood Heath, Hahnmark, which will create the national title Herbalist of the Hearth.

Construct Vallornguard Mustering Ground.o: In Spring 388YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Vallornguard Mustering Ground in Holtford, Miaren, a sinecure offered by the Every path you know wind of fortune. Once it was complete, the Vallornguard could appoint the First Thorn of the Vallornguard.

Construct Vicente School and Orphanage.o: Heliodoro Vicente, Bearer of the First Imperial Wayleave, announced the commissioning of the Vicente School and Orphanage, a mana ministry in Apulian, Apulus, combining an orphanage that trains orphans as reckoners and traders with a mana trading house. It was funded by donations and completed.

Construct Vigilant Shield.o: In Summer 383YE the Senate passed a motion to build a liao sinecure called the Vigilant Shield in Casinea, held by a new Imperial title, the Captain of the Throne Guard, responsible for protecting the person of the Throne at Anvil.

Construct Virtue's Rest.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build Virtue's Rest, a Great Work in Bastion made up of seven pilgrim hostels, one for each Virtue, based on plans drawn up by Philemon of the Chapter of Fulmon's Bounty.

Construct Wanderer's Entertainment Socie.o: In Spring 387YE the Chair of the Wolf announced the construction of the Wanderer's Entertainment Society, a self-funded wealth-producing sinecure in Hanuri, Temeschwar, supervised by a League-appointed Mistress of Festivities.

Construct Wayhouse in Holberg.o: In Winter 387YE Ciapek Splintered Oak, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced the self-funded construction of a Navarr wayhouse, The Splintered House, in Utterlund, Holberg. The wayhouse was later completed.

Construct Wayhouse in Ossium.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Navarr wayhouse in Nearweald, Ossium, to shelter refugees from Therunin and help fund the Navarr army, with the title attached to the Navarr strategos.

Construct Wayward House.o: The Wayward House, a block of apartments in the city of Apulian, Apulus, was commissioned to give hospitality to Jarmish pilgrims of the Way visiting the Empire. It was announced by Paris of Apulus, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, after the Full circles wind of fortune.

Construct Well of Life.o: In Winter 387YE the Senate saw a motion, announced by Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, Master of the Koboldi, to commission the Well of Life, a grand lodge and hospital of the Silver Chalice in Lightsea, Madruga, to be funded by the order itself.

Construct Western Kalsea Spy Network.o: In Autumn 384YE the Imperial Spymaster, Bernard Dugdale, announced a commission to build a spy network in the territory west of Skallahn to strengthen the offensive against the Jotun. The network was later destroyed by the forces of Jarl Ustigar of Kierheim.

Construct Wharfage of Oran.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Wharfage of Oran in Oranseri, Feroz, a sinecure that removed the lawless quality from the Cazar Straits and created the title of Corsair of Oran.

Construct White Roads.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion commissioning the White Roads of Virtue's Path across Bastion, Necropolis and Reikos, great works meant to boost the prosperity of farms and businesses and bring pilgrims to the hostels of Virtue's Rest.

Construct Wintermark beacons.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by Hahnmark's senator and seconded by Kallavesa's, to commission a series of beacons and watchtowers across Kallavesa and Hahnmark.

Construct Wrangler's Market.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate approved a motion to commission the Wrangler's Market in Arbonne, a spy network built under the opportunity described in the No matter what Wind of Fortune.

Construct Wyrding Tower.o: In Summer 388YE the Boyar of the Iron Roads announced the commissioning of the Wyrding Tower, a volhov tower in Livardz, Volodmartz, which was subsequently built and removed the threat of the ashen wind.

Construct Yakholme Grange.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Upwold and seconded by Karov, to construct Yakholme Grange in Stockland, Upwold, a great work to be self-funded by the Marches.

Construct Zemress Naval Academy.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Zemress Naval Academy, also called the School of Blood and Brass, in Madruga, a self-funded institution open to Imperial students for studying and researching techniques of naval warfare.

Construct Zemress seminary.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 382YE to build a self-funded seminary in Madruga honouring the exemplar Zemress and welcoming pilgrims; the Seminary of Zemress was completed after the Summer Solstice 383YE.

Construct Zoria's Maze.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 383YE to enhance Zoria's Maze, the shrine in the vale of Griejezdo in Miekarova recognised as the final resting place of Zoria, Paragon of Wisdom, so that it would house her knowledge and teachings.

Construct a Marcher graveyard in Holberg.o: In Spring 378YE the Senate approved, unanimously and at no cost, a motion to build a Marcher graveyard in Holberg for Marchers who had been raised as husks. The graveyard was quickly completed in Holfried.

Construct a Trade Hub to Axos.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a Trade Hub to Axos in Necropolis, a ministry that trades liao for mana and other materials from Axos.

Construct a reliquary in the mountains o.o: A reliquary in the mountains of Gildermark was commissioned in Summer 381YE as a mana sinecure in Skarsind, creating the title Weigher of Worth.

Construct a road connecting the Thule to.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion to build a road linking the Torfast Trading Post in Skarsind to the Thule, opening a route for trading materials for crystal mana.

Construct an inspirational shrine to Cor.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct an inspirational shrine to Cora Holdfast, exemplar of Loyalty, in High Chalcis in Reikos, serving as a self-funded religious sinecure appointed by the Assembly of Loyalty.

Construct apothecary clearing house in T.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Tassato's senator and seconded by Miaren's, to fund a ministry in Tassato that would buy herbs to supply the Empire's warriors with medicinal potions. The clearing house was later built in Mestra.

Construct butterfly reserve in Miekarova.o: Julianna of Phoenix Reach, holder of an Imperial wayleave, announced the construction of a butterfly reserve in the forests of Miekarova in Spring 381YE, a sinecure producing Iridescent Gloaming.

Construct cargo dock at Caricomare.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate approved construction of a cargo dock at Caricomare in Sarvos, meant to bring white granite from the Asaveans and create a new Imperial Bourse title. Construction began, but all progress was lost when the Grendel invaded Sarvos before the Spring Equinox 380YE.

Construct cargo dock in Cargo.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 380YE to construct a cargo dock in Cargo, Redoubt, so that the Empire could buy white granite from the Sarcophan Delves.

Construct college of magic in Morrow.o: The Senate considered a motion in Winter 378YE to build a College of Magic aligned with the realm of Summer in Morrow, to designs provided by the Eternal Meraud, with its Dean appointed by the Conclave. The commission later lapsed without being completed.

Construct conservatory for the Anvil Hos.o: The Senate passed a motion to build a conservatory in Zenith on the foundation of the retired speaker Origen's herb garden, creating the Senate-appointed sinecure of Origen's Rest to benefit the Anvil Hospital.

Construct expansion of Georgie's House.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to expand Georgie's House, the Kennels of Holfried in Holberg, by acquiring adjacent properties so the business could sell its ratting dogs to clients across the Empire.

Construct expansion to Halls of Knowledg.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to expand the Halls of Knowledge in Peregro with a wing dedicated to researching Autumn magic, but the Druj invasion of Morrow destroyed the Halls and the commission could never be completed.

Construct folly in Afarjasse.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 379YE to build a self-funded folly in Afarjasse in Feroz, dedicated to that location; the folly was later completed.

Construct fortified garrison in Overton.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed a motion, at a cost of 15 Thrones, to build a fortified garrison in the town of Overton in the Mournwold, offering refuge for local citizens and a base for military units.

Construct fortified manor in Liathaven.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 378YE to build a fortified manor at Beacon Point in Liathaven, giving local citizens a place of refuge from raiding.

Construct herbal great work in Skarsind.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a great work in Skarsind, dedicated to those orcs who never got to see a homeland, which would produce True Vervain.

Construct mana ministry in Astolat.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed a motion to construct a mana ministry in Astolat, with its holder appointed for life by the Dawnish Senators, but the commission later lapsed without being built.

Construct mana repository in Morrow.o: At the Spring Equinox 378YE the Senate rejected a motion to build the Phoenix Caverns, a mana crystal facility in Morrow, as a sinecure supplying crystal mana. It failed in principle by 8 votes to 18.

Construct mana sinecure at New Dunhall.o: Breeta Dunning, holder of an Imperial Wayleave, commissioned a mana sinecure at New Dunhall in Hahnmark to harvest the mana crystallising around Lorenzo's Deep Pockets. It was funded with 10 wains of mithril and 20 crowns after the Autumn Equinox 381YE.

Construct memorial at Anvil.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build a memorial to the fallen at Anvil, established as a sinecure, without requesting funding.

Construct mithril mine.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the Senator for Sermersuaq and seconded by Mitwold, to commission a mithril mine exploiting the recent discovery at the Face of Ikka in Suaq Fount.

Construct museum.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed a motion to build a new Imperial museum in Bastion, replacing the museum in Tabernacle in Riverwatch, Reikos, which had been destroyed in the recent fighting.

Construct night mana sinecure in Redoubt.o: In Spring 381YE the Arcane Architect, Vitore van Temeschwar, commissioned a night mana sinecure in Naris, Redoubt. The sinecure, the Penumbral Watcher, creates a new Imperial title appointed by Declaration of Candidacy in the Conclave.

Construct place of pilgrimage in Casinea.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a grand tower of pilgrimage at the Silent Sentinel in Casinea, taking advantage of an opportunity and creating the Imperial title Castellan of the Silent Sentinel.

Construct repairs to Heliopticon.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a commission to repair and rebuild the Heliopticon in Urizen, restoring its central towers in Morrow and Spiral. Once complete, it would create the Imperial title of Doyen of the Spires and let Urizen's magicians work together as a college of magic.

Construct runeforge in Redoubt.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a self-funded runeforge in Limus, Redoubt, on the road between Cargo and the Highguard town of Hedra, with a new title, the Seer of the Spiral Sword, to be appointed through the Imperial Bourse.

Construct sausage shop.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build a Great Work in Holberg honouring the provisioners and victuaries of the siege of Holberg, expanding sausage production and creating the title of Custodian of the Bloody Great Sausage.

Construct seminary in Reikos.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build a seminary in Reikos, set in an artificial lake at the site of the Vigilant Swan, to train Highborn magisters in magic and Virtue and to benefit the territory's mana site owners.

Construct shrine for Britta's body.o: In Winter 376YE the Senate passed a motion to lay the late Empress Britta to rest, with her remains interred in the Kallavesi marshes and her effects in Necropolis, and monuments raised in both places. It also created the Imperial title Guardian of Britta's Shrine.

Construct shrine to Britta.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 379YE to build a shrine in the Kallavesa Marsh celebrating the life and achievements of Empress Britta, whose regalia had been interred in the marshes. The major version of the shrine was completed, creating the Imperial title of Watcher of Britta's Pool.

Construct south west road network.o: The Senate passed in principle a motion to build a road network linking Anduz in Segura with Tassato, running through Madruga, at a cost of 80 wains of white granite and 20 thrones in labour.

Construct spy network in Feroz.o: In Winter 383YE Ka'bal, Bearer of an Imperial Orc Wayleave, announced the commissioning of a special spy network in Feroz, as outlined in the Bones in the ocean Wind of Fortune.

Construct spy network in Ossium.o: In Spring 383YE the Senate passed a motion to construct a spy network in the Varushkan territory of Ossium, to be called the Ossium Watchers.

Construct spy network in Skallahn.o: In Autumn 383YE the Imperial Spymaster, Cayleb of Felix's Watch, announced the commission of an Imperial spy network in Skallahn, the Jotun territory west of Sermersuaq and Kallavesa.

Construct spy network in Spiral.o: In Spring 384YE the Imperial Spymaster commissioned a unique spy network in Spiral, to be built at the Spire of Oblivion's Edge and ceded to the Night eternal Sung. During scrutiny the Constitutional Court spotted a potential problem and raised an administrative motion for the Senate to deliberate at the Summer Solstice.

Construct spy network in the Mountains o.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Casinea and seconded by Redoubt, to build an Imperial spy network in the Mountains of the Moon, the independent territory east of Zenith that Axos calls the Valley of Silence.

Construct spy network in the Sarangrave.o: In Summer 383YE the Senate passed a motion to commission an Imperial spy network in the Sarangrave, a Druj-held territory in the Mallum.

Construct statue of Janon.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the League approved the construction of a folly to the Eternal Janon in Hanuri, Temeschwar, intended to encourage good relations.

Construct summer sinecure.o: The Arcane Architect announced in Spring 382YE that they would use their power to commission a self-funded summer mana sinecure in Reikos, which would create the Imperial title Keeper of the Cox when completed.

Construct the Azure Chorus.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Azure Chorus, a congregational sinecure in Braydon's Jasse in Kahraman, funded by Lorenzo la Volpe.

Construct the Blood Red Roads.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion commissioning the Great Work "The Butchers Benevolence: The Blood Red Roads", a road network to improve trade and transport at the heart of the Empire. It was to be overseen by Lorenzo La Volpe and self-funded by the Bloody Butchers Guild of Temeschwar.

Construct the Celesti Lighthouse.o: The Civilian Commissioner of the Brass Coast announced a commission to invest 16 wains of mithril in a lighthouse in Feroz, to be called the Celesti Lighthouse, but the commission was never authorised.

Construct the Celesti Lighthouse II.o: In Winter 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the Brass Coast approved the renovation of the lantern of the lighthouse at Oran in Feroz, creating a Freeborn ministry able to buy mana directly from ship captains.

Construct the Colossus of Sarvos.o: The League's Civilian Commissioner commissioned the Colossus of Sarvos, a great work in the city of Sarvos celebrating its liberation and commemorating citizens who fell defending it. It was completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 380YE.

Construct the Deep Place.o: The Senate passed a motion to construct the Deep Place, mine workings in the mountains of Brez in Volodmartz, creating the ministry of the Bredavoi Emissary to aid the cabalists of Void and keep watch over their doings.

Construct the Dour Fens.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the Marches approved the construction of a mana sinecure in Graven, Bregasland, to be known as the Dour Fens.

Construct the Dreaming Spire.o: In Summer 387YE the League's Red Raven Holdings commissioned the Dreaming Spire on Mount Cinnius in Ankra, Spiral, as a gift to the Urizen. The edifice houses the Omphalos of Urizen and the Library of Solen's Doubt, and it was completed by the end of 387YE.

Construct the Eternal Flame of Miaren.o: In Winter 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Navarr commissioned the Eternal Flame of Miaren, a sinecure producing mana crystals in Seren, Miaren, using construction powers delegated by the Senate.

Construct the Five Cities Military Acade.o: In Autumn 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Five Cities Military Academy, a folly in Tassato Mestra. Once completed, it raised the number of armies the League can support to three.

Construct the Gardens of Pallas.o: Juliana of Phoenix Reach, Civilian Commissioner of Urizen, commissioned the Gardens of Pallas, a herb sinecure in Zenith, in Autumn 380YE using the commissioning power delegated by the Senate.

Construct the Gardens of the Grim.o: A Senate motion proposed creating a herb-producing sinecure in Miekarova called the Gardens of the Grim, held by a title named the Grim Gardener. The motion failed.

Construct the Gates of Holmauer Park.o: The Gates of Holmauer Park, a great work securing the eight gates of the Park in Holmauer with mithril and providing a small garrison of guards, magicians and priests, was commissioned in Autumn 385YE and has since been completed.

Construct the Glass Point Cove.o: The Glass Point Cove, a mana sinecure in Uccelini, Sarvos, was commissioned in Summer 381YE by Dalibor Marek do Saverio Von Temeschwar using the construction powers of an Imperial Wayleave, and was subsequently built.

Construct the Glorious Fountain of Dusk.o: In Winter 378YE a Senate motion proposed building a self-funded sinecure, the Glorious Fountain of Dusk and Dawn, in Morrow to produce crystal mana. Its keeper would be appointed by the Urizen senators.

Construct the Golden Fields.o: In Autumn 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the Marches approved the construction of a mana sinecure, the Golden Fields, in Hay in Golden Downs, Mitwold, creating the title of Keeper of the Golden Fields.

Construct the Great Chain of Sarvos.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate commissioned a fortification in Sarvos, later renamed the Great Chain of Sarvos, to protect the territory against naval attack, drawing on the Parents of Security Wind of Fortune.

Construct the Great Library of Hacynian.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Great Library of Hacynian, a self-funded folly in Mourning Hollow, Summersend, on the ruins of the ancient library of Phaleron. It had been approved by the Conclave through a Declaration of Concord.

Construct the Greenwatch.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 385YE to construct the Greenwatch in Casinea, a ministry arising from the Rain King wind of fortune that creates the Highborn national title of Greenwatcher.

Construct the Hanging Fruit Gardens of G.o: In Autumn 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of Navarr approved the construction of the Hanging Fruit Gardens of Gerondi, a great work in Serenael, Miaren, to provide herbs; the commission later lapsed by the Autumn Equinox 381YE.

Construct the Hearth of Virtue.o: Nikolovich Drakov used an Imperial wayleave to commission the Hearth of Virtue, a seminary sinecure in Perumaki, Miekarova, intended to show Varushka's dedication to the Way.

Construct the Hearth of the Tempest.o: In Autumn 379YE the Senate passed a motion to build a folly called the Hearth of the Tempest in Mieriada, Miekarova, to be given to the Spring Eternal Papa Otec to run as a college of Spring magic at no ongoing cost to the Senate.

Construct the Lakesedge Highway.o: In Autumn 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Lakesedge Highway in Holberg, linking the Holmauer Gate to Misericorde through Rebeshof and creating the Imperial title of Rebeshof Roadwarden.

Construct the Ministry of Industry and S.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build the Ministry of Industry and Skarsind Trade in Temeschwar, as part of the greater Torfast ministries, intending to improve the wealth of Skarsind. It was completed as the Northern Traders Guild in Temeschwar city proper.

Construct the Northern Way.o: In Summer 388YE the Master of Rings, Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, announced the commission of the Northern Way, a great work in Apulian to build a safe passage between the city and the territory of Zenith, funded by the Crimson Reapers.

Construct the Park of Holberg.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 380YE commissioning a Great Work to clear the ruins of the Holmauer in Holberg and build a park in their place, funded by the citizens of Holberg. Holmauer Park was completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 381YE.

Construct the Phoenix Flame.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate passed a motion to commission the Phoenix Flame, a sinecure in Astolat, and to create the title of Tender of the Phoenix Flame. The work followed the Back in town Wind of Fortune.

Construct the Pilgrim's Rest.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 380YE to construct the Pilgrim's Rest, a sinecure in Kallavesa Marsh, creating the title of Crow Keeper of the Rest.

Construct the Red Depths.o: The Senate passed a motion to commission the Red Depths in Kahraman, a mithril-producing Brass Coast National Bourse seat, funded by the citizens of the Brass Coast in line with the Landscape Wind of Fortune.

Construct the Salt Guard.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Madruga's senator and seconded by Feroz, to build the Salt Guard, a unique fortification in Siroc designed by the famed architect Menno van Ritsjhof. Its labour costs were set at 80 Thrones.

Construct the School of Hard Knocks in T.o: In Autumn 385YE the Senate was presented with a motion, announced by D'ardante as Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, to build the School of Hard Knocks in Temeschwar using 20 wains of white granite. The project was funded and completed, creating a new League title.

Construct the Signori d’Argento Vineyard.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion to create the Signori d'Argento Vineyards in Foracci, Sarvos, a planting of fine Catazarro wine cultivars overseen by a new League national position.

Brother Dagon of the Shattered Tower, holding an Imperial Wayleave, announced the construction of the Signori d'Argento Vineyards in Sarvos, following an earlier motion to build them that had been abrogated.

Construct the Skarsind School of Warcast.o: In Summer 380YE the Civilian Commissioner of the Imperial Orcs approved the construction of a mana sinecure, the Skarsind School of Warcasting, in Estermark, Skarsind, using construction powers delegated by the Senate.

Construct the Stones from Blood.o: In Autumn 385YE the Senate passed a motion to build Stones from Blood, a mana ministry in Therunin intended to support the Navarr vates council, with its holder expected to take an oath.

Construct the Story Garden.o: In Winter 387YE the Master of Rings announced the construction of the Story Garden, a sinecure at Belletain in Weirwater, whose Apothecary provides potions to virtuous Dawnish citizens in exchange for stories of their virtuous acts.

Construct the Tassato Mana Exchange.o: The Senate passed a motion to commission the Tassato Mana Exchange, a ministry in Tassato arranging the purchase of mana crystals. It was later completed in Mestra.

Construct the Tenebrous Path.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion to construct the Tenebrous Path, a sinecure in Hercynia's Old Ranging that produces mana crystals and carries the Navarr national title Wisdom of the Tenebrous Path.

Construct the Thorned Rose.o: In Summer 382YE a Senate motion proposed building the Thorned Rose, a place of learning just outside Seren in Miaren, to teach prospective vates and creating the Imperial title of Dean of the Thorned Rose as a mana sinecure.

Construct the Triosk Metal Exchange.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 385YE to commission the Triosk Metal Exchange in Triosk, Volodmartz, a ministry seat arising from the Deep forests and dark hills Wind of Fortune.

Construct the Weaver's Market.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to construct a mana ministry in Skarsind, "the weavers' market", through which crystal mana could be purchased. The office was to be a self-funded Imperial Orc National Bourse position.

Construct the expansion of Spiral Castle.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Astolat's senator and seconded by Tassato's, to expand Spiral Castle in Weirwater so that its Castellan could resupply armies in the territories adjacent to Weirwater.

Construct the market town of New Dunhall.o: The Senate passed a motion to build New Dunhall, a market town and coin-generating sinecure near the ruins of Dunhall in Hahnmark, as a first step in rebuilding after Dunhearth Hall was lost to a recent collapse.

Construct theatre in Temeschwar.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build a great theatre in Temeschwar celebrating the city's Pride, taking advantage of an opportunity from a recent period of inspiration; it was completed as the Bloody Great Theatre shortly before the Spring Equinox 381YE.

Construct tomb for Empress Giselle.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 380YE to move the body of Empress Giselle to Temeschwar and build her a tomb there, overseen by a new League title.

Construct trade hub in Upwold.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion to build a trade hub with the Faraden in King's Stoke in Upwold, to strengthen economic and diplomatic ties between the Empire and the Faraden.

Construct vale in Karsk.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion to build a new vale on the site of Ivarsgard in Lestazny, Karsk, as a self-funded folly proposed by Karsk's senator and seconded by Hahnmark's.

Construct venom brokerage.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to build a brokerage in Miaren supplying herbs, blade venoms and Scorpion Stings for the fight against the vallorn, with its broker appointed by the Navarri senators.

Construct village expansion in Volodmart.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Volodmartz and seconded by Karsk, to build a village expansion housing the growing vigilant population of a virtuous mine in Volodmartz, functioning as a money-producing sinecure.

Construct walls of Holberg.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Holberg and seconded by Tassato, to raise the walls of Holberg city to double their effectiveness. It was carried at a cost of 150 thrones and was believed to be taking advantage of an opportunity.

Contact the Lasambrian orcs.o: At the Spring Equinox 378YE the Senate passed, unopposed, a motion to open diplomatic contact with the Lasambrian orcs, seeking their withdrawal from Segura and an alliance against the Jotun.

Conversion of Overton Garrison.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion to convert the Overton Garrison in Overton, Mournwold into a sinecure, The Sheriff's House, to curb banditry and raiding on the Mournwold mines and reclaim ore.

Conviction.o: In Winter 379YE the Highborn preacher Golan the Wanderer began preaching in war-ravaged Reikos that the First Empress was an exemplar of Courage, making Courage the pre-eminent Virtue, and that she would be reborn only when the Empire embraced it. The Synod's responses failed to check him, and Courage congregations across Highguard swelled at the expense of the other Virtues.

Cost.o: In Spring 385YE eleven Imperial armies drove the Druj from the Bitter Strand, the Saltmarsh and the Plains of Teeth and stormed the Spires of Dusk, but the victory cost the Empire the Dawnish army the Hounds of Glory, which was destroyed winning it.

Crafted from torment.o: With the conquest of Ossium complete, the first new Imperial territory in decades, the civil service set out the case for assigning it to each Imperial nation. The Senate gave Ossium to Varushka and recognised the Sand Fisher orcs as foreigners.

Create Chair of the Wolf.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 384YE giving the Holberg Guild of Engineers permission to expand their premises and creating the League national title of Chair of the Wolf, appointed by Tally of the Votes.

Create law of delegation protection.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed a law granting legal protection to barbarian delegations that arrive at Anvil under a flag of peace, protecting them as citizens for the duration of their visit.

Create law of protection for humans in M.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion granting humans of the Mourn, excluding the Feni, full protection under Imperial law, giving them the same legal standing as foreigners.

Create title Custodian of Ivarsgard Dock.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 382YE creating the Imperial title Custodian of Ivarsgard Docks, designating part of the Ivarsgard docks on the Semmerlak as a herb ministry for cerulean mazzarine.

Create title of Ambassador to the Thule.o: The Imperial Senate passed a motion in Spring 381YE creating the title of Ambassador to the Thule, appointed by Senate vote, to take advantage of a recent diplomatic opportunity. Juha, the Cave Spider of Varushka, was appointed as the first ambassador.

Create title of Keeper of the Breadbaske.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed a motion creating the Marcher national title of Keeper of the Breadbasket, giving its holder custody of the Imperial Breadbasket great work and the decision over whether its granaries and storehouses support the Mournwold or the Imperial armies.

Create title of Quartermaster General of.o: In Autumn 377YE the Senate created the Imperial title of Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies, holding the Senate's power to authorise the resupply of armies, after being told a great work in Miaren could not provide automatic emergency resupply.

Crimson and green.o: In Winter 387YE the roused Tharunind vallorn turned from western Therunin and swept over Druj-held Eastring, claiming the region, while the Druj burned Thornsong House after its Night ward failed, leaving its apothecaries fleeing west towards Reikos with orcs in pursuit.

Crossroads.o: In Summer 379YE a conjunction of fate and chance settled over the Empire. Runecasters, astronomancers and League players all saw signs of crossroads and fateful choices, and the conjunction made divinatory magic harder while easing rituals that carry decisions already made.

Crow on the cradle.o: With the Thule withdrawn from Branoc and Crowslook, the Charnel Lord of the Broken Hill prepared to return to slumber and offered his Varushkan followers to the Empire, either to enlarge an existing Varushkan army or to restore the Iron Helm. The Senate chose to rebuild Karsk's ruined roads and restore the Iron Helm.

Crowned in rose and heather.o: In Autumn 383YE the Constitutional Court ruled that Imperatrix Lisabetta and Imperial Magus Juha, who vanished on the second night of the Summer Solstice, were legally dead or resigned, leaving both titles vacant. The page set out opportunities for the Senate and Synod to mark her legacy.

Crusade.o: In Winter 379YE, with Dawn's fourth army nearly mustered and Barrens orcs attacking the Towers of the Dawn, Dawnish ambition to conquer the Barrens revived. The Dawnish national assembly backed a crusade, but the enthusiasm faded by season's end.

Culling the threat.o: The Prognosticator Naomi of Virtue's Rest, appointed by the Imperial Auditor at the Senate's request, laid out options for ending the Druj threat to Echofell and the Drownbark Forest in Ossium. Meanwhile a Druj force accompanied by heralds of Surut moved to destroy Marshstand Skerry.

Cup of choices.o: After the Navarr chose to share their knowledge of fighting the vallorn with Urizen, four months of joint work in the Urizen territories produced several proposed opportunities. They included a mana great work in Redoubt, the rebuilding of Sunspire, a new Citadel Guard technique, a fortified wayhouse in Sarangrave and Arhallogen's final offer of a fane.

Cuttings.o: In the winter of 379YE, eight babies born in Upwold over three months showed unmistakable briar lineage from birth, something practically unheard of; all trace back to Tower March, and nobody yet knows why.

Damming the Doubt.o: In Spring 387YE, preparations were made to dam the River Doubt in Apstrus to relieve the aridity of Icarion. The Varushkan, Imperial Orc, League and Urizen assemblies all acted on the graves of the fallen at Solen's Doubt, and the Conclave granted amity to the eternal Ylenwe so that zie could aid the project.

Dark skies.o: In Spring 380YE the heavens grew disturbed: a tiny new star was seen trailing the Wanderer, the constellation of the Phoenix began to fade, and the night skies over Skarsind and Holberg became entirely empty save for the moon, while cases of mania continued to rise across the Empire.

Darkest night.o: Shortly after the 380YE Autumn Equinox, the Empty Skies phenomenon spread to blot out the stars over every Imperial territory, plus Liathaven, the Mournwold and Brocéliande, leaving only the sky within a mile of Anvil unchanged. A powerful shroud now hampers scrying, naga find their secretive urges greatly strengthened, and a Wintermark circle has stepped forward to aid the Imperial Seer.

Daughters of the Empire.o: Elkiah's Autumn 383YE statement calling for Empress Britta's neglected shrine in the Necropolis to be repurposed stirred Highborn priests to propose rededicating it to the virtue she best inspired, alongside a proposed memorial to forgotten soldiers and an invitation to the architect Frederick di Sarvos to design Empress Lisabetta's tomb. After the Winter Solstice, Britta's memorial was rededicated to Courage.

Daybreak in Spiral.o: In Summer 387YE the Dawn Chorus, a feathered guardian of the Eternal Ylenwe, settled at the ruined spire of Solen's Doubt in Spiral to protect those who would dam the River Doubt. Further opportunities arose to found a Dreaming Spire at Urizen's omphalos, and the Silver Flame rebels asked for access to Imperial Lore.

Daylight fading.o: Varushka completed the Iron Roads and the port-town of Kostjyas Respite in Spring 385YE, boosting prosperity across its territories and making a fourth Varushkan army possible. Meanwhile an envoy of the Charnel Lord, Tasya of the Black Feathers, walked the new roads with requests and offers, and an Assembly statement about sapient creatures caused confusion in the vales.

Dear green space.o: After the Wisdom Assembly sent Hembeneth i Guerra with liao to seek a practical answer to Skathe's curse on Holmauer Park, Wise pilgrims gathered in Holberg and produced rival proposals: cleanse and restore the park, or accept and exploit the curse.

Death is not the end.o: In Summer 381YE the schism over Yael of Highguard's claim to be the reborn First Empress deepened: seven nations had denounced her while Highguard and Dawn had embraced her, and armies on opposite sides could no longer fight well together. At the Summer Solstice the Dawnish assembly resolved its uncertainty by repudiating Yael.

Death leaves us homesick.o: In winter 387YE the civil service reported on Imperial relations with Axos. The Axou welcomed the Sarangrave treaty but flatly refused any part in waking the Visokuma vallorn, arrested the Scions of Cavan for plotting to rouse it, turned cold towards the Navarr, and asked to collect Fintan Nighthaven's remains.

Death of a salesman.o: The Bourse private auction collapsed after years of poor returns, rumours of a price-fixing cartel and the excommunication of the Pledge's owners, so the civil service cancelled it for the coming summit. Instead, several private sellers announced their own sales and appeals at Anvil.

Declare Feni group to be foreigners.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Bregasland and seconded by Kallavesa, declaring the Feni tribe known as "The Woods That Fell" to be foreigners.

Declare Mournwold thralls foreigners.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 381YE designating the orc thralls living in the Imperial territory of Mournwold as foreigners under Imperial law.

Declare Ossium orcs as foreigners.o: The Senate passed a motion declaring the orcs of Ossium who are not Druj, the former tribes the Druj had subjugated there, to be foreigners in Imperial lands.

Declare peace with Barrens orcs.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate declared the three orc tribes occupying the Barrens, formerly subservient to the Druj, to be foreigners rather than barbarians under Imperial law, in the hope of opening negotiations with them.

Declare peace with Lasambrian orcs.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed a declaration of peace with the Lasambrian orcs, making them foreigners under Imperial law, on the stated condition that they return the occupied regions of Segura in exchange for 62 wains of Weirwood, Mithril or White Granite.

Declare peace with Orcs of the Great For.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Casinea and seconded by Necropolis, granting the orcs of the Great Forest of Peytaht the legal status of foreigners under Imperial law.

Declare war on the Barrens orcs.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion declaring war on the orcs of the Barrens, who had launched a surprise attack and were besieging an Imperial fort, so they were no longer protected by Imperial law as foreigners.

Decommission Ossium spy network.o: In Winter 383YE the Imperial Spymaster, Cayleb of Felix's Watch, announced that the spy network operating in Ossium would be decommissioned.

Decommission Verthandi spy network.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to decommission the Verthandi spy network, at a cost of five Thrones from the Imperial treasury.

Deep blue sea.o: In Spring 388YE the Black Thorns, Argent Sword and Wolves of War retook Siluri and Naris as the Grendel abandoned Redoubt, carrying off kidnapped Urizen scholars and craftsfolk. Meanwhile a Grendel and Asavean armada descended on Calvos Sound to catch the Red Wind Corsairs, only to find they had already sailed south and landed at Oran in Feroz.

Deep forests and dark hills.o: Varushka's completed Iron Roads, Autumn magic and a National Assembly statement encouraging internal trade set off a wave of prosperity, opening several commission opportunities in Varushka and boosting trade across the Northern trade network.

Deep when the river's high.o: In Summer 384YE the Marcher armies and the Imperial Orcs' Winter Sun tried to drive the Jotun out of Bregasland but were beaten back through Grey Fens and defeated at Ottery, losing Ottermire and with it the territory. Two Sentinel Gate conjunctions were also offered: one to protect House Greywater's resistance and one to recover the shield Oath-Heart.

Define Jarmish embassy.o: In Winter 378YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the Imperial Civil Service, asking the Principalities of Jarm to build their Imperial embassy in the port city of Rigia in the eastern Principalities.

Delirium.o: In Summer 384YE an Imperial raid destroyed the bandit town of Isember in Karsk, uncovering an Elder plaguewulf, while a huge Druj host invaded Ossium, destroyed the Tower of the Scorpion and conquered the Echofell.

Desolation of Yoorn.o: Wither the Seed, a potent Winter curse cast by Navarr magicians on Liathaven and Brocéliande, began sapping the fertility of both territories while lulling the vallorn into quiescence. This forced hard choices on those who lived there and drew an offer from the Thrice-cursed Court to take Liathaven.

Desperate affairs, desperate measures.o: In Autumn 381YE, Imperial captains led by the Freeborn defeated a surge of Grendel pirate raids in the Bay of Catazar. They protected the fishing fleet without losing a single boat and evacuated the several thousand people of the Isle of Zemress. The Freeborn Assembly then encouraged the Zemress Islanders to settle in Segura.

Despise treachery.o: Following a Senate motion, the magistrates swept through Bregasland and punished those who had collaborated with Mathilda Fisher and the Jotun. Order was restored, but the purge left deep grudges across several regions, while the mortally wounded Fisher Queen was carried to Anvil to meet her fate.

Diadem on my brow.o: In Autumn 387YE Emperor Vesna addressed every citizen of the Empire, declaring that the time had come to destroy the Druj and conquer their lands. The Emperor called on all citizens to stand with them through the sacrifices ahead.

Digging for fire.o: After the Conclave asked the Order of the Golden Pyramid to explore Mareave, its magicians found a newly discovered minor wonder in Nadir, rich mines in the northern hills, and the chance to stay on in the territory or build a grand lodge there.

Disburse funds for Astolat ministry.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed a motion requesting funds for a mana ministry in Astolat, with the expenditure approved at 40 Thrones.

Disburse funds for Farstrider's Watch Sp.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to disburse 80 Thrones of Senate funds to pay for materials to build Farstrider's Watch, a fortification on the Greensward in the Mournwold.

Disburse funds for Iron Helms III.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Karsk and seconded by Hahnmark, to disburse 200 thrones towards completing the Iron Helms army in Karsk, Varushka.

Disburse funds for Pilgrim's Trail.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion disbursing 18 Thrones to purchase resources for constructing the Pilgrim's Trail great work in Kallavesa.

Disburse funds for Summer college.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 379YE disbursing 100 Thrones towards the continued construction of a College of Magic focused on Summer rituals.

Disburse funds for The Towerjacks.o: In Autumn 379YE the Senate passed, in principle, a motion to disburse 350 thrones to the Senator for Holberg to continue building the Towerjacks, a League army.

Disburse funds for mithril research.o: In Winter 377YE the Senate passed a motion to fund research by the Provost of the Halls of Knowledge into increasing mithril production in Redoubt, approving 34 thrones but rejecting the extra 10 thrones to place the findings in Imperial Lore.

Disburse funds for rebuilding of Holmaue.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Holberg and seconded by Karov, to disburse funds for rebuilding the Holmauer, following an earlier motion to construct a park there. It passed at 100 thrones.
In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Holberg's senator and seconded by Tassato's, to disburse 75 thrones for the rebuilding of Holmauer in Holberg.

Disburse funds for resupply III.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Bregasland and seconded by Mitwold, to disburse 250 thrones of Senate funds intended to resupply the Imperial armies.

Disburse funds for resupply IV.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by the senator for Feroz and seconded by the senator for Kahraman, to disburse funds for resupplying the Imperial armies. It was passed at 115 thrones 4 crowns.

Disburse funds for strategic rituals.o: The Senate disbursed Imperial funds to Urizen senators so that crystal mana could be bought for strategic rituals benefiting the Empire and its armies. Redoubt received 25 Thrones in Spring 378YE and Morrow 95 Thrones in Autumn 378YE.

Disburse funds to Bregasland.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed a motion disbursing 200 Thrones to Orrick, Senator for Bregasland, to be used to resupply the Imperial armies; a further 400 Thrones followed in Autumn 378YE.

Disburse funds to Grendel raiders.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed a motion to pay the Grendel 300 thrones so that they would not invade or sack any Imperial territories on the Bay of Catazar that season.

Disburse funds to Miekarova militia.o: In Winter 378YE the Senate passed a motion granting 26 thrones to fund a militia in Miekarova to crush the anarchy cultists troubling the territory.

Disburse funds to Thanmir Hrafn.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a motion disbursing 100 thrones to Thanmir Hrafn to buy materials for building cargo docks to trade with the Sarcophan Delves.

Disburse funds to aid Liathaven citizens.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed a request for funds to send an aid package to Liathaven, proposed by Kallavesa and seconded by Therunin, with 10 thrones approved.

Disburse funds to citizens of Skarsind.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion to allocate funds to the Wintermarkers affected by the gifting of Skarsind, recognising their Loyalty, Pride and Prosperity.

Disburse funds to the Jarmish Cartel.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate passed a motion approving the Jarmish Cartel and disbursing funds to it. The cartel sought exclusive trade with the newly opened eastern Jarmish port in return for releasing its contracted slaves within a year.

Disbursement of funds for College of Eng.o: The Senate passed a motion to disburse funds to complete construction of the Adamant College, the College of Engineering and Architecture, in Temeschwar, following an earlier disbursement motion for the same project.

Disloyal, unprosperous, unvigilant, unwi.o: In Autumn 380YE Friar Alyn of Hay, Mitwold, toured the Empire urging citizens not to sell their treasures to Imperial Bourse agents for the Private Auction, after the Synod's excommunication of four citizens over a Private Auction purchase. Early reports showed the Private Auction's prospectus significantly reduced.

Dispatch prospectors to the Pride of Ikk.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to send prospectors to the Pride of Ikka's Tears, the mithril mine in Sermersuaq, to explore whether it could be expanded.

Disseminate True Liao visions.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion, at 10 thrones a season, to distribute the Seer of the Gateway's accounts of True Liao visions across the Empire and to every nation the Empire trades with. Foreign reactions to the resulting volumes of Echoes of the Labyrinth ranged from enthusiasm to outrage.

Distant deeps.o: In Spring 381YE the Temple of Balo and the Black Bull in Oran, Feroz, was completed and opened to Asavean sailors and merchants, and the Plenum allowed work to begin on a temple of the Way in Nemoria. Freeborn unease about the temple's influence persisted, and the Synod was offered several possible mandates in response.

Distribute food to the thralls of Mournw.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion to distribute 75 thrones' worth of food to the thralls of the Mournwold, then held by the Jotun.

Dog days are over.o: After the conquest of the Barrens was completed, Dawn's jubilant people launched a year of celebratory tourneys known as the Grand Tour. The wind also offered opportunities to build a school of music in Weirwater, restore the Castle of Thorns' throne room and raise a church at Hope's Rest.

Doing it.o: In Spring 387YE Barien, the Iron Duke, set two new challenges for those receiving the Challenge the Iron Duke ritual: an arena fight against dire astacids handled by Beoraidh gladiators, and a stealth hunt through a forest of spider heralds lent by Jaheris.

Domain expansion.o: With their highest calling complete and the Imperial Breadbasket now covering all four Marcher territories, the Marchers were offered new ways to build on it in Autumn 388YE: forges at the Singing Caves, a Marcher-held Quartermaster General and a Synod claim on Liathaven. A broken scrying map of Liathaven and an Imperial Orc demand over the dead of Grave Wood complicated matters.

Don't blame me.o: After the Autumn Equinox 384YE, Ratibor's Tomb at Ratibor's Gate in Temeschwar was consecrated to Ambition with true liao. The consecration spread a ruthless, unsentimental Ambition through the League and opened several opportunities, including mandates, great works and a campaign against the Vyig.

Double dare.o: After the Freeborn Bounty in Segura paid out without any fighting, the Freeborn Assembly was offered the chance to extend it to armies attacking the Grendel in occupied Feroz. Corsairs spurred by a narrowly passed Synod mandate also identified four possible raid targets against the Grendel and asked the Assembly to choose one.

Double or nothingness.o: After the Senate banned the sale or gifting of liao to the Iron Confederacy, the Silent Bell uncovered a liao smuggling route from southern Feroz into Kalino, Dumon's Hand sought a lawful way to keep receiving liao, and priests divided over whether the Empire should support the Suranni rebel magicians at all.

Down along the cove.o: In Summer 381YE, years of Spring and Night magic in the Bay of Catazar caused a boom in sea life, giving Imperial fisherfolk the chance of bumper catches while drawing independent Grendel captains eager to raid them. Imperial fleets were offered the chance to protect the fishing fleet for one season.

Down that road.o: In summer 384YE the Lasambrian Jotun consolidated their hold on Gambit and captured Jade Range in Kahraman, leaving the exhausted defenders of Fort Braydon clinging to the northern hills. A major conjunction offered the Empire a chance to stop the orcs crippling the hill roads and to strike at Stephen of Sarcombe.

Down the cavalier road.o: In Autumn 384YE the Summer eternals' attitudes to the Empire shifted: Eleonaris was mollified by her statue, Jaheris rewarded his tourney champions, and Hayaak turned furiously against the Empire to back the Jotun. Lady Nimue de Moraine also opened an opportunity for Dawn to win up to five Summer eternals as patrons of the Eastern Sky.

Drain the flooded streets of Caricomare.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed in principle a motion from the senator for Sarvos to rebuild the docks of Caricomare, sunk thirty years earlier by a terrible storm. The work was paid for and completed, making the flooded district habitable again and creating the title of Mayor of Caricomare.

Draw strength from vulnerability.o: After the Dawn National Assembly sent the Earl of Fools to preach that true Love and true Glory arise from the seven Virtues, Dawn saw a resurgence of interest in True Love. The wind also brought new laurels for the Champions of Love and Glory, a proposed statement of Love and Glory, and plans for a monument called the Arbor of the Twin Roses.

Dream on.o: The Navarr completed the Temple of the Waking Dream in Seren, Miaren, and Seren became known as the City of Dreams. New dreamspeakers emerged with two rival visions for the nation's future, each calling for a decision at the Autumn Equinox.

Dream to me.o: Six eternals answered the Imperial archmages' Winter Solstice plenipotentiaries ahead of the Spring Equinox 386YE. Eleonaris, Wise Rangara, Sinokenon and Lashonar offered meetings or encounters, while Siakha and Estavus declined to parley and made offers directly to Imperial magicians.

Dreaming in strands.o: Commissioned by the Senate at the Autumn Equinox, Eilian Sweetwater of the Department of Historical Research recovered Carmen i Dehasa i Erigo's original blueprints for the damaged Spider's Dream bridge. He set out a costed repair alongside several long-rejected historical proposals that the Senate could add to it.

Dredge the Westmere.o: In Autumn 385YE the Senate passed a motion to dredge the Westmere at Meade March in Mitwold, creating a mithril ministry in Meade and an ilium ministry in Fisk, Kallavesa, as offered by the Butterfly in Reverse wind of fortune.

Dressed in smoke and fire.o: Following the Hag Queen's curse that shattered its mirrors, Sarvos completed its transformation into the City of Masks, lifting the doom over the city. Fires at Caricomare reshaped the Mayor of Caricomare title, magic settled on many Sarvosan masks, a Summer Solstice masquerade was proposed, and Genia Bourné offered a Brokers Office for buying magical schemas.

Drinking song for the socially anxious.o: With the Empire steeped in Autumn's power after the Spring Equinox, a host of traders, heralds and foreign visitors made their way towards Anvil for the Summer Solstice, each seeking trade, patronage or conversation with Imperial citizens.

Drive back.o: The Empire held back the vallorn of Brocéliande for another season, but the vates warned that its final and strongest surge was imminent. Meanwhile, the reclamation of the Westwood in Liathaven revealed a pristine weirwood forest that could become a new Bourse seat.

Drowned in tears.o: The Civil Service's Autumn 387YE diplomatic briefing covered the Asavean Archipelago, the rebellious satrapy of Ibaria and the Sumaah Republic. It set out Asavea's continuing war with the Empire, options to arm Ibarian rebels, and a Sumaah gift of aid for the Brass Coast that needed Imperial escorts.

Drumbeat of war.o: In Summer 386YE the Asavean Plenum, at war with the Empire and enraged by Imperial missionaries spreading the Way, carried out its threat to put a bounty on ships trading with the Empire, while the Synod and Conclave committed to further missionary work in Asavea.

Drums beat in my head.o: In Winter 384YE, displaced Freeborn netrigger Ottilie i Malune i Erigo and the parador masters of Cerevado proposed building new ilium nets on the Scorrero rapids in Segura. The nets would catch the river's ilium upstream of the Grendel-held Scorrero Nets in Feroz and deny it to Governor Rahab.

Dusty old dust.o: A Winter 381YE survey of the Empire's dealings with foreign human nations reported rising liao prices, a Sumaah delegation coming to negotiate peace, unrest in Asavea, and a growing Faraden trade presence after the Upwold enclave was completed. It also noted that the Iron Confederacy port of Robec was opening to Imperial captains.

Dying light.o: A potent twentieth-magnitude Winter curse fell on Bastion in Winter 379YE, bringing sleet, hail and a creeping malaise of doubt and despair that sapped faith in the Virtues and the paragons.

Each age a lens.o: In Winter 387YE five orc nations and groups engaged in diplomacy with the Empire. A new Jotun–Wintermark Meeting Place was completed and the Jotun proposed a feast to set rules of war. The Grendel, Morajasse and Beoraidh sent messages and offers, and the Druj threatened to unleash the vallorn of Béantal Dol.

Easy come, worth less.o: Four statements of principle upheld by the Highborn Assembly at the Spring Equinox 382YE spread through Highguard's congregations with mixed results. Spider-jar fears came to nothing, Urizen refugees mostly declined sanctuary but received aid, and costly mandates on the Druj and the vallorn were laid out as opportunities.

Eat like kings.o: Meraud, the Summer eternal, recovered from his crisis thanks to the sacrifices made by Imperial magicians, and set out how rituals drawing on his power would now work and the rewards he offered to those who had helped him.

Eclipse.o: Through Winter into Spring 386YE, Imperial armies and warbands fought the armies of Cold Sun's scions across the Empire. They destroyed the Blade of Skies, Still Walkers, Exigent Span, Fire Beacon and Winnowers, while the Shepherds of Ash were devoured by a dark power beneath Volodmartz.

Eight for a wish.o: After Emperor Vesna ratified the Vallornguard, an Imperial sodality dedicated to destroying the vallorn, the Civil Service helped citizens join it. Nations and the Constitutional Court set out ways to support or empower it, and two conjunctions against vallorn-touched Druj were offered.

Empty handed.o: A collection of opportunities arose around the Autumn Equinox of 381YE: a Marcher brought a mysterious Autumn-magic crystal to Anvil, Earl Celeste of House Magot offered Circe's Necklace to Dawn's troubadours, and the Brother of Wizards offered a lost herald's aid to the tea-houses. Great Forest Orc traders, a Varushkan Winter Market and an economics conference also came to Anvil.

Empty skies (winds of magic).o: In Autumn 380YE the starless night skies first seen before the Spring Equinox continued to spread, darkening Sermersuaq, Volodmartz, Karsk, Miekarova and the Barrens as well as the territories already affected. The page also recorded the sudden return of the fading Phoenix constellation and the dispersal of the mysterious fog over the northern Bay of Catazar.

Enchanted.o: Ahead of the Winter Solstice 384YE, a round-up of magical matters faced the Imperial Conclave: a spreading Winter blight in Madruga, unpredictable chaos fruit gathered in Brocéliande, and a string of follow-ups to Autumn Equinox declarations.

Enlargement of The Black Thorns.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed a motion to enlarge the Navarri army the Black Thorns to a large army, taking advantage of an opportunity presented during the retaking of Liathaven.

Equivocate the past.o: The Lepidean University in Bastion was completed, adding a seasonal dose of true liao to the Virtue Fund and awaiting its first Lepidean Librarian. Meanwhile, a new sodality pressed for Ruth of Highguard's recognition, and the Vyig kidnapped two Heirs of Lepidus in Temeschwar.

Establish Cerevado Nets.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 384YE to establish a new Brass Coast Bourse seat at Cerevado in Segura, using nets and traps to collect ilium from the Scorrero river.

Establish contact with Barrens orcs.o: In Summer 378YE the Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by Skarsind's senator and seconded by Sermersuaq's, to send Winged Messengers to the unaligned orcs of the Barrens and invite them to send a delegation to Anvil.

Even darkness must pass.o: In Autumn 387YE the Empire fought a chaotic, magic-soaked campaign in the Sarangrave, claiming Kroll, holding Bloodwater Marsh against six Druj armies and retaking Lustri in Zenith. Rebel former slaves seized the Nesustak Forest for themselves.

Every day of your life.o: After the Imperial Orc Assembly's judgement calling for an Assembly of the Ancestors, the Constitutional Court advised that the Constitution leaves no room for such an assembly. Instead, the Imperial Orcs were offered several other ways to honour and learn about the ancestors.

Every path you know.o: After the Navarr National Assembly declared support for the Vallornguard its highest calling, Navarr responded with urgency, opening opportunities to share their expertise with other nations and to build new works in Miaren and Hercynia to aid the sodality against the vallorn.

Every time it rains.o: In the summer of 384YE a three-month drought struck the Empire and blighted farm harvests, while a rare conjunction of the Wanderer, the Fountain, the Stallion and the Lock empowered rain, water and storm rituals during the Summer Solstice. Certain curses and enchantments cast on Casinea would spread across every Imperial territory.

Everything has a price.o: In Winter 383YE, after the Senate ratified a peace treaty recognising the Grendel as foreigners, the Grendel offered the Empire a series of trade opportunities: an open port at Oran, a mithril-for-weirwood market, a grand embassy and paid searches for enslaved citizens. Some citizens called for an embargo instead.

Everything has rhythm.o: Before the Spring Equinox 382YE, the civil service listed nine sets of Sentinel Gate conjunctions offering Anvil's heroes chances to act across the Empire. They ranged from frenzied soldiers in Spiral and Jotun scouts near a mithril mine to Feni raiders, risen husks, vallorn regio and a Druj slave camp.

Everything is broken.o: After the Hounds of Glory died capturing the Spires of Dusk, the Dawnish in the Barrens rose in open revolt against the Druj, ending the Empire's careful plans to arm them first. The Military Council was offered a Sentinel Gate battle at the Merigionne Estate that could win the Barrens, along with several smaller conjunctions.

Everything is on show.o: In Summer 388YE the League's third army, raised in Tassato and named Sparrows Reckoning by Senator Cesare Sanguineo Rezia Di Tassato, neared the end of its training, and Cesare was asked to choose its quality. It became a Resourceful army.

Everything is trying to kill us.o: After the Senate assigned the Sarangrave to Urizen, the nation faced a host of obstacles to making the Druj-scarred swamp a prosperous territory. The Urizen Assembly was given the opportunity to direct one named archetype each season, by a statement of principle upheld with a greater majority, to investigate one of these problems.

Excavate Gildenheim Runeforge.o: In Winter 383YE the Senate passed a motion confirming the runesmiths of Wintermark as rightful heirs of the Gildenheim runeforge, allowing its ruins to be excavated and moved to Runegrott in Hahnmark.

Excavate Holberg Embankment.o: In Winter 385YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the Citizens' Voice, to excavate a deep embankment in front of the Walls of Holberg, as described in the opportunity from "The greatest city in the world" Wind of Fortune.

Expand Academy of Arms.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion commissioning the expansion of the Academy of Arms in Siluri, Redoubt, creating the title Prelate of Adelmar's Shrine. The work was completed, and the Assembly of Ambition was to appoint the first holder at the Summer Solstice.

Expand Breadbasket into Mournwold.o: The Senate passed a motion in Spring 388YE commissioning the Mournwold expansion of the Breadbasket great work, along with the Keeper's Cottage sinecure in Maiden Downs, Mitwold, following the Search high and low Wind of Fortune.

Expand College of Warcasting.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by Skarsind's senator and seconded by Weirwater's, to expand the Warcaster College of Skarsind, giving its Preceptor custody of a ministry and changing how the title is appointed. The opportunity arose from the Tired of sleeping Wind of Fortune.

Expand Mana Ministries.o: In Spring 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Tassato and seconded by Astolat, to fund upgrades to the mana ministries in Tassato, Sarvos and Temeschwar. The upgrades would expand how much crystal mana the Conclave grandmasters can buy.

Expand Pride of Ikka's Tears Autumn 387Y.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 387YE to expand the Pride of Ikka's Tears mithril mine in Suaq Fount by sinking a deep shaft and galleries, funded directly rather than through a commission.

Expand the Kruidenkenner Magazjin.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a motion to expand the Kruidenkenner Magazjin at Crown's Quay in Necropolis. The expansion was completed shortly before the Winter Solstice 383YE and gave several Imperial ministries access to herbs bought from the Sarcophans.

Exploit Tassatan Hills.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate approved funding to exploit the hills above Tassato, creating a new ilium-producing bourse seat assigned as a League national position chosen by a Tally of the Votes of business owners. The project was completed after the Spring Equinox 385YE.

Extend Iron Roads.o: In Spring 384YE the Senate passed a motion, at a cost of 128 thrones, to extend the Iron Roads project into Ossium and to request the funds needed to do so.

Fade out again.o: Spurred by mandates in the League and Varushkan assemblies, magistrates and their allies purged the Vyig from the League and Varushka in Spring 385YE, uncovering their bite-smuggling links with the Druj. Meanwhile the Rod and Shield cleared the Hag Queen's beasts from the woods of Metri.

Faded from the winter.o: In winter 383YE the Heirs of Terunael and their Yaw'nagrah-aligned allies, beaten back in Hercynia and Therunin, were left exposed, and the Silent Bell's findings opened opportunities to strike at them. The Senate chose to have magistrates root out the cults of Yaw'nagrah within the Empire.

Fading like a Flower.o: As Winter 385YE approached, the blight completed its consumption of Madruga's Great Grasses, now called Blightheart, and the region slipped from Imperial control, while three rune-marked Harbingers led gatherings of Dry Patricians and Parched to the borders of Segura and Kahraman. The page set out options for the Conclave, Senate, Synod and Military Council to respond.

Fair play is turnabout.o: In Spring 387YE the City of Locks, under Basileia, offered the Empire a costly, long-term opportunity to arrange the assassination of Salt Lord Seonag of the Grendel, set up a standard contract system for Imperial title-holders to name their bribery price, and sent letters offering espionage and help to destabilise the Asavean Plenum.

Fair share of labour.o: At Emperor Vesna's request, Magistrate Abraham of the Constitutional Court appraised the implications of making the Imperial Guild of Artisans an Imperial sodality, setting out the powers and titles it would gain and the groups offering support if the Senate ratified it.

Fake empire.o: Naomi of Virtue's Rest of the Prognosticators Office delivered the appraisal the Senate commissioned at the Autumn Equinox. It described how the Grendel Salt Lords Council works and set out possible ways to disrupt the salt lords and their foreign allies.
