Falcon in winter.o: In Winter 379YE, Thane Dogri Thulebane and his self-proclaimed Skarsind Loyalty Congregation rejected the handing of Skarsind to the Imperial Orcs. They fortified Crow's Ridge and declared it still part of Wintermark.

Fall of Brocéliande.o: After a year-long vallorn surge into Boar's Dell and Elerael was weathered, the Brocéliande vallorn was left weakened, opening a window until the Autumn Equinox 384YE to clear Dark Ranging with Imperial armies. Several allied proposals to strengthen the Navarr in Brocéliande were also put forward.

False kings.o: In Spring 384YE Bregasland was quiet: the Jotun held their ground in the western fens while the Strong Reeds lay low, but Mathilda Fisher's campaign for an independent Bregasland began drawing disaffected Bregas to her Yegarra.

Famine and feast.o: Six eternals replied to the Imperial archmages' plenipotentiary messages. The Lictors, Ossegrahn, Sung and Blood-on-the-Snow arranged meetings at Anvil, while Rhianos and Kimus declined parley but offered boons; in the end the Conclave asked Ossegrahn for a college proposal, and the Blood-on-the-Snow parley never took place.

Farewell wanderlust.o: In Summer 385YE the Wintermark Net and Vine's Autumn enchantment, the Bounty of the Brilliant Broker, swept across the Imperial territories. It brought windfalls, new trade opportunities and rare deepstones, but its clash with the lingering Spring magic of the Hallow of the Green World twisted farm and forest produce.

Farm, fur, and fish.o: At Wintermark's request, the Imperial Senate commissioned Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra to appraise how Sermersuaq's untapped natural wealth could raise its prosperity and its contribution to the Empire. She returned with proposals covering trade, new great works and sinecures, and cost-cutting. The page also gave notice that the Icebarn Twins would emerge during the Summer Solstice.

Fate and function.o: In Summer 385YE the completed Crucible of Fate in Iteri dispelled the Druj miasma and the despair hanging over Zenith. Guided by an Urizen Assembly mandate favouring practical and effective work, it began transforming the territory and Urizen's economy.

Fear quickens the breath.o: After the Envoy to the Karass met Anka Karass, relations between the Empire and the Barrens sept advanced markedly, and the Karass came forward with three offers: a joint scouting venture against the Thule in the Forest of Ulnak, a request that the Last Battle Wayhouse be ceded to them in return for scouting services, and a potion trade.

Fearful symmetry.o: In Spring 381YE fierce storms lashed the coasts of Spiral and Redoubt, and a magical storm mirroring them settled over Redoubt itself, wrecking roads and bridges and blocking the main pass on the Cargo Road. Armies crossing Redoubt were slowed until the Northern Eagle repaired the routes over two seasons.

Fight.o: In Spring 382YE, Sister Meredith of the Marchers and Bloodcrow Losak of the Imperial Orcs led a mission to preach the Way of Virtue to the Jotun thralls living in the Mournwold. The thralls showed genuine interest at first, but then grew agitated and angrily rejected the sermons for reasons no one could discover.

Fight or flight.o: In Winter 382YE the civil service reported to the Senate on how Morrow might be evacuated in the face of a Druj invasion. Alongside this, Urizeni magicians proposed repairing the Heliopticon so that their spires could act together as a college of magic, and the Senate commissioned the repair of the towers in Morrow and Spiral.

Fight with monsters.o: After the Wintermark Assembly upheld Gunnbrand Ironwill's final mandate committing the Mark to the path of the hero, Wintermark's armies permanently adopted honourable tactics against the Jotun and gained new heroic orders. Both the Fist of the Mountains and the Green Shields were offered, and took up, new army qualities.

Fighting fish.o: In Spring 386YE the Loyalty assembly upheld Brother Luke's judgement acknowledging the Loyalty of the late Bregas poacher Bushel Sykes while challenging the Empire to earn its citizens' Loyalty, turning Sykes into a romanticised folk hero and drawing wider attention to the assembly.

Figure of eight.o: After nearly a year of review following the collapse of the trial of the 'peaceful Four', the Constitutional Court replaced the Synod's judgement of condemnation with a new judgement of proscription. Under it, the General Assembly defines which specific acts count as religious crimes, and the magistrates then enforce those definitions directly.

Figures from the past stand tall.o: In the winter of 386YE Reikos was beset by a surge of restless ghosts from the Empire's wars against the Druj, and a conjunction opened to the Gardens of High Chalcis so that a hundred Imperial citizens, led by the Highborn stewards of the dead, could lay them to rest.

Finding is the final act.o: Following religious judgements in the Vigilance, Highborn and League Assemblies, opportunities arose in Winter 387YE to root out the Grendel espionage ring in Sarvos, survey the Bay of Catazar for spy rings, and build new Imperial spy networks, while the Whisper Gallery offered a treasonous way to exploit the ring instead.

Fire and the flood.o: In Winter 387YE five Imperial armies pressed the Druj in Thornfen and the Tower of the Skink while also turning back a fresh Druj attack out of the Salt Flats, ending three-tenths of the way to capturing Thornfen. The Axou Shield of Ipotavo joined the assault from the south.

Fire on fire.o: In Winter 384YE the Empire liberated Zenith after trapping seven Druj armies there; the fleeing orcs were cut down in Lustri, and Imperial forces then retook Proceris and Occursion and cleared much of the Druj legacy.

Fit and proper.o: After the Conclave kept Rivers Run Red interdicted yet instructed the Voice of the Quiet Forest to cast it on Therunin, the Freeborn magician Camila i Erigo of Kahraman proposed a new Declaration of Endorsement allowing the Conclave to approve specific uses of interdicted rituals or items.

Five flames.o: Faraden remained caught between the Empire and the Asavean Archipelago in Spring 388YE, pressing for closer trade with the Empire while the Synod's proscriptions on Vengeance troubled its faithful. Its authorities also crushed the Cinders extremists and arrested an Asavean merchant accused of funding them.

Fixing What is Broken.o: Three years after Imperial curses devastated the Mournwold, Marcher threshers grew uneasy that the Conclave might lift its interdiction on Rivers Run Red, and two competing Synod mandates were proposed. One would urge lawful action against sorcerers; the other would back threshers acting by any means necessary.

Flames and the dark.o: After six months of occupation, the Grendel were driven from Redoubt, leaving surprisingly little general damage but having looted arcane equipment and texts and devastated the Tower of Light and Shadow on the Tilphussian Reach. Four eternals offered ways to restore the regio, and the Conclave accepted Phaleron's proposal.

Flight of birds.o: The mystics of Ishal, having divined how Wintermark might raise a new Kallavesi army to replace the destroyed Fist of the Mountains, asked for a Witan to direct their next appraisal. They also revealed two rival opportunities to rebuild a ruined hall in the Sovevann.

Fly high.o: In Winter 381YE the League celebrated the completion of the Blood Red Roads, the Grand Park of Holmauer and Lorenzo's Legacy of Virtue monoliths, opening opportunities for a garden city in Holberg, an expanded Imperial Menagerie and new mana exchanges, while a new narcotic called Bite spread among the bravos of the League cities.

Focused and methodical.o: Master architect Frederick di Sarvos answered the Cardinal of Ambition's Statement of Endeavour by offering four ambitious, white-granite-heavy proposals for Imperial centres of learning. The Senate could commission only one, and none was raised that Winter.

Fog on the brine.o: In Autumn 379YE a strange, faintly glowing magical fog rose without warning from the Bay of Catazar, blanketing the northern half of the Bay and lingering with no sign of dissipating.

Foggy mountain top.o: A season of strange magic swept the Empire: the stars returned everywhere except the Barrens and Semmerholm, the Halls of Knowledge vanished from Zenith and reappeared in Peregro, and Richard of Holberg published designs for three magical structures. Several eternals also stirred, from new emissaries and boons to the mysterious withdrawal of Murit and Soghter.

Folklore.o: Following the Autumn statements of principle urging the Empire to embrace them, the Free Folk planned a pilgrimage across the Imperial nations. The Synod was offered several ways to shape it and was told they would not become citizens until one of their Divine Family was recognised.

Follow me my friend.o: In Spring 387YE five Imperial armies marched from Segura into Jotun-held Reinos. They conquered Ribeira and took most of Bastasor, while the Fist of the Mountains brought along ghouls raised from the tombs of Tassato.

For the Common Good.o: In Summer 386YE the Commonwealth, locked in war with Jarm over Lantir, sought Imperial mercenaries, mana and a new embassy while voicing deep pessimism about the Liberty Pact. The Senate commissioned a fortified Commonwealth embassy, a diplomatenschloss, in Necropolis.

For those in peril on the sea.o: Prognosticator Eilian Sweetwater delivered a Senate-commissioned appraisal on restoring the great lighthouses of the Bay of Catazar, after a symposium in Sarvos attended by a herald of the eternal Kimus. He set out plans for standard and great lighthouses, proposals to restore or fortify the Celesti Lighthouse in Feroz, and an offer to spend a year studying six more sites.

Forests of the night.o: At the Winter Solstice, Urizen's Coven of Umbral Reflection and Spire of the Auric Horizon laid the Wondrous Forests of the Night across the Empire. The enchantment boosted every forest's production, stirred Night regio and eternals, and brought vivid dreams to the Empire.

Forever is composed of nows.o: In Winter 387YE, with the Prognosticator's Office stretched thin, several opportunities were set out to support it. They included Mladen Escovitch's offer to revisit old fortification plans, a choice of three candidates to stand in for the missing Eilian Sweetwater, and a new power for the Throne to have proposed sodalities appraised.

Forge of sorrows.o: A Winterfolk band sent by the civil service to explore collapsed Thule tunnels beneath the runecarved cave of ice at Gildenheim, in Skarsind, discovered an ancient, damaged runeforge that the Thule had been trying to repair.

Forging links.o: Escorted by nearly a hundred Imperial captains who drove off an Asavean armada, the Sumaah Stone Fleet delivered white granite and liao to Feroz to help rebuild the Brass Coast. Sumaah also questioned the value of further Liberty Pact meetings and offered a single joint magical appraisal with the Empire.

Fortify Ateri in Spiral.o: In Winter 377YE the Imperial Master of Works approved completing Fort Mezudan, a partially built fortification at Ateri in Spiral. The fort was finished but was later destroyed by a magical storm in Autumn 379YE.

Fortify Coursmouth.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build a coastal fortification at Coursmouth in Necropolis. Once the commission was completed, it produced the fortification Reumah's Rest.

Fortify Delev.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Karov's senator and seconded by Volodmartz, to build a fortification completing the walls around the town of Delev in Duzekani, Karov. Once funded and completed, the walls became known as The Little Boyar's Welcome.

Fortify Foracci.o: In Autumn 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Sarvos and seconded by Tassato, to build a fortification in Foracci, Sarvos. Once complete it would be a rank one fortification named "Our Lady of Pride".

Fortify Freemoor.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build a fortification in Freemoor in the Mournwold. Once fully funded with materials, the fort was completed as Landskeepers Bulwark.

Fortify Gildenheim.o: Groza, the Legion Engineer, announced a commission to fortify Gildenheim in Gildermark, Skarsind, with a rank one fortification bearing runic wards offered by the Tamazi, as set out in the Standing in the sun wind of fortune.

Fortify Golden Downs in Mitwold.o: In Winter 377YE the Imperial Master of Works approved the construction of a new fortification, Forte Fidelis, at Golden Downs in Mitwold, using the power to raise fortifications granted by the Senate.

Fortify Greensward.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build a new fortification named Farstrider's Watch in the Greensward region of Mournwold, to be funded by the Imperatrix.

Fortify Lestasny in Karsk.o: In Spring 381YE the Senate passed a self-funded motion, proposed by the senator for Karsk and seconded by Miekarova, to commission a fortification in Lestasny, Karsk.

Fortify Lower Tarn Valley.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed in principle a motion accepting the Great Forest Orcs' offer to build a weirwood fortification, the Holt of the Oak, in the Lower Tarn Valley of Therunin. Too little weirwood was supplied, and the commission lapsed at the end of the Autumn Equinox 382YE without being built.

Fortify Lower Tarn Valley II.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion to recommission the Holt of the Oak, a weirwood fortification in the Lower Tarn Valley of Therunin, after the original motion lapsed. The fort was to be built, garrisoned and controlled by the orcs of the Great Forest.

Fortify Lustri.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion to build a fortification in Lustri, Zenith. After donations from many citizens it was completed as The Stork's Gaze, a fortification of 3000 strength.

Fortify Miekarova.o: In Winter 378YE a Senate motion sought permission to raise a new, unnamed fortress in Miekarova to guard against possible threats from the Northern Barbarians, but the motion was defeated.

Fortify Miekarova II.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate considered a self-funded motion, proposed by the senator for Miekarova and seconded by Karsk, to raise a fortress named Grimhold in the Perumaki region of Miekarova. It followed a failed attempt to fortify the territory in Winter 378YE.

Fortify Morajasse.o: In Autumn 382YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Feroz and seconded by Mournwold, to commission a new fortification at Morajasse in Feroz; it was later completed.

Fortify Overton.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to build a new fortification, Orchard's Watch, at Overton in Mitwold. It was completed after Bridget Eastville of the Marches supplied all the white granite needed.

Fortify Reikos.o: In Winter 380YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Bastion and seconded by Upwold, to build a fortification at Broken Ride in Reikos, taking advantage of an opportunity there.

Fortify Ruicraic's Redoubt.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 387YE to build a fortification at Ruicraic's Redoubt in Eoradal, Mareave, acting on an opportunity identified by the Tamazi sept in Autumn 386YE. Once fully funded, it was completed as a rank one fortification.

Fortify Skogei.o: In Summer 377YE the Senate commissioned a fortification at Skogei in Skarsind to reinforce the Imperial foothold there, and the motion was amended in Autumn 377YE to upgrade it. Built with white granite supplied by the Senator for Hahnmark, it was completed as the Will of the Wintermark, known as Hengesthal.

Fortify Southmoor.o: A Senate motion to build a fortification in Southmoor in the Mournwold was proposed in Autumn 381YE but failed.

Fortify Spider's Dream Bridge.o: In Spring 386YE the Senate passed a motion to fortify the Spider's Dream Bridge, the crossing that links Torres in Madruga with Bocche in Sarvos, taking up the opportunity offered by the Dreaming in Strands Wind of Fortune.

Fortify Tassato.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Tassato and seconded by Feroz, to build a new fortification called the Rezia Redoubt in Tassato Mestra. It was passed at a cost of 250 Thrones.

Fortify Town defences.o: In Winter 376YE the Senate passed a motion to fortify towns in the League, the Marches and Highguard, and the White Granite later supplied partially fortified Meade, Sybela and Mellfort, which suppressed banditry in those nations.

Fortify Vigilant Swan.o: The Senate passed a motion in Summer 386YE to fortify the Vigilant Swan, a White Granite bourse seat in Riverwatch, Reikos, with the aid of the Manse of the Lionsmith, under the Metal and Stone Wind of Fortune.

Fortify multiple towns.o: In Spring 377YE the Senate passed a motion from Upwold's senator to fortify three towns or regions of the Empire over Spring and Summer, with the senator for Upwold choosing the sites. Work in Miaren, Karov and Semmerholm left Seren, Delev and Lacre only partially fortified.

Fortify the Ore Hills.o: In Winter 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Upwold's senator and seconded by Hahnmark's, to complete a half-built fortification abandoned by the Jotun in the Ore Hills of Mournwold. The fortification was named The First Step.

Forward into depthless dark.o: In Summer 388YE five Imperial armies, aided by the Northern Eagle's groundwork, conquered Lower Saarnath in the Salt Flats of Sanath. The Citadel Guard's Technique of the Transcendent Claw then left the Beacon of Iskrid in Leen devastated but still standing.

Forwards and Rewards.o: Following a Urizen Assembly judgement thanking the Varushkan boyars for a wayleave that helped build the Gardens of Pallas, Urizeni priests proposed ways to permanently boost the Imperial Virtue fund. Alongside these came proposals for herb-funded Imperial titles in Zenith and Reikos and a monument in Mitwold, while the Civil Service confirmed that magistrates' fines now go to the Imperial treasury.

Four and four.o: In Summer 385YE several eternals reached out to the Empire: Barien, Janon, Kimus, Lashonar, Siakha, Tharim, Ylenwe and Zakalwe sent heralds, offers, challenges and problems, including Sentinel Gate conjunctions to Sarangrave and Mitwold.

Four strong winds.o: In Summer 383YE, statements passed at the Spring Equinox, mostly by the Freeborn National Assembly, opened a series of opportunities across the Brass Coast while Jotun and Grendel invaders threatened its territories. The Senate went on to commission the Iron Qanat and the House of Guerra, and the Assembly backed privateering and the defence of Segura.

Free to live.o: In Spring 382YE the Zemress Islanders, rescued from the Grendel by a Freeborn-led armada, were raising hundreds of farms in Segura's Sobral Grasses and Yellow Chase. They proposed great works to improve their new home, while disputes over tribal heritage and doctrine stalled their integration into the Brass Coast.

Friend of mine.o: In Winter 386YE the Sumaah Republic braced for an all-out Asavean naval strike intended to raze one of its cities, as Siroc had been razed. Imperial fleets had the chance to prevent it, while the Sumaah also responded to Imperial diplomacy on the Way, magic, gifts and a proposed pilgrimage to Holberg.

Friendly rivalry.o: In Winter 378YE, a friendly rivalry grew between the Imperial Orc armies of the Summer Storm and the Winter Sun as their military units fought side by side. Preacher Atla answered it with a statement of principle in the Imperial Orc assembly praising the Winter Sun, boosting the morale of its units.

Froggy went a'courting.o: Ahead of the Winter Solstice 381YE, delegations from the Thule, the Grendel and the Great Forest orcs were expected at Anvil, as the three-year Thule peace treaty neared its end and the Thule massed armies in Krevsaty and the Silver Peaks. No new Thule treaty was agreed, and the Grendel's peace offer was rejected.

From the sieve of your hands.o: After the Senate ceded Ankra, Ateri and Cinion in Spiral under the Grendel peace treaty, Grendel armies claimed the whole territory. Salt Lord Mahiri Kaliact offered the remaining Urizen spires a light-handed rule if they cooperated, and the Urizen Assembly later enacted a mandate urging them to do so.

Full circles.o: The Sevenfold Path continued fighting Cold Sun in Jarm and made a major gift of liao to the Convocation of Virtue, a loose Jarmish fellowship of Way followers. The Convocation proposed a pilgrims' house in the Empire, which was later commissioned in Spiral as the Wayward House.

Full of sacred sound.o: Victories over the Druj in Zenith and the Empire's blow against slavery stirred a wave of Pride across Highguard in Winter 384YE. The Wind of Fortune changed how Highborn armies fight and offered the Highborn National Assembly three mandates that could all be enacted together.

Fund the Academy.o: In Spring 377YE the Senate passed a motion granting 5 Thrones to the Academy to train the Empire's next generation, with the money paid out to Bastion's senator.

Germinating a city.o: Commonwealth scholars led by Professor Gelberg, acting for Gisli Baerson of Wintermark, reported that Siroc could never be rebuilt and proposed the Municipal Docks at Calvos to help the town grow into a great city. The wind also covered Commonwealth relations, the unused Beurteilung auction and the League's welcome to Commonwealth visitors.

Gifts of a green mother.o: In Winter 386YE a herald of the enemy eternal Yaw'nagrah answered the Spring Archmage's plenipotentiary with a range of boons for Imperial magicians. Because she is under the Conclave's enmity, accepting any of them was a serious crime unless that enmity was lifted.

Given and denied.o: In Spring 384YE the Empire's armies, fighting alongside three Thule armies under the new alliance, drove the Jotun out of East Floes and pushed deep into Suaq Fount. The Jotun held on at the Pride of Ikka's Tears and sealed Pakaanan's Pass.

Glass and flame.o: Eight Imperial armies, backed by Summer realm champions, marched from Lucksprings into Feroz in Autumn 386YE and liberated Oranseri, Fontargenta and Afarjasse from the Grendel, conquering the territory. The Grendel fortress of Mora's Rock held out in Morajasse.

Goatfoot.o: In autumn 380YE the Krampus, a curse-dispensing spirit linked to the Wintermark egregore, was revealed as the shaggy beast haunting Pakaanan's Pass in Skarsind after months of mutilated mammoth corpses. It began shouting a message to the Imperial Orcs, inviting them to its camp above the Clattering Gulley.

Golden Sails.o: In Summer 379YE a Grendel war fleet, the Golden Winds, arrived off southern Feroz escorting a diplomat sent by Salt Lord Suriad to negotiate with the Empire at Anvil over continued Imperial raiding of Grendel ships in the Bay of Catazar.

Golden Trumpets.o: In Winter 379YE, golden trumpets rang out from the air at places connected to Summer magic across the Empire, and a voice proclaimed that the eternal Meraud challenged Imperial wizards to create and perform arcane projections. The coven performing the highest-magnitude ritual before the start of the Summer Solstice would win a boon.

Golden light.o: After the Assembly of Ambition backed Prince-Bishop Estella Lucati's call to truly consecrate Capodomus Cathedral in Sarvos, the civil service set out what a Synod mandate from the General Assembly consecrating the cathedral's Atrium of Golden Light to Ambition would achieve. The consecration was a proposal awaiting that mandate.

Golden magicians fayre.o: In Spring 387YE a Dawnish weaving of Summer magic, lasting six months rather than one season, drew heralds of almost every Summer eternal except Hayaak into Dawn's four territories. They brought personal boons, rival offers and proposals, and a pervasive urge towards splendour and pride.

Good apples.o: After rumours spread that Good Walder's ghost had appeared at Anvil, an old apple copse near Hay in the Golden Downs of Mitwold, long said to mark his grave, burst into miraculous fruit. The friars of Hay proposed honouring the site with a folly, a larger shrine sinecure or an inspirational memorial.

Good as gold.o: Professor Immanuel Gelberg's Commonwealth scholars, commissioned through the Beurteilung by Nekoda of the Shattered Tower, published their appraisal of the River Couros after Gelberg himself was abducted by Grendel raiders. They proposed a great work, the Visitors Docks of Hedra, to channel pilgrim donations to congregations along the river.

Good faith.o: In Autumn 379YE the Grendel sent a letter from High Lady Suriad declaring that the Imperial children they had taken hostage would not be released but would instead be put to work in the salt, ending hopes that they would honour their earlier promise.

Good old smooth red wine.o: After the Cardinal of Prosperity, Darian Numbers, directed the Prosperity assembly's attention to Astolat at the Summer Solstice, the seneschals and visiting pilgrims put forward four commission opportunities to further enrich the territory and Dawn as a whole.

Goodwill.o: Following Summer 388YE judgements making the war against the vallorn Dawn's highest calling and pledging Navarr support for the Vallornguard, a series of opportunities emerged in Dawn, Highguard and the Conclave to prepare for the coming final war against the vallorn.

Gorgeous.o: Ahead of the Winter Solstice of 384YE, a crowd of foreign visitors, traders and curiosities made their way to Anvil, alongside the season's Imperial auction of titles and the Bourse's tally of the votes.

Gossamer threads.o: In Spring 388YE the Iron Confederacy, at peace with the Empire but no ally, held the Cazar Straits after crushing the Children of Wrecks, announced an attack on Free Landing and invaded Reinos. Ambassador Baroness Katerine Lavasse floated treaty, trade and supply-route proposals.

Grace that comes with healing.o: The Day eternal Ylenwe, after a year of amity, reached out to the Empire with a plan to quiet the Black Plateau using perfect mortal-composed music, while the damming of the River Doubt in Apstrus and the new Dreaming Spire reshaped Spiral and helped turn Icarion into an oasis.

Graveyard rats.o: Temeschwar's rat plague was brought under control in autumn 386YE after the city's Chamber of Commerce hired the Rat Kings guild, though Giselle's Tomb kept suffering attacks, several people were gnawed to death and the King of Rats remained at large. The city's doctors also proposed a new ministry to stockpile cures for the rat sickness.

Great prosperity and strength.o: In Autumn 383YE the Bourse was reshaped by Synod-driven calls for 'fair prices'. The Cinderpath Exchange and Iron Roundtower were completed, the Grendel seizure of Feroz diverted ilium, and several nations were offered proposals for their own national Bourse ministries.

Green and pleasant lands.o: In Summer 379YE a delegation of independent orcs from the Barrens emerged under a flag of truce in Boar's Dell in Brocéliande, seeking passage to Anvil to negotiate with the Imperial Senate. It was believed to be the first peaceful contact between the Empire and the orcs of the Barrens.

Grind.o: In the winter before Spring 385YE, forty thousand Jotun of Narkyst, backed by Summer knights and their greatest champions, struck south from Liathaven into Kahraman. They stormed Fort Braydon, took all of Braydon's Jasse and seized eight-tenths of Jade Range, including Nestor's Bounty.

Grown from the revolution seed.o: Documents seized in the Liberty Pact's raid on Chalonsio revealed that the Noble Lady of the Sea is a ship, the flagship of the Slave Lords of Rachensgrab, and gave the location of their island stronghold. The Empire was offered a one-season opportunity to assault it with Imperial fleets and military units.

Guide the spirit.o: In Summer 386YE the Civil Service reported on relations with the Sumaah Republic, covering the Liberty Pact, their war with Asavea, liao trade, ritual sharing and calls for Imperial fleets to aid them at sea. The Conclave disseminated two fortification rituals to Sumaah, and the General and Wintermark Assemblies passed mandates urging Imperial captains to help the Sumaah.

Half-time score.o: Halfway through the year-long contest to see which League city could spend the most Bourse resources improving itself, the civil service reported that Temeschwar led, Holberg ran second, and Sarvos and Tassato trailed far behind. It also set out new building opportunities for each city.

Hammers and boxes.o: Heralds from the Autumn realm visited the Empire in Winter 386YE: agents of the City of Fire and Stone offered paid help clearing Pakaanan's Pass and building Curstag's Way, while agents of the City of Gold and Lead changed how Ephisis' Scale boxes are handled and sought to buy the permanent Bound by Common Cause enchantment on the Wolves of War.

Handful of magic.o: In Spring 380YE a series of potent magical effects spread across the Empire: healing Spring waters, damaging storms, a surge of briar-born children, lingering Night shrouds and fog, and a powerful Winter curse eating away at the Court of the White Fountain in Redoubt.

Handle with care.o: Ahead of the 382YE Winter Solstice, several traders and visitors announced their arrival at Anvil: a lead on a Ring of Atun, a Faraden buyer of iridescent gloaming, a Therunin broker seeking apprentices, a Wintermark raider selling Grendel plunder, and a Night Market offered by the eternal Azoth.

Hard times.o: In Winter 381YE some two hundred escaped slaves rebelling against Duke Guiscard of Kalino fled into Feroz and began raiding back across the border, and the Duke asked the Empire for help dealing with them. At the Winter Solstice the Senate authorised the Imperial Ambassador to invite the Duke's troops over the border to suppress the rebels.

Hard times come again no more.o: In Winter 383YE a great many orcs who had lived under the Druj in Ossium completed the trek through Varushka to Skarsind, where the Imperial Orcs welcomed them and many joined the nation. Three large septs settled as foreigners in their own enclaves, each with conditions to meet before they would join.

Hard to find.o: In winter 386YE a Dawnish questing expedition into the Untrod Groves of the Barrens was turned back by a magical thorn barrier and a manticore-like being calling itself the Earl of the Groves. Meanwhile the Navarr completed the Last Battle wayhouse in the Bleaks, angering the Karass.

Harvest of infamy.o: In Autumn 386YE an Asavean and Grendel raiding fleet sailed down the Westmere to sack the Marcher market-town of Meade, but the Drakes, forewarned by orders seized in Madruga, were waiting and drove the raiders off. A separate Asavean-led band also threatened to desecrate the Phytwin Clearing on Kallavesa's Pilgrim's Trail.

Has reared himself a throne.o: Six eternals answered the Imperial archmages' plenipotentiary messages ahead of the 387YE Autumn Equinox. Estavus proposed an office in Zenith and an unknown Winter eternal agreed to parley, while Llofir, Lashonar, Jaheris and Zakalwe declined parley but set out conditions, offers or questions.

Have you seen me lately.o: In Spring 385YE six eternals answered the archmages' plenipotentiary messages: Sung, Ylenrith, Rhianos and Kaela agreed to formal parleys, Ephisis asked for a meeting that would not be a parley, and Ossegrahn declined but offered help in other ways. The second Arcane Colloquium was also scheduled for Saturday afternoon of the Spring Equinox.

Hear your footsteps.o: At the Assembly of Nine's request, the Silent Bell sodality searched for the Silent Bell of Brian Heathford, a relic lost at King's Stoke in Upwold in 290YE. They failed to find it but tied its theft to an Agramant-tainted Marcher coven, and the page offered mandates against Agramant and against suspiciously easy boons.

Heart of gold.o: Following the Senate's request, an appraisal by the civil servant Naomi of Virtue's Rest set out what would happen if the Mournwold orcs, former Jotun thralls, were bonded to the Marcher nation, after the Marcher egregore Jack confirmed this was possible. The Marcher Assembly was offered an open mandate to proceed, but serious problems of faith and of Whittle's hatred stood in the way.

Hearth Tithe.o: In Autumn 379YE, with the Jotun ceasefire ended early, the Marcher and Wintermark national assemblies both revived the Hearth Tithe. This old custom sees farmers give over part of their fields to growing healing herbs for their communities and soldiers.

Here comes the night.o: Six months after the Senate voted to raise a third Varushkan army in Karov, the nearly mustered force needed a name and a defining quality, with several sovereigns offering their patronage. The former Senator for Karsk, Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad, named it Boyar's Hasta and gave it the Sell Sword quality.

Here to stay.o: In Autumn 386YE the Navarr prognosticator Eilian Sweetwater appraised how to win over the uncooperative orcs of southern Mareave. The Senate then recognised all orcs in Mareave not actively fighting the Empire as foreigners and banned turtle hunting in the Bay of Catazar.

Here you come again.o: Six eternals answered the Imperial archmages' plenipotentiary messages from the Summer Solstice, and five of them agreed to parleys or meetings at the Autumn Equinox. Sinokenon declined to meet but offered help with one of three projects.

Heroes.o: After Suranni rebels claiming to be escaped slaves crossed from Kalino into Feroz and raided the Iron Confederacy, the Duke of Kalino's army entered Feroz with Imperial approval and crushed them. The slave revolution ended in executions and re-enslavement.

Hey now how you doing?.o: In Autumn 386YE several eternals reached out to the Empire: Kimus located the Pauper's Key, Sadogua offered to extend the Lyceum's wards and to make items for the Navarr, Lashonar withdrew favours after losing amity, Zakalwe stopped the Pearls of Manush, and Tharim's knights stayed camped in Madruga. Two skirmishes were also called against cults of Agramant.

Hidden inventory.o: The artisans of Runegrott proposed Brittashal, a hall in Valasmark to display Wintermark's banners, along with a new Warcaller title and an artefact banner to carry Empress Britta's legacy. Separately, the hylje invited Winterfolk to their Festival of Autumn's Easing.

Hierarchs of sea and sky.o: The Imperial enchantment Bright Eyes Gleam in the Depths drew the Day eternals who are not enemies of the Empire to send heralds across Imperial lands in Autumn 385YE. Most offered boons or proposals, chiefly for the Autumn Equinox, while Roshanwe stayed notably aloof.

High hopes.o: Following the Senate's creation of cattle markets in Stockland and Wayford, Marcher farmers brought 818 cattle bonds to Anvil in Spring 387YE, with buyers across and beyond the Empire competing for them. Enough were gathered to found the Southern Herd in Mareave and to lure the beast Typhawn in Sermersuaq.

Hoist up the thing.o: Before the 383YE Winter Solstice, the Imperial prognosticators published the conjunctions they had found from war scout reports. These offered chances to strike at the Jotun, the Druj, vallorn-allied Navarr and the cultists of Yaw'nagrah across the Empire.

Home fires.o: After the Marcher Assembly upheld Friar John of the Mourn's call to support soldiers resting in Marcher lands, Marchers debated how to make it real. Friar John later enacted a Synod mandate allowing any Imperial army to be billeted on Marcher farms.

Home from the wars.o: Following the fall of Overton and the razing of Orchard's Watch, the Greensward was beset by angry Imperial and Jotun ghosts, and the Marcher Assembly was offered three possible mandates for sending priests with liao to deal with them.

Honey and vinegar.o: In Spring 383YE, after the old bequests to the font ran dry, League merchants offered new ways to fund the Conclave's mana, the hylje of the Rikkivesi proposed a floating trading hall with Wintermark, and Marcher landskeepers made offers in gratitude for Rivers Run Red remaining interdicted.

Honey off a thorn.o: On the sixtieth anniversary of Thrace's slave uprising, the Imperial Orc egregores asked the Imperial Orc Assembly to settle who may join the nation, now that orcs settling Skarsind include many who have never served in the legions. Several competing mandates were offered for the Assembly to consider.

Hope and fear.o: Retired Varushkan general Mladen Escovitch delivered the Senate's commissioned appraisal of the Forest of Ulnak. He concluded that Druj armies depend on their septs' home lands, and that fully conquering the Salt Flats of Sanath plus either the Sarangrave or the Forest of Ulnak would collapse the Druj.

Hopeless as a feather.o: Following the Summer Solstice, eternals answered the plenipotentiaries sent by the Imperial archmages. Sadogua, Callidus, Meraud and Irra Harah agreed to parleys, Wise Rangara arranged a perilous non-parley audience with the Silent Witness, and Sinokenon sent its thanks without offering a parley.

House of earth.o: In Winter 381YE the Empire faced the question of what to do with the many Jotun thralls who stayed in the reconquered Mournwold, farming much of its best land. The Marcher Assembly sent Sister Meredith to bring them to the Way, and the Senate recognised them as foreigners.

Houses of Silence.o: Three years after the Senate ceded the Alivetti estates in Sarvos to the Sarcophan Delves, the thriving enclave raised concerns about lawlessness, offered Sarvosan businesses a narcotics trade deal that the Chamber of Commerce declined, and saw a Sarcophan sect begin building a heretical temple there.

How sweet is the sea.o: Following the Senate's Winter Solstice decision, more than eighty Imperial captains mapped the shores of the Bay of Catazar, charting three Iron Confederacy and five Grendel territories. Meanwhile, Grendel pirates continued to prey on Imperial trade in the Bay.

How the sausage is made.o: In Summer 386YE a subtle Night enchantment settled over Holberg, inspiring its people to seek out the finest food and drink, just as cannibal followers of the eternal Agramant were exposed grinding up victims into food in the city. The murdered merchant Anthony de Woort von Temeschwar's cooked head was served at a guild banquet, and the Synod was offered mandates to hunt the conspiracy.

How to be dead.o: After a Rod and Shield expedition into Lorenzo's Deep Pockets exposed the Braying Lord, an elder plaguewulf serving the Howling Queen, three Sentinel Gate opportunities arose to destroy its followers, its mercenary allies and the beast itself.

Hunter of stars.o: Ahead of the Spring Equinox 382YE, several eternals answered the archmages' plenipotentiary messages. Adamant, Ylenrith, Estavus, Sorin and the Boar King agreed to formal parleys, while menacing heralds of an unnamed master refused the Spring Archmage's message to Capradan.

Hunters and wolves.o: In autumn 381YE three encounters with Winter eternals came to Imperial attention: Sorin's herald sought nominees for the Trials of the Pallid Charm, heralds of the Bound-King Tharim emerged from a Winter regio in Birchland, and an Agramant-worshipping killer who sought to divide Wintermark and Varushka was caught and executed.

Hurricane party.o: After Archmage of Spring Ibiss Briarheart reached out by plenipotentiary at the Winter Solstice, the Spring eternal Siakha, who is under Conclave enmity, offered Imperial citizens a set of destructive boons for the Spring Equinox. Accepting any of them is treason punishable by death.

Hyenas and herbs.o: In Autumn 386YE the Sarcophan Delves set out their dealings with the Empire. They complained about the Asavean bounty and the Children of Wrecks, and offered trade proposals on weirwood, white granite, metals, herbs and a letter to the Elakar. Hahnmark's farmers voted to accept the Kraft brothers' vlinderbloem scheme.

I already know you.o: In spring 386YE the Westmere dredging was completed, bringing prosperity around the Gullet but also raising a deeply cursed rune-carved stone, while the Marches wrestled with how to fold the Marcher orcs into their traditions. The Marcher Synod then passed mandates binding the Drakes, Bounders and Tusks to Mitwold, Upwold and the Mournwold.

I am easy to find.o: Emperor Vesna used the Throne's power to address the Empire to publicly denounce General Archavion of the Gryphon's Pride as a criminal for his actions against the Rahvin in the Barrens, which the Empire had sworn to protect.

I heard a source.o: In Spring 383YE the City of Gold and Lead politely declined the Autumn Archmage's invitation to parley with Ephisis and instead sent heralds with three offers to the Empire. The Eternal Prospero then countered with an offer of his own; all the opportunities lasted until the end of the Winter Solstice 383YE.

I knew you were trouble.o: Ahead of the Winter Solstice 384YE, six eternals answered the plenipotentiary messages of the Imperial archmages: Prospero, Sorin, Kimus and Eleonaris agreed to formal parleys, the Whisper Gallery agreed only to an informal meeting, and Llofir refused, demanding amity so that it could take revenge on the Empire.

I remember you.o: As the Winter Solstice of 385YE approached, a varied assortment of foreign and unusual visitors made their way to Anvil. They included Axou traders and scholars, a Suaq astronomancer, a doom-preaching Urizen stargazer, an ailing Summer herald and Thule merchants, while the Charnel Lord of Branoc promised a gift for the new Empress.

I wish you would.o: In Summer 387YE the Empire's dealings with five foreign powers developed: Otkodov, the Iron Confederacy, the Grendel, the city state of Beoraidh and Skoura. The Thule treaty awaited a possible Synod veto while Otkodov fortified its holdings inside the Empire.

Idle hands are the devil's playthings.o: After the Synod convicted the Asavean architect Almodin Oktístis of idolatry and the Assembly of Pride condemned his works, Imperial citizens were ready to act against his idol-decorated buildings across the Empire. Three competing Synod mandates and Senate options were offered for dealing with his legacy.

If one be gone we carry on.o: In Spring 387YE the Tusks and the Drakes liberated the Ore Hills of Mournwold and pushed into the Chalkdowns. Meanwhile a vast Jotun host poured out of Ashvale and conquered nearly all of Bregasland, leaving only Ottery and its causeway held by the Strong Reeds and a fractious Bregas resistance.

If the wheel is fixed.o: After Jorma Steelhail's mandate urging the Empire and the Sumaah Republic to treat Timoj and Bastion as equals, the Sumaah Houses of Virtue paused missionary preaching against the Synod. They offered talks at Anvil if the Imperial Synod's General Assembly pledged to make no recognitions or changes of doctrine for a year.

If we never meet again.o: After Imperial disclosures that Commonwealth citizens unleashed Cold Sun on Lantir, the Principalities of Jarm forced the Commonwealth into a ceasefire, and Imperial-Commonwealth friendship began to collapse. Militärattache Ludkhannah Schöningen resigned as Commonwealth ambassador and was replaced by Otto Fuchsbach.

Immortal hand.o: In the wake of the Winter Solstice, five Imperial archmages used their power of plenipotentiary to contact eternals, and all five responded publicly. Their responses ranged from a formal parley to private audiences and, in one case, a legally fraught message to a declared sorcerer.

Impossible landscapes.o: In Winter 383YE five eternals answered the plenipotentiary messages of the Imperial archmages. Lord Rain, Ephisis, Roshanwe and Sung arranged meetings at Anvil, Adamant sent koboldi in place of a formal parley, and Kaela declined to meet but offered her gift against the vallorn.

Improve Court of the White Fountain.o: In Spring 384YE Sagua i'Ezmara, Master of the Koboldi, announced plans to improve the Court of the White Fountain fortification in Redoubt with the help of the eternal Adamant, aiming to make it unbreakable.

Improve House of Barbs.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to upgrade the House of Barbs sinecure in Hercynia, raising its yield to 7 liao and 14 Synod votes a season. The work was never commissioned because the Senate had no commission opportunities left.

Improve Our Lady of Pride.o: In Autumn 382YE the Imperial Master of Works announced a commission to enlarge Our Lady of Pride, the fortification in Sarvos, raising its effective strength to 6,000 once complete.

Improve Reumah's Rest.o: A Senate motion to upgrade the fort Reumah's Rest in Coursmouth, Necropolis, was proposed by the senator for Semmerholm and seconded by the senator for Kahraman, but it failed.

Improve Reumah's Rest II.o: In Autumn 383YE the Imperial Master of Works, Marley of Treen, announced a commission to upgrade Reumah's Rest, the fortification in Necropolis. When complete, it will raise the fort's strength to 6,000.

Improve Syrene's Wisdom.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate passed a motion to fund the modernisation of the pumps at Syrene's Wisdom, the ilium mine in Casinea, taking up an opportunity described in the Wake up crying Wind of Fortune.

Improve Towerjacks.o: In Spring 384YE the Senate passed a motion to fund improvements to the Towerjacks army, replacing its Siege quality with the Engineer quality, following an opportunity raised in the Watches from the Wall wind of fortune.

Improve Walls of Holberg.o: In Summer 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Holberg and seconded by Volodmartz, commissioning the expansion of the Walls of Holberg, to be funded by the citizens of Holberg.

Improve the Great Chain of Sarvos.o: In Winter 386YE the Master of the Koboldi, Dima Vasilyevna Novosad, announced a commission to improve the Great Chain, the fortification in Sarvos. It was funded over the following year and completed, raising the Great Chain to a rank two fortification.

Improve the vale of Orieb.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion to fully improve the town of Orieb and its Stinking Market in Ossium, establishing the first true vale of the Drownbark Forest, funded entirely by Varushkans.

In Virtue and Reason.o: Imperatrix Lisabetta used her power to address the Empire to condemn the heavy civilian toll of the previous season's war in the Mournwold and to urge that ruthless tactics be reserved for enemy armies, not ordinary people.

In brightest day.o: After the Autumn Equinox a powerful Night enchantment settled over the whole Empire, inspiring artists and stirring national Pride, with the effect strongest in the Empire's cities. It gave the Senate a rare chance to commission Pride-focused great works, and led Sarvos's House Bourné to reveal six new ritual-robe schemata.

In each line lies another line.o: At the Winter Solstice 384YE, prognosticators identified three major conjunctions on the Sunday morning that offered Imperial heroes the chance to fight the Jotun in Skallahn, Liathaven or Bregasland. The Military Council was to choose between them at the Friday muster.

In good company.o: In Summer 384YE the Imperial and Thule alliance drove the Jotun from Suaq Fount and Suaq Wastes, recapturing the Pride of Ikka's Tears and returning Sermersuaq to Imperial hands, though the Jotun still held fortified positions in Tanikipari and Stark. The page also set out a Sentinel Gate battle in Tanikipari and three conjunction opportunities.

In harmony and unison.o: The Conclave requested, and Imperial magicians prepared, plans for a Grand Lodge of the Sevenfold Path at Sanctuary in Sanctuary Sands, Necropolis, honouring the paragon Atun's voyage to the continent. The great work still had to be commissioned by the Senate and built.

In the Court of Far Horizons.o: In Summer 388YE, at Emperor Vesna's request, the Constitutional Court appraised the proposed Imperial sodality, the Court of Far Horizons, finding it would govern maritime trade and receive the power to set tariffs. Three groups offered support if the Senate backed it with real powers.

In the charnel pit.o: Following the Spring Equinox, the Prosperity and Courage assemblies' highest callings opened pastoral opportunities to aid damaged territories and those who had suffered under Druj fear. A proposed refuge for escaped Druj slaves was also put forward, and Esther of the Watchers of Belial urged the Synod to forgo the Druj's secret lore.

In the end everything collides.o: In the autumn of 382YE the new Thule treaty took effect: Crow's Ridge passed bloodlessly to the Thule, and talks began on slaves, Druj intelligence and a disputed claim to Sungold Pass. Meanwhile Great Forest orcs began walking the trods with the Navarr, the Mournwold thralls kept the status quo, and a Grendel emissary sought to ransom captured troops.

In the flat field.o: The Marchers' efforts to bring the Mournwold's Jotun former thralls into their nation continued, with a proposed Synod mandate to share the breadbasket's bounty with the thralls at the Autumn Wassail. The Hate-following village of Whittle rejected the Marcher Assembly's final offer to recant, leaving the Empire to choose how to deal with its ringleaders.

In the flesh.o: In spring 387YE the manticore known as the Earl of the Groves published an open letter to the people of Dawn, claiming its nobility through Penni the White and inviting Dawnish knights to a tourney at its manse in the Untrod Groves. It was also bolstering the Golden Sun with vassals and recruits, while eternals and heralds moved against it.

In the garden of defiance.o: After agents of the Hag Queen cursed Holmauer Park in Holberg at the Summer Solstice 383YE, the blight left fouled waters, a Winter regio, corrupted woods and statues, and a string of opportunities for the Senate and Synod to turn the disaster to advantage.

In the ground.o: In Winter 387YE three eternals courted the Marches. Adamant answered the Stone Smith's missive with fortification and curse-ward offers conditional on Eastern Guard, Tharim offered landskeepers boons and compensation, and Sadogua's heralds joined Wassail and offered gifts to mummers.

In the hills, the cities.o: In Summer 386YE, relations between the Empire and Axos remained badly damaged by the Tsark Debacle, though they were eased somewhat by the Empire's defence of Axos's place in the Liberty Pact. Two new opportunities arose: an offer of Understanding-hallowed items for the Assembly of the Nine, and an Axou bid to buy white granite.

In the lonely hour.o: In Winter 384YE Druj forces led by the Black Wind tried to break the Steel Causeway in the Barrens, but six Imperial armies beat them back and gained a small foothold in Bitter Strand. The cost was six thousand Imperial dead, and the campaign was slowed by a deliberate effort to reach the Druj's subject orcs.

In the tents of prosperity.o: In Spring 381YE several traders headed to Anvil with valuable goods. Druj merchants came to exchange mithril for white granite, Urizen's House Cudo offered three droplets of night, and a Highborn explorer, a Marcher trader and a Navarri survivor of Liathaven each sought buyers for rare relics.

Inextricable, indefatigable, and inevita.o: In Summer 386YE Emperor Vesna addressed every Imperial citizen, celebrating the recent addition of Ossium, the Barrens and Mareave to the Empire and condemning those who curse Imperial territories. The Emperor also challenged the Empire to make every corner of its lands an example of Prosperity.

Inkpot gods.o: In Summer 385YE the Bounty of the Brilliant Broker drew heralds of Ephisis, Estavus, Callidus, Prospero and Basileus Flint into the Empire, bringing a wide range of trades, commissions and bargains. The heralds also brought news that Mazen had been destroyed and that the Lictors had fallen silent.

Into the spin.o: After Imperial victories in Mareave, including the conquest of Clisearn, the Senate was asked to assign the former Grendel territory, which has no Imperial citizens. The Senate allocated Mareave to the Imperial Orcs and ratified a treaty recognising the orcs of Beoraidh as foreigners.

Into the valley.o: In Summer 384YE Imperial armies returned to the Barrens for the first time in three years, striking from Holberg and Therunin to conquer the Carmine Fields and Hope's Rest and drive a 'steel causeway' through the centre of the territory.

Into the woods.o: In Winter 380YE the Metri region of Temeschwar fell under a strange darkness, with ghostly figures serving 'the Prince of the Icy Heart' brutally killing anyone who threatened violence on its roads, leaving Metri haunted but free of banditry.

Into tired shadow.o: In Autumn 384YE, with six Druj armies encircled in Zenith and preparing to flee after Karvor Eyepeel's death, the Highborn Assembly was offered competing Synod mandates. It could either press the attack on the Druj or turn aside to purge the lingering evil of their occupation before Zenith became permanently terrorised.

Invest in Beoraidh Docks.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to commission new docks at Beoraidh in Mareave, disbursing 75 thrones so that Imperial fleet owners could trade with the port and the Empire could raise revenue from tariffs and tax.

Invited with asperity.o: In Winter 387YE the Thule sent word that their ambassador Rak would make a state visit to Anvil with his potential successors, and set out a series of offers and refusals. These included an invitation to join a Thule invasion of the Forest of Ulnak, a joint raid on face-peelers in Varushka, and several requests for Imperial rituals and weirwood trees.

Iron and wine.o: Lavish celebrations of Empress Lisabetta's coronation, led by the League and funded by the Senate, Synod and private donors, spread across the Empire. Her message to stem the flow of Imperial blood inspired healers to support the armies.

Irreconcilable differences.o: Rane Shardbearer, Senator for Kallavesa, passed a Senate motion by a single vote making it illegal to preach the Way in Asavea, and Sabella of the Silent Tide sought a Synod veto. At the Autumn Equinox the General Assembly upheld the veto and struck the law down.

Is there anybody out there?.o: In Spring 387YE a roundup of eternal activity reached the Empire. Tharim's thousand Ashen Knights marched north from Madruga seeking vengeance, the House of Fire and Flame reopened Pakaanan's Pass, and numerous eternals made offers, challenges and visits.

Islands in the dream.o: In Autumn 388YE an Unshackled expedition, guided by Bloodcrow Meep with Varushkan and Highborn advisors, visited the Dreamers of the Dark Forest in Echofell to learn about their ancestors. The Dreamers declined to share their ancestors, but begged the Empire to free the other half of their sept from the Druj-held Ghul'Thak Forest.

It can't get much worse.o: Ahead of the 382YE Autumn Equinox, the civil service published the conjunctions found by war scouts and prognosticators. They offered Imperial heroes chances to rescue refugees and scholars, hunt Druj monsters and ritualists, raid fugitives and green iron, and repel Grendel landings.

It never happened.o: In Winter 386YE the Civil Service reported on rocky relations with the Citadels of Axos amid internal upheaval driven by Grand Ilarch Kyther of Kaban and Theodosia of Ipotavo. Shuttered Lantern magicians spied in Axos, and the Synod was offered mandates to join, study or watch the effort to cleanse the haunted ruins of Solokha.

It's all wrong, but it's all right.o: In Autumn 388YE the Empire's relations with Faraden were strained by Faraden anger at Synod hostility to their Five Flames faith, while the Iron Confederacy, now holding Cazar Straits and Free Landing, sent a delegation to Anvil to negotiate a treaty.

It's my time.o: Highborn archivists and benefactors, sent north by Jared of the Suns of Couros's peerless kinship judgement, arrived in Wintermark but could not agree which of three causes to support. They turned to the Highborn Assembly to choose between mandates backing the banner hall, the Witan, or the exploration of Tsirku.

It's only me.o: Ahead of the Spring Equinox 386YE, the first summit of Emperor Vesna's reign, a range of visitors announced their intention to come to Anvil seeking aid, counsel or business, while one foreign scholar abruptly left the Empire.

It's what we do.o: Following the Senate's creation of the Imperial Apothecaries Guild at the Winter Solstice, the civil service publicised the new sodality, arranged a means for members to join, and set out the legal powers it might be granted. Three groups of citizens offered support in return for changes to its manifesto or powers.

Journeys end in lovers meeting.o: Ahead of the Spring Equinox of 388YE, a range of visitors sent word that they were coming to Anvil. They included Freeborn with transformative waters, envoys of the Charnel Lord Irontooth, Marracossan treaty partners, armed boggarts, Hahnmark ghosts and the rebuffed Tribunal of the Silver Flame.

Judged by their company.o: Requests from Asaveans wishing to be ordained at the new Temple of the Seven Virtues in Nemoria prompted its overseer to seek the Imperial Synod's guidance, with three possible mandates offered on who, if anyone, should be trained. The page also covered the Synod's inquisition of the architect Almodin Oktístis, Zemress concerns over his commission for the Iron Qanat, and a pamphlet on the Asavean gods.

Keep talking.o: In Spring 387YE the Civil Service reported on foreign relations. A Suranni priestly delegation planned to visit Anvil to discuss military history, Jotun ghodi camped on Gull Isle asking how it was chosen for a new Meeting Place, and the Grendel denied any alliance with the Children of Wrecks.

Key of dreams.o: Six eternals answered the plenipotentiary messages of the Imperial archmages, arranging parleys, a night market, a library archive and conditional boons for the Spring Equinox summit. Arhallogen declined to parley but offered boons if the Conclave changed course; the interdiction on savage army enchantment was removed and Ossegrahn was placed under enmity.

Keys of Enlightenment.o: In Summer 388YE, Sumaah ambassador Oxtitocszin offered a deal to transport Imperial mithril and weirwood and shared an essay on the paragon Sjördeyr. The Republic also voiced doubts about the Liberty Pact, a Sumaah ship lay stricken by sickness in Free Landing, and the Regario Dossier's spy network in Zemeh went dark.

Kingdom by the sea.o: After the victors of the Great Race met Rhianos, the eternal's heralds offered Imperial fleet captains three possible voyages for the season after the Autumn Equinox 387YE: mapping the eastern coastline, raiding Asavean shipping, and hunting the juvenile kraken off Free Landing.

Kith and kin.o: Following the Marcher Assembly's judgement accepting Highguard's peerless kinship, Highborn priests worked with the Marchers to defend the Mournwold against the Jotun, which opened up mandates, a new way for beaters to defend the bounds and proposed fortifications. A Bounders Hall was then commissioned in Bregasland at the Summer Solstice 386YE.

Knocking on every door.o: After the Assembly of Vigilance endorsed consecrating an inspirational location to the contentious exemplar Berechiah with true liao, the Civil Service treated the statement as the first Writ of Consecration. They identified three candidate sites, each of which would shape his inspiration differently.

Know your enemy.o: The Imperial Synod chose to reject the false virtues, and Viviane Barossa's General Assembly mandate urged the Empire to stay vigilant against them, though it had no effect in Urizen, Varushka or Wintermark. The mandate left open questions about the Peace auras still borne at the heart of the Synod, and it offered the Vigilance Assembly a chance to send the Silent Bell to spy on followers of false virtues.

Laid low.o: In spring 385YE eight Imperial armies, alongside the Strong Reeds' uprising inside the territory, drove the Jotun and Mathilda Fisher's 'Free Bregas' forces out of most of Bregasland. The territory became Imperial again, though Fisher refused to surrender and called her supporters to retreat.

Land fit for heroes.o: Following Wintermark's relinquishment of Skarsind and its ratification through Empress Britta's Imperial Favour, the Senate assigned the territory to the Imperial Orcs at the Autumn Equinox 379YE, giving them a homeland for the first time. Over the winter Imperial Orcs moved there in large numbers, and new arrangements were set out for their senator, generals and national titles.

Landscape.o: After Imperial heroes used the House of Fire and Flame's rondures to tear open Redgate Pass in Serra Damata, the shattered mountain was found to hold mithril, weltsilver, orichalcum and bloodstones. Several opportunities were offered to exploit the wealth, and the Senate chose to build the Red Depths as a Brass Coast national Bourse seat.

Lantern's light.o: The red star fell into the Thule region of Sküld in Otkodov, and the Thule offered Varushka a share of the resulting ilium as they had agreed. The Senate accepted, creating the Gift of the Dwindling Star as a Varushkan national Bourse seat with offices at Void in Brez.

Large but far away.o: This Wind of Fortune set out the state of the Empire's relations with the great foreign powers at the Autumn Equinox 383YE. Key developments were Marracossan refugees settling in Trajadoz, Commonwealth magicians arriving to study Imperial lore, and Jarm and the Commonwealth sliding into war over Lantir.

Last rays of the sun.o: In Summer 386YE the last two scion armies of Cold Sun in the Empire were destroyed. The Quiet Step and Navarr allies wiped out the Empty Hands at Rhonwen's Fall in Miaren, while the Granite Pillar, Summer Storm and Autumn Hammers broke the Silence Arc at the Tower of the Eagle in Hahnmark, ending the incursion but leaving a deadly gateway behind.

Lay the foundations.o: After the Highborn National Assembly upheld Eli of the Cenotaph's judgement declaring completion of the Grand Inspiration of the Way in Bastion to be the nation's highest calling, Highguard's enthusiasm surged. A range of new opportunities to speed and shape the project arose.

Lean and athirst.o: Over the winter of 387YE a large force of Varushkan captains, aided by the Thule Claws of the Dragon, systematically rooted out the face-peeling trudniki across Karsk and Ossium. The hunt was an overwhelming success but left draughir and other 'suspicious' Varushkans facing distrust.

Leaves and fruit.o: In Summer 382YE a revival of Highborn interest in building with white granite raised three opportunities: a network of White Roads for pilgrims, refurbishing the Basilica of the Seven Doors in Bastion with a restored Speaker of the Highborn Assembly, and a white granite ministry called the Cinderpath Exchange. Of these, only the Basilica refurbishment and the Speaker's restoration are recorded as completed, shortly before the Summer Solstice 383YE.

Less welcome tenants.o: Following a Senate appraisal requested by the senators for Holberg and Semmerholm, the cabalist Lutomysla Niegoslava set out several proposals to end Dho'uala's attacks around the Semmerlak, while the Silent Bell sought Synod guidance on countering the sovereign virtuously.

Let that be your last battlefield.o: By Autumn 384YE the Free Folk were working the harvest across the Empire and spreading pamphlets about their ancestors and their 'Divine Family', while refusing to seek citizenship. Imperial priests divided over whether their beliefs were acceptable, and pressure mounted on the Synod's General Assembly to give a clear ruling.

Let the day die.o: In Winter 384YE a Winter enchantment woven by Highguard's Saker coven stirred the Mournwold's ghosts to communicate with the living. Priests answering Friar John of Honour's Rest learned that the Greensward dead chiefly wished to be remembered, which opened the opportunity to build a memorial orchard at Orchard's Watch.

Lethal and elusive.o: In Winter 382YE the Liathaven vallorn, weakened by its failed expansion and smothered by the Wither the Seed curse, offered a closing chance to clear Westwood, while the Feni of the Woods-that-Fell moved on: the southern band into Liathaven and the northern band into Hercynia, where they raided Navarr steadings.

Light upon the water.o: In Summer 384YE Imperial magicians cast Thunderous Deluge and Regrow the Land's Heart under a conjunction that spread both across every Imperial territory, turning the Great Drought into the Great Storm. Three months of destructive but renewing rain flooded the Empire, with Tassato worst hit.

Like a wheel within a wheel.o: After an Imperial raid through the Sentinel Gate at the Summer Solstice captured Ossuary and gave the Empire control of Spiral, the Civil Service assessed the reclaimed territory. It reported on spoils of war, the restored Legacy mithril mine, Urizen's army capacity and a conditional offer by the Stonemasons of Mezudan to help build a castle.

Lines of care and sorrow.o: In Autumn 387YE four Grendel armies invaded Mareave from Ayereed, seizing Fleisardh with the help of the Brine Turtle sept and pushing deep into Clisearn. Summoned Winter and Summer defenders slowed them, and the city of Beoraidh stayed neutral.

Listen to your heart.o: With Madruga burning, Grendel fleets began targeting and boarding Imperial ships across the Bay of Catazar. The Freeborn Assembly was offered two competing Synod mandates: strike back at Grendel shipping, or escort Imperial merchants safely past them.

Lit up.o: In Winter 386YE, Mareave offered several opportunities. The Golden Pyramid proposed a far grander lodge in Clisearn, and Illarawm envoys mapped the leadership of the Brine Turtles in Fioroult. Skouran mercenaries offered to garrison a citadel, and two conjunctions arose: a Grendel paymaster in Icarion and a storm-stranded Beoraidh ship.

Little boats.o: In Summer 379YE three Druj boats crossed the Semmerlak and landed a delegation near Lacre under a flag of truce, asking to speak to the Senate about peace. The diplomats travelled to Anvil, negotiated at length and later returned safely to the Mallum.

Little faith.o: Following the Wisdom Assembly's call to make the Great Library of Hacynian a true sacred site, the General Assembly chose between three competing consecration mandates and upheld Judgement 34, under which Nathair Autumngale consecrated the Library with true liao to seek the right question between Night and Day. The Library's success also inspired the Navarr vines movement, opening a time-limited opportunity to commission a Vinery.

Little mercy.o: In Spring 386YE an uneasy calm settled on the Barrens. The Black Wind army returned unopposed to evacuate its sept, a third of whom chose to join the Rahvin, while the Great Forest Orcs looked to the Navarr for protection and the Karass offered Dawn a herb trade.

Living with war.o: Before the Summer Solstice of 383YE the civil service published the military conjunctions it had found: chances to strike at stranded Grendel pirates in Madruga and Spiral, Jotun stockades in Sermersuaq, vallorn threats in Brocéliande, Druj miasma pillars and tortured souls in Ossium, and a Druj scouting camp in Holberg.

Lonely, dark and deep.o: In Summer 379YE the vallorn in Brocéliande grew restless, apparently weakened and provoked by the repaired trod network, while the Druj withdrew from Elerael. Miasma and ettercaps spilled into Casinea, Astolat and Semmerholm, twisting a quarter of their farm and forest produce, though some of the strange fruit proved usable like crystal mana in Spring rituals.

Long grass and stormclouds.o: In Summer 387YE the Fist of the Mountains and the Burning Falcon reclaimed the Quiet Grasses, restoring Madruga as an Imperial territory, while the Children of Wrecks launched a massive but ultimately failed raid on Trivento in Sarvos. Grendel forces in Feroz stayed quiet, and three conjunctions offered chances to strike at Grendel agents in Necropolis and Mareave.

Long roads to ruin.o: In Winter 379YE four separate orc contingents (Druj, Thule, Grendel and orcs from the Barrens) travelled overland or by sea towards Anvil for the Winter Solstice, each with its own purpose.

Long shadows.o: A Senate-approved drive, fully funded by Irontide Flax and aided by Golden Pyramid magicians, sent prospectors into the mountains of Skarsind. They found iron, silver, magical metals and several valuable sites, and Imperial heroes later cleared the trogoni from Crimson Peak Mining.

Long walk home.o: The Summer 383YE Wind of Fortune reported on the Empire's foreign affairs and their consequences. Freed Dubhtraig orcs were settled in Skarsind, the Great Forest orcs and briars made requests, and tensions with the Thule over raids and slaves continued. A Jotun warband came to Anvil for a contest and the weregild, Tsark dismantled the Imperial spy network, and the Grendel demanded the Imperial Fleet Master as their ambassador.

Lost in translation.o: In Spring 383YE most of the orc slaves freed in the raid on Dubhtraig were scattered across the Empire, begging or turning to banditry, because no Senate motion was raised to supply their journey to Skarsind. Imperial military units were offered the chance to find them and escort them north.

Loud and proud.o: In Autumn 388YE the Highborn and Ambition Assemblies pressed on with the unfinished Grand Inspiration of the Way, prompting offers around a cantor concert and inquisitorial chambers, and a public pledge to complete it by Spring 389YE. Meanwhile the Sumaah answered the Way Assembly's challenge with their case that Zemress is a Paragon of Prosperity.

Louder than words.o: In Spring 387YE the Thule pressed the Empire for land, wanting at least one of Opascari or Mieriada, as the price of renewing the peace treaty that expires at the Summer Solstice. Ephisis brokered several side offers intended to ease the negotiations.

Love and War.o: In Spring 387YE Dawn's new army, mustered in Astolat and funded largely by Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost through the Hand of the Chancellor, neared completion. The new Senator for Astolat, Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco, was left to choose its name and its defining quality.

Love and monsters.o: After the Dawnish National Assembly upheld the Earl of Fools' Highest Calling to fight the vallorn, Dawn was offered several ways to prepare for war against it. The Assembly backed a mandate opening Greenwood Manor to the Vallornguard and citizens of all nations, and Dame Katelyn Quinnell De Cordraco met the eiaran Eleonaris.

Love and rockets.o: In Autumn 383YE, responding to a Dawnish Assembly mandate, Dawnish troubadours travelled across Highguard to sing of love and glory, and the Highborn welcomed them warmly. Their visit left the Highborn Assembly with a choice of mandates on whether these Dawnish ideals are virtuous, a distraction or a vice.

Made anew.o: After the Autumn Equinox 386YE, explorers and the Unfettered Mind and Rod and Shield Conclave orders charted the new marsh created when the Scorrero flooded southern Madruga, mapping three transformed regions and uncovering several opportunities. Bakar i Riqueza took one of them, funding an expansion of the Parador of Salt and Sand.

Make a deal.o: Prompted by Cardinal Darian Numbers of the Prosperity assembly, Navarr brokers and their Great Forest Orc neighbours put forward several proposals to improve the prosperity of Therunin. These included a great herb-lore college at Peakedge, a fortified expansion of the Feverwater docks, and a request that the Senate promise the Heart of Peytaht to the orcs.

Make good use.o: In Summer 382YE Feni raiding surged across the Mournwold and Hahnmark, threatening production on every farm, business and herb garden there, while the long-standing Feni enclave in Alderly remained hidden and untouched by the raids.

Make it happen.o: Acting on a Senate motion proposed by Temeschwar, the prognosticator Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra appraised how the Empire might use its spy network in Sarangrave to incite the Druj's subject septs to rise up. She concluded that the septs loathe the Druj but are too frightened to rebel without arms and real encouragement.

Map the Bay of Catazar.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Kahraman and seconded by Madruga, to give Imperial fleets the resources to explore the Bay of Catazar and produce an Imperial map of it.

March on their belly.o: In late 379YE a Winter curse, identified as Naeve's Twisting Blight, devastated the Marcher harvest across Mitwold, Upwold and Bregasland. Food prices rose and Imperial military resupply suffered, until the Marcher assembly urged farmers to sell cheaply to the Civil Service for the good of the Empire.

Mark of the Ravadi.o: In Summer 388YE the Custodes Clavicum offered to build Ravadi's Bow, a keep at Lightsea in Madruga, as the inspirational memorial to the Exemplar of Vigilance Ravadi Founders' Dance. The Senate had until the end of the Summer Solstice to commission it.

Mean what you say.o: A summer round-up of magical occurrences across the Empire: enchanted fortifications, restored trods in Spiral, a transformed Colossus of Sarvos, bountiful Mournwold farms and lingering starless skies and veils. It also set out Conclave business, including offers from Adamant, Eleonaris, Sadogua, Azoth and Arhallogen, and an unsettling message from Agramant.

Mercy is weakness.o: With the Temple of the Winds in Morrow finally rebuilt, the sword scholars of Sulemaine resumed their role as foils to the Imperial Synod, so every Synod mandate now needs a greater majority to be effective. The Wind also set out ways the Synod and Urizen could strengthen or condemn the scholars.

Mermaids in the basement.o: Following a Senate motion to appraise bridging the Brass Coast islands to the mainland, the prognosticator Lutomysla Niegoslava concluded in Winter 387YE that such bridges were effectively impossible. She instead set out alternative ways to reach, defend, enrich or even remove the islands of Free Landing and the Cazar Straits.

Metal and stone.o: After the Conclave accepted an offer from the Sovereign Lord of the City of Fire and Stone, heralds of the Architects of Iron and Stone spent a season assessing three Bourse seats. They returned with proposals to improve the Brilliant Star in Redoubt, the Vigilant Swan in Reikos and the Pride of Ikka's Tears in Sermersuaq.

Metamorphosis.o: In Autumn 388YE the Sarangrave faced looming famine among orcs expelled from Thornfen, delicate negotiations with the Nesustak rebels, and a threat from the regenerating beast Kroll, even as the last Druj miasma pillar was finally destroyed.

Midnight rain.o: Following the Senate's Autumn Equinox vote, a fleet of over seventy Imperial captains, mostly Winterfolk, sailed the Sea of Snow and mapped its coastline, filling gaps in the Empire's knowledge of the Jotun and Faraden lands along its shores.

Million miles of water.o: Freeborn and Marcher experts, Skouran water-guardians and others offered competing ways to bring water to the arid regions of Mareave, the Imperial Orcs' newly assigned territory. Each scheme came with its own costs, risks and deadlines.

Mime each lonely word.o: Illya Nikovitch Volkov, Guardian of the Maze of Zoria, consecrated the ancient Maze in Miekarova with True Liao at the Varushkan national assembly's urging, infusing it with the Dagger of the Mind. Pilgrims emerged transformed, the Guardian gained strange powers, and dreams began revealing the sovereigns of Varushka.

Mirror and the flame.o: In Winter 387YE the Spiral rebels announced they had formed the Tribunal of the Silver Flame under Grand Arbiter Caela, planned a fane to Sinokenon in Cinion, and brought the eternal's offers of war rituals and a gift for the Throne. Separately, a Grendel company escorting Asaveans carrying Black Plateau glass was found trying to leave Spiral through Apulus.

Missionary work.o: Escaped human slaves rebelling against the Suranni in Kalino asked the Empire for missionaries to teach them the Way, following a Senate motion offering General Assembly missionaries to the Iron Confederacy. The Synod considered aiding the rebels or offering them sanctuary, but Empress Lisabetta intervened and neither mandate was upheld.

Mistaken for strangers.o: In Winter 386YE a stream of visitors made for Anvil during the solstice, from heralds of the Lion of Summer and the Howling Queen's envoy to merchants, petitioners and a delegation of Sand Fishers answering the Synod's invitations.

Mithril and rope.o: In Summer 388YE the Grendel pressed their invasion of Clisearn in Mareave and, aided by a new navy and Asavean warships, drove the Imperial defenders back until only Iskander's Donjon stopped the region from falling. Grendel raiders also plundered the Fundindelve mithril mine, though much of the loot was recovered.

Momento mori.o: An undying horror known as the Schlacta of Rot in Karov and the Deadwood Knight in Weirwater failed to return to slumber after its Summer challenge and began a growing rampage along the Dawn–Varushka border, raising those it slew into an unliving warband.

Monarchs and outcasts.o: In Spring 388YE a host of eternals reached out to the Empire with offers, boons, complaints and warnings, from Llofir's mycelium-for-herbs deal with the Navarr to Ephisis' bids to buy the Quicksilver's Flame and build Counting Houses.

More love, less paperwork.o: The great building works of Merchant-prince Lorenzo "La Volpe" Macelliao von Temeschwar across the League created Synod opportunities to hasten the Blood Red Roads, to recognise his monuments as broadly inspirational, and to consecrate the Colossus of Sarvos. The General Assembly sped up the roads, the League Assembly mandate failed, and the Colossus was consecrated after the Spring Equinox 383YE.

More work.o: Following Severin von Holberg's encyclical stressing that the Seven Virtues unite the Empire, scholars and priests put forward several proposals to strengthen the cardinals and the Synod's power of revocation. Severin's sermon also stifled religious conflict, leaving some statements of principle without effect.

Mosaic.o: In Autumn 384YE the Liberty Pact armada of Sumaah, Imperial and Commonwealth ships sailed from Xeier and sacked the Asavean city of Chalonsio. The raiders freed slaves, destroyed the priesthood of the God of Chains and burned the Ceruleo family's Sapphire Keep.

Moving mountains is no easy task.o: Senate's refusal to build the Cinderpath Exchange, a proposed white granite market in Mareholm, prompted the Synod to back it, and at the Winter Solstice 382YE three mandates were upheld urging citizens to withhold Bourse resources from the Public Auction at Anvil.

Mud, blood, and manacles.o: In Autumn 388YE twelve Imperial armies, led by the Strong Reeds, retook the Rushes and Ottermire from the Jotun, making Bregasland an Imperial territory once more. Meanwhile the Autumn Hammers and the Lictors cursed every Jotun army in the territory.

Murder of Crows.o: After three Wintermark Assembly judgements at the Spring Equinox 385YE, the Assembly was offered choices on how to honour the Varushkan senator Yulia Kasimirova Voronov and the rebel thane Dogri Thulebane. It could also decide whether Wintermark should abandon its policy of fighting the Jotun with honour.
