Mushroom, mushroom, mushroom.o: After the Conclave declared neutrality with Llofir in Winter 387YE, the Spring eternal offered the Navarr help against the vallorn, proposed a new garden in Greenfalls and a plan to hasten the Druj's collapse, and extended new whisperspore boons. It continued to nurse a grudge against Highguard, the League and Urizen.

Music of a distant drum.o: Relations with the Thule of Otkodov soured after the Empire imposed Liberty Pact sanctions without warning, and a Thule delegation was announced for the Spring Equinox. The page also gave diplomatic updates on the Great Forest Orcs, the Mournwold thralls, the Jotun, Tsark, the Grendel and the Druj.

My friends are my estate.o: After the Senate dispatched Naomi of Virtue's Rest to appraise Spiral's prosperity, she put forward several League–Urizen proposals to blunt the Black Plateau's effects and enrich the territory. They include a Night-infused shipyard and a fortified Palace of Mists in Apulian, a questing venture, a Northern Way road to Zenith, and a revised Oblivion's Edge fortification.

My passions from a common spring.o: The Civil Service's Autumn 387YE diplomatic report described the Lantir War between the Commonwealth and the Principalities of Jarm. Neither side was clearly winning, though the Commonwealth seemed to be slowly pushed back. It also set out the state of Imperial relations with both great powers.

Myth makers.o: In Summer 388YE the Empire's dealings with five orc nations moved forward: the Protectorate of Morajasse sent emissaries to Anvil, the Thule pressed their war in Ulnak and met the Ambassador, Beoraidh expanded trade, a shrine was consecrated at the Jotun Meeting Place, and the Grendel mocked the Imperial ambassador.

Never be found at home.o: After the Empire's raid on Skallahn wrecked the Kongegőr land bridge, a brief chance opened for Imperial fleets to sail into the Sea of Snow. The Senate could fund a 50-throne expedition to map its coasts before the Jotun finished repairs.

New port, old wine.o: After the Jotun were driven from Bregasland, General Amberlain swore a binding oath that the Strong Reeds would protect the territory, and House Greywater sought a lasting reward for aiding the resistance. The Imperial Senate later agreed to expand the docks at Eel's Landing and granted it a charter as a market town, ending the embittered mood in the North Fens.

News from the north.o: In Summer 379YE the Bane of Tradition faded from Wintermark after the Crown of Three Tears was recovered, but Thule curses ravaged Sermersuaq, Kallavesa's mana stayed drained, auras of Prosperity shook Hahnmark and Skarsind, and Jotun raids grew bolder.

Nightcall.o: The mystics of Ishal, guided by the Raven Seer, proposed new ways to protect Kallavesa now that the Toad King has weakened Dripping Echoes of the Fen. They suggested building three fanes to three night eternals in the territory, and arranged a private meeting with Sadogua at the Autumn Equinox.

Nightfall in Apulian.o: In Summer 387YE the city of Apulian in Spiral sank deeper into the influence of the Night realm and an intensifying dramaturgical confluence, while suspicion fell on Sung's fane and its backers. The infiltration of a Grendel espionage ring gave the Empire a choice: destroy its outpost or attempt counter-espionage.

No Matter What.o: After Freeborn expertise helped the Imperial Orcs turn desert into oasis in Mareave, the Sunstorm sept came to Feroz with two proposals: a military training camp in Afarjasse, and a joint spy network against the Suranni in Arbonne disguised as a cattle market. The Wrangler's Market spy network was commissioned and funded.

No Peace.o: In Winter 384YE five Imperial armies drove the Lasambrian Jotun out of Kahraman, which they abandoned with little resistance and retreated to Reinos. Meanwhile Mathilda Fisher held Bregasland under Jotun protection, and a Jotun host conquered almost all of Liathaven, bringing them back to the threshold of the Mournwold.

No evil shall escape our sight.o: The Silent Bell, a Vigilance sodality officially disbanded in 210YE but still quietly active, offered its investigative services formally to the Imperial Synod. At the Winter solstice the Synod declared its support, the Council of the Nine gave its first instruction, and a mandate endorsing the sodality was executed.

Not a drop to drink.o: A Winter-fuelled blight continued to threaten the Great Grasses of Madruga, held back only by repeated castings of Regrow the Land's Heart. The Sentinel Gate offered three conjunctions into the blight at the Summer Solstice to further the search for a permanent cure.

Not dark yet.o: After the Iron Helms' cruelty against the Jotun, several national assemblies were offered Synod mandates to shun or support the Varushkan army at the Summer Solstice 381YE. Wintermark, the Freeborn, Navarr and Varushka each enacted one.

Not from the benevolence.o: In Autumn 388YE the heralds of Ephisis, the City of Gold and Lead, returned with new trade offers: a proposed sale of the Reikos fortification of Remember Exile, seven bulk contracts for auction, invitations for chosen citizens to submit contracts, and completed plans for three Autumn market fanes in Hercynia, Kallavesa and the Barrens.

Not to conquer.o: Following the Barrens' assignment to Dawn, Dawnish and Highborn priests opened talks with the territory's septs, each of which set out what 'liberation' should mean for them. The Wind set out Senate, Synod, Military Council and Conclave options for answering their demands, along with the risks of each.

Nothing great without cost.o: Imperatrix Lisabetta used the Throne's power to address the Empire, sending a personal letter from her guildhouse in Holfried weighing the cost of the Empire's many wars against its ambitions, chiefly the Liberty Pact and an end to the Grendel threat.

Nowhere and everywhere.o: After the Autumn Equinox, six eternals answered the archmages' plenipotentiary messages. Five arranged parleys or meetings with the Empire for the Winter Solstice, and Rhianos declined a parley but offered aid instead.

O rose thou art sick.o: In Summer 380YE a suspected Night curse inflamed resentment in Astolat, particularly among yeofolk and Dawnish soldiers, while other curses brought a sapping heat to Tassato, drought to Casinea and continued decay to the Court of the White Fountain in Redoubt.

Obsidian shards.o: In Winter 386YE a renegade faction of former rebels, the sentinels of the Spire of Black Glass, slaughtered a merchant caravan and the Urizen spire of the Prismatic Garden in Spiral, then moved against the Block and a group of Black Plateau researchers. Two conjunctions gave Imperial heroes the chance to stop them.

Of earth and sky.o: In Autumn 384YE five Imperial armies, both Freeborn armies and all three Navarr armies, overwhelmed the Lasambrian Jotun in Kahraman. They reclaimed Jade Range and drove the orcs back into Gambit, even after the Lasambrians had wrecked the mountain roads to isolate Fort Braydon.

Of tribute.o: At the end of Winter 380YE, heralds of the eternals of Winter revealed which peoples had won the boons offered at the Winter Solstice in return for tribute of dragonbone. Thirteen hundred measures were given, most of it by the Empire, but Axos, Jarm and others also claimed powerful gifts.

Oh so intricate.o: In Autumn 382YE the magic that had shielded Imperial traders from Grendel pirates faded, citadels were conjured across the Empire, and Druj star-shrouds and Imperial veils persisted. A curse struck Segura, and eternals including Meraud, Kimus, Leviathan, Irra Harah and Sadogua made offers and challenges, Sadogua raging at the Druj burning of the Halls of Knowledge.

Old blue banners dancing.o: In Spring 388YE six Imperial armies drove the Jotun out of Gravenmarch in Bregasland after a costly campaign, pushing into the edge of the Rushes. Graven Rock roared during the final battle, and overnight a forest grew from the bodies of the fallen.

Old ways.o: Following the restoration of the Speaker of the Highborn Assembly in Summer 383YE, other national assemblies began considering similar leadership titles. Specific opportunities emerged for the League, Wintermark, the Marches and Varushka.

On southern sands.o: In Winter 386YE the Grendel and then the Children of Wrecks attacked the southern coast of Redoubt. Three Imperial armies, backed by heavy Imperial magic, repulsed both assaults on the harbour of Elos, but at a steep cost.

On the outside looking inside.o: In Spring 384YE the Empire's foreign relations were in flux: the Imperial Consulate was completed in Tassato, the Liberty Pact delegates gathered at Anvil, the Principalities of Jarm issued an ultimatum, and the Thule took regions ceded to them by treaty.

On the road ahead.o: Freed for once from immediate threat, the people of Anduz in Segura sought a new future for their ruined city, and the Brass Coast was offered four edifice commissions, each paired with a Freeborn National Assembly mandate, that could recast Anduz's fate. The Assembly passed the mandates for the Cities of Deals, Passions and Wonders, and construction of the grand City of Wonders project began in Summer 388YE.

On wings aspire.o: In Spring 381YE the Winds of Fortune brought rumours of upheaval in the Summer realm's Forest of Arden, a bounty from the eternal Roshanwe on pawns of the Whisper Gallery, a strange butterfly-filled citadel in Bregasland's marshes, and a conjunction of the Wanderer with the Chalice wherever stars still shone.

One last song.o: In Winter 384YE more than three hundred Imperial champions, sustained by Rhianos' golden cauldron at the Broch, explored the vallorn of Brocéliande. They drove out the Druj, destroyed the last Heirs of Terunael stronghold, reached the ruins of Terunael and looked upon its vallornheart before the cauldron's power faded.

One more day's light.o: In Spring 383YE the Druj threatened to torture and kill Dawnish prisoners in Dawnguard if any Imperial army entered the Mallum. At the same time, the Spring eternal Irra Harah, newly granted amity, offered secret routes for a raid into the Barrens to rescue the children of Dawn and other slaves.

One of us.o: In Winter 386YE the Empire's effort to spread the Way to Asavea reached a crossroads. The Sevenfold Path found three groups of Asavean magicians who might be won over, the Assembly of Loyalty was offered two competing strategies, and the Whisper Gallery warned that one of the three groups planned to betray the Empire.

One side stone, one side fire.o: The koboldi of Adamant completed the Red Iron Door, a great rune-marked mithril gate meant to seal the trogoni-infested sinkhole known as Lorenzo's Deep Pockets. The Empire was offered the chance to fight its way into the depths so the door could be installed, with deeper progress bringing richer rewards.

Only forward.o: In Summer 386YE the Jotun armies the Fist of Ulven and the Southern Bear marched north from Liathaven and conquered Gravenmarch in Bregasland, taking Graven Rock and the town of Graven and executing the Navarr they found there.

Other monstrous geographies.o: In Spring 388YE five Imperial armies, aided by the Axou of Ipotavo, took Sephals and stormed the Tower of the Skink, ending Druj dominion over the Sarangrave, while the Gryphon's Pride saved the Nesustak rebels. In retaliation the Tainted Basilisk broke the wards of Béantal Dol and unleashed its vallorn.

Our choice.o: Following the Varushkan National Assembly's mandates, all Varushkan armies came to share the penalties for fighting alongside Wintermark and Brass Coast armies, while the Northern Eagle and Golden Axe were offered a one-season chance to embrace their Ushkan and Vard heritage. The Golden Axe took the Driven quality and the Senate commissioned its enlargement.

Our elaborate plans.o: In Spring 388YE the strange night magic and dramaturgical effects gripping Apulian grew more turbulent after the Chamber of Euphony, Sung's new fane, was completed. Sung's heralds sought military units to map the City Below, while the duSesna Guild sought help to find their missing merchant prince.

Our eyes in Spiral.o: The Vigilant followers of Berechiah, sent to Spiral by the Vigilance Assembly in Spring 386YE, reported back after a year of thorough and largely undisruptive investigation. They found no active threats at the Black Plateau or among the rebels, but uncovered signs of a Grendel espionage ring in Apulus.

Our thumping hearts.o: The tourney to decide which eternal would become patron of the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun, the Empire's Summer college, was set to take place in the Glory Square, with around a dozen eternals from Summer and other realms fielding teams of Imperial magicians.

Ourselves and immortality.o: Ahead of the Winter Solstice 387YE, six eternals answered the plenipotentiary messages of the Imperial archmages. Five arranged parleys or meetings at Anvil, while Adamant declined a formal parley and instead made proposals about ritual magic.

Out of the abyss.o: After the Varushkan Assembly urged priests to aid the miners building the Deep Chamber, the ancient sovereign called the Night Below grew more active beneath Varushka's northern mountains. A lightstone trade with Urizen and a joint great work were proposed, and the sovereign offered to destroy the Shepherds of Ash in return for a price.

Out of the realm.o: The Summer 384YE Wind of Fortune reported the magical consequences of the Spring Equinox across the Empire. These included new fortifications and veils, an enchanted Skarsind, Tamazi joining the Imperial Orcs, eternal patronages, ultimatums and grievances, a ghostly conjunction in Hahnmark, and the discovery of long-missing sorcerers dead in Temeschwar.

Out of these convertites.o: After the League and Marcher assemblies endorsed a pilgrimage at the Summer Solstice, Leaguish priests and orcs spent the autumn of 388YE in the Mournwold. They helped bring in the harvest and learned how the Marcher orcs hear their ancestors, chiefly through foot-the-ball.

Out of void, out of chaos.o: During Autumn 381YE the Wanderer hung in the constellation of the Great Wyrm, bringing dreams of transformation and altering powerful night rituals for the coming Autumn Equinox. Meanwhile, the heralds of the night eternals Murit and Soghter were withdrawing from the Empire and their regio became sealed.

Outreach across the marshes.o: In Autumn 388YE the merchant princes of the League, led by Lia Adelaar von Holberg, visited Misericorde to persuade the Sand Fishers sept to join the Empire. They identified the sept's sticking points, and the sept's leaders agreed to discuss them at Anvil.

Outside the wall.o: Commissioned by the Senate at the Winter Solstice, the Highborn prognosticator Naomi of Virtue's Rest appraised how displaced Varushkans might be drawn to Delev in Karov, and how the town's prosperity and safety could be built up. She proposed warding its walls, building a great market and founding an assayer's office to rival Temeschwar, and she reported on the unsolved disappearance of Duzekani's bees.

Over western hills.o: In Winter 386YE the Jotun pressed to take all of the Mournwold, but Imperial armies holding Freemoor and two forces striking into Southmoor liberated Sarcombe, drove the Jotun armies back into Liathaven and returned the Mournwold to Imperial control. Jarl Haakon refused to withdraw and now holds Farstrider's Watch in the Greensward.

Parched earth.o: Lutomysla Niegoslava's Senate-commissioned appraisal of the Blight in Madruga, worked with the Unfettered Mind, set out how to halt, end and heal the curse. It identified three rune-marked Dry Patricians threatening neighbouring regions and proposed a Grand Lodge for the Silver Chalice.

Part of this together.o: In Winter 385YE the Synod's replacement of the Doctrine of Human Destiny with the Doctrine of Enlightenment, which recognises orcs and humans as equals in the Way, was embraced across the Empire with little opposition. It spread swiftly through all ten nations and sharply reduced prejudice against orcs.

Parts of speech.o: After the Winter Solstice mandates, Imperial missionaries spread the Doctrine of Enlightenment abroad, winning interest in the Sarcophan Delves but angering the Sumaah and provoking Asavea to execute nearly thirty Imperial priests. Meanwhile the Free Folk settled in Dawn as Imperial citizens.

Patterns of fairytales.o: A Winter 386YE grab-bag of magical happenings across the Empire, chiefly the Silver Chalice's relief of the Scorrero flood victims, a Grand Conjunction that permanently disabled warlike arcane projections, and a series of eternal and herald visits and offers.

Pay in blood.o: Shortly after the Spring Equinox, Imperial magicians found they could no longer draw on the power of any Spring regio for ritual magic. Historians found a precedent from Empress Deanne's reign, when the Empire lost access to Winter regio for a year after Highborn magisters disrupted a formal parley with the eternal Agramant.

Peace song.o: In Autumn 380YE heralds of the eternal Lashonar flooded Dawn with mournful songs against the war in the Barrens, sapping the morale of all four Dawnish armies. The Conclave stripped Lashonar of amity and the Dawnish National Assembly countered the songs, ending the effect by the Winter Solstice.

Peaks and planes.o: In Summer 386YE the Marcher and Urizen National Assemblies were offered competing Synod mandates for a pilgrimage exchange to mend relations after the Cold Sun affair. Meanwhile a growing rift opened between the Marcher Assembly and ordinary Marchers over the condemned landskeeper covens who cursed Urizen.

Pebbles drawn from a heap.o: After the peace treaty ceded all of Spiral to the Grendel, Salt Lord Kaliact and the Urizen reached a compromise: Spiral's citizens would ward only her palace in Apulian with the Block's mithril wards, and the Citadel Guard could again be supported. The page also set out several time-limited Grendel trade, envoy and magical opportunities, and announced a diplomatic visit over an assault in Anvil.

Permit Great Forest Orcs to work the Thi.o: In Autumn 381YE the Senate passed a motion accepting the Great Forest Orcs' offer to work the Thimble, the weirwood groves of Therunin, in return for four wains of weirwood each season.

Permit dredging of Feverwater.o: In Summer 377YE the Senate passed, by 26 votes to 1, a motion permitting Meryl of Navarr to scout and then dredge the Feverwater, a lake partly within Therunin, for materials using riverboats.

Petals in the snow.o: Rival Sarcophan merchants, the Kraft Brothers and the Zuredruiven vintners, had both invested in Hahnmark's farms. After being kept from discovering each other at the Winter Solstice, Hahnmark's farmers were offered a choice over which partnership, if either, to keep.

Phantasms and foam.o: In Summer 388YE the Red Wind Corsairs pushed deep into the strange, Night-touched Siroc Bayou, where phantasms slowed their advance. The Iron Confederacy, aided by Freeborn corsairs, conquered Free Landing and destroyed the Children of Wrecks.

Pieces missing everywhere.o: Buoyed by Pride in recent victories, the Highborn Assembly passed three mandates with greater majorities, softening prejudice against lineaged and orcs, spurring religious construction, and granting the Assembly new powers to aid or answer other nations. Other assemblies faced proposals either to refuse Highborn aid or to reciprocate it, while Highborn generals opened contact with the Vendarri and the chance to clear the last Druj miasma from Zenith.

Pilgrimage.o: In Autumn 380YE, after the Synod's backing, Jared of the Suns of Couros and others spread word across the Empire of the First Empress reborn in Yael and of the Land Without Tears. A growing tide of pilgrims set out for Reikos and Casinea to hear her preach.

Pitiless as the sun.o: In spring 382YE a range of magical phenomena were reported across the Empire and beyond. Stars stayed missing over Druj-held and threatened lands, penumbral veils lay over several territories, Weirwater was cursed with the name Edric de Gauvain, and Llofir sealed Tamarbode in response to the Conclave's enmity.

Pitter patter.o: Through the summer of 386YE a magically influenced rat plague continued to beset Temeschwar, and the Unfettered Mind traced it to a previously unknown power called the King of Rats, which had apparently devoured the volodny Shadowsmith. Meanwhile, a separate and intelligent menace sickened workers at Lorenzo's Deep Pockets.

Poetry and prose.o: In Summer 386YE the Barrens settled into an uneasy calm under Dawnish rule, and several Dawnish opportunities arose: three rival proposals to rebuild the ruined Towers of Dawn, a Synod mandate to consecrate the Spires of Dusk to Ambition, and a chapel to strengthen the true aura at the Shrine of Hope. Meanwhile the Navarr swore oaths to protect the Great Forest Orcs as the Druj invaded Therunin.

Poets light but lamps.o: A diplomatic roundup reported on the Empire's neighbours. Faraden helped the Empire against the Cinders after their attacks on Imperial sites, and offered trade and a joint campaign against the Jotun. The Iron Confederacy seized the Cazar Straits, the Sumaah and Frieøyer completed the work of the Zemress Naval Academy, and Tsark and Skoura made cautious offers of their own.

Point of the spear.o: Before the Spring Equinox summit of 383YE the prognosticators listed the conjunctions they had found through the Sentinel Gate. They offered strikes against the Jotun, Grendel, Druj, vallorn, Feni and other threats across the Empire.

Poor boy.o: Four opportunities arose ahead of the Winter Solstice at Anvil: a poor clam diver sought to sell a powerful Spring-aligned pearl, a Navarri vate hunted pages of The Book of the Stars, a merrow captain brought a salvaged Freeborn warship to auction, and Jarmish envoys from Kobarid offered enchanted star jewels.

Possibility days.o: Several hundred Suranni magicians and their families fled persecution in the Iron Confederacy and reached the Empire, hidden by a magical fog along the south-western border, with no sign so far of any diplomatic incident. Their arrival raised questions about where they would settle and what dangers might come with them.

Power, corruption, and lies.o: In Autumn 383YE a conjunction of the Great Wyrm, the Drowned Shepherd and the Claw strengthened destructive enchantments, while magical castles, a lingering curse, shrouded skies, Summer frost giants sent to Wintermark and a crop of eternal opportunities shaped the season across the Empire.

Praise and blame.o: After the Urizen, Highborn and Dawnish assemblies joined Navarr and Varushka in endorsing cruelty in war, inspired by the Iron Helms, several time-limited opportunities arose for national assemblies to make their armies more ruthless. None took effect: the Navarri and Varushkan mandates failed, and the upheld Urizen mandate was declined by its priest.

Price of experience.o: In Spring 381YE the Great Forest orcs camped in Therunin's Lower Tarn Valley neared the end of their patience and began preparing to break camp. They announced a final delegation to Anvil to seek an accord with the Empire.

Price of prosperity.o: In Winter 379YE the Sumaah Republic expelled every Imperial citizen from Zemeh, declared war on the Empire and denounced the entire Synod as heretical. The same Trade Winds reported cooling relations with the Commonwealth and Asavea and tentative progress with Jarm.

Pride and paragons.o: After the Synod renounced Vardas as a paragon of Vigilance in Autumn 386YE, the faithful began asking deeper questions about the nature of paragons and exemplars. The Lepidean Library's archivists threatened to quit, and confidence in the Grand Inspiration of the Way in Bastion faltered.

Pride and prejudice.o: After Varushkan and Highborn mandates urged peaceful contact with the orcs who share Varushka, cautious overtures to the Thule and independent orc septs produced several trade opportunities and competing mandates. The Senate later built the High Path, and the Leshun Market was commissioned.

Pride in the Marches.o: In the summer of 388YE the Jotun abandoned Mitwold, leaving a looted Meade to welcome the Drakes, while blood-sailed Fjorknae warships appeared in the Gullet and ghosts haunted the Grey Fens. The Marches also weighed folk heroes, Rebellion's Ridge, defending Marcher orcs against heresy charges, and rowdy scions of Red Walder.

Pride of the Marches.o: The heralds of the eternal Kimus, sent by the Imperial Conclave, found Tom Drake's vorpal sword hanging over the fireplace of his descendant William Drake in Upwold. William will give it only to the General of the Drakes, and only if the Empire meets certain conditions.

Professional killers.o: In Autumn 379YE, Senate-funded bodyguards foiled three further assassination attempts against civil servants of the department of historical research, and one assassin, revealed to be a herald, was captured. It was later confirmed as an agent of the Eternal council known as the Whisper Gallery.

Promises to keep.o: In Summer 379YE a small Thule delegation came down from Otkodov to Wendell's Hope in Miekarova under a flag of truce, seeking to parley with the Empire at Anvil in the name of Orobus the Chained. It was later received at Anvil, where a peace treaty was presented to the Senate.

Promising light.o: Following her coronation at the Autumn Equinox, the civil service distributed Emperor Vesna Borkovna Prochnost's inaugural address across the Empire, sparking breath-taking celebrations and a renewed sense of optimism. Her call for unity and for the Empire to unite the world under the Way opened new opportunities in troubled lands and revived support for the Holy City at Bastion.

Propensity to truck, barter, and exchang.o: Ephisis, Sovereign Lady of the City of Gold and Lead, announced changes to trading through Ephisis' Scale after price problems at the Spring Equinox. Eight large contracts would be auctioned in the Hall of Worlds, alongside published price guidance and an offer to discuss patronage of the Golden Pyramid.

Propose treaty of limited warfare to the.o: In Spring 378YE the Senate rejected a motion to open communications with the Jotun proposing that fighting be restricted to Mournwold and Liathaven, an amendment to the existing Jotun ceasefire.

Prospecting in Skarsind.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 385YE inviting human prospectors and mining experts to explore the northern hills of Skarsind and work the Imperial Orc mines, at a cost of 100 thrones funded by Irontide Flax.

Protect or punish.o: Ahead of the Winter Solstice 382YE, the civil service published the Sentinel Gate conjunctions it had found. They offered chances to fight vallorn swarms in Brocéliande, free captives in Redoubt and Morrow, harry the Druj in Ossium and strike Jotun raiders in Sermersuaq. It also reported a dark stirring in Estmure tied to the Eater-of-Hope.

Proud to serve.o: Imperatrix Lisabetta lent her power to address the Empire to the Imperial Warmage, Heilyn Bronwen's Rest, who spoke to all citizens about the strain of funding strategic magic, the grave costs of recent ritual decisions such as those in the Mournwold, and the founding of the Order of the Silver Chalice.

Provide aid to the Hierro Clan.o: In Autumn 379YE the Senate passed a motion authorising the civil service to provide aid to the Hierro clan refugees camped in Segura, at an upkeep of 75 thrones per season.

Pruning shears.o: Following Synod judgements honouring the little-known Marcher exemplar "Major" Joshua Benson, a Sentinel Gate conjunction opened to his grave-orchard at Pickham Monastery so it could be consecrated to Vigilance. The Wind of Fortune also set out proposed mandates for unleashing threshers and others against the Whisper Gallery.

Push for victory.o: In his Spring 388YE Throne address, Emperor Vesna announced the early completion of the third League army and urged a final push against the Druj. Citizens across the Empire rallied in response, producing a series of opportunities for the war and beyond.

Put on your war paint.o: Several national assemblies were offered Synod mandates to reshape their armies after statements of principle at the Summer Solstice 382YE. The Freeborn could support reviving the historical Burning Falcon army, the Marches and Dawn could refine their armies' qualities, and Wintermark could widen its condemnation of dishonourable tactics.

Queens and kings.o: Several Summer eternals approached the Empire. A Tourney of Sun and Ice was held to settle patronage of the Icy Crag of the Eternal Sun, and King Adamant sent his koboldi to offer help expanding Imperial mines. Eleonaris's champions won the tourney, and the Grandmaster of the Golden Pyramid accepted Adamant's offer.

Questions of virtue.o: After the Jotun quit Kahraman, leaving only champions to die defending Fort Braydon, the Brass Coast faced a choice over how to treat their bodies. Highguard was offered a way to aid the Freeborn, Tharim offered his knights to the Fire of the South, and the Freeborn weighed naming customs and corsair vengeance on Asavea.

Quietude.o: In Winter 387YE the Barrens grew quieter as Druj influence faded. The Karass handed over two members accused of betraying the Last Battle wayhouse to the Druj, while a Dawnish Autumn enchantment brought prosperity to most of the territory's other inhabitants.

Rabbits and snares.o: After the Summer Solstice, three eternals publicly answered the archmages' plenipotentiary messages. Irra Harah and the Lictors agreed to formal parleys at the Autumn Equinox, and Zakalwe offered an informal discussion.

Rain king.o: After the Sails of the First Flame cast Hallow of the Green World at the Winter Solstice, the eternal Ossegrahn, guided by a plenipotentiary from Archmage of Spring Ibiss Briarheart, sent heralds across the Empire offering healing, help to farmers and several building opportunities.

Raise Autumn Hammers.o: In Autumn 385YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a third Imperial Orc army, the Autumn Hammers, from the Ethengraw sept in Skarsind.

Raise Dawnish army.o: A Senate motion to raise a fourth Dawnish army in Astolat, proposed by the senator for Semmerholm and seconded by Weirwater, was defeated.

Raise Dawnish army II.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Weirwater and seconded by Morrow, permitting the Dawnish to raise a new army mustering in Semmerholm.

Raise Dawnish army Summer 385YE.o: In Summer 385YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the Senator for Astolat, to raise a fourth Dawnish army. After a year of donated materials it was completed as the Lions of Adelmar.

Raise Fifth Marcher Army.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a fifth Marcher army in Upwold, proposed by Henry Birchsmith, Senator for Upwold, and seconded by Mary Birchsmith, Senator for Mitwold.

Raise Fourth Highborn Army.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Casinea and seconded by Bastion, to raise a fourth Highborn army in Casinea. Once completed, the new army was named the Pilgrim's Defiance.

Raise Fourth Navarr Army.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a fourth Navarr army, mustering in Oakways in Miaren, intended to fight the vallorn with the support of an eternal such as Llofir or Kaela.

Raise Fourth Varushkan Army.o: In Summer 388YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a fourth Varushkan army in Karsk, with Varushka seeking Senate funding for the work.

Raise Freeborn navy.o: In Winter 378YE the Senate passed a motion to build a new Imperial navy for the Brass Coast at the Atalaya shipyards in Madruga.

Raise Highborn army.o: In Spring 382YE the Senate passed a motion to recruit a fourth Highborn army in Reikos, proposed by the senator for Reikos and seconded by the senator for Necropolis.

Raise Highguard army.o: In Winter 376YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a new Highborn army to muster in Anvil under a Highguard general, with the funds distributed to Necropolis.

Raise Second Urizen Army.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion to raise a second Urizen army, the Argent Sword, in Redoubt. The 300 mithril and 900 crowns it needed were paid by individual contributors.

Raise Third League Army.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Tassato and seconded by the Conscience of the Senate, to raise a third League army in Tassato. Fully funded through public donations, it mustered as the Sparrows Reckoning shortly before the Summer Solstice 388YE.

Raise Third Navarr Army.o: In Spring 387YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a third Imperial Navarr army, to muster in Treji in the Glen of Shadows, Hercynia, paid for by self-funding at a cost of 200 wains of mithril and 75 thrones.

Raise Third Varushkan Army.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Karsk and seconded by Karov, to raise a third Varushkan army in Karov to replace losses on the Eastern front. Once fully funded and completed, it was raised as the Boyar's Hasta.

Raise Thornbound Army of Navarr.o: In Summer 383YE the Senate passed in principle a motion to commission a third Navarr army, mustered in Miaren with the Thornbound quality, taking up an opportunity presented by the Navarr vates.

Raise Towerjacks army.o: In Summer 379YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Sarvos and seconded by Holberg, to restore the Towerjacks to full fighting strength as an Imperial League army, approving 200 Thrones for the work.

Raise Varushkan army.o: In Autumn 379YE the Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by Karov and seconded by Necropolis, to commission a new Imperial Varushkan army, the Iron Helms, to muster in Karsk, the Broken Barrow.

Raise Wintermark army.o: A Senate motion proposed by the senator for Hahnmark and seconded by Bregasland sought to raise a new Wintermark army, reforming the Bloodcloaks as a force rich in grimnir. It was withdrawn after a motion allowing the Dawnish to raise an army passed.

Raise Wintermark army II.o: In Summer 380YE the Senate passed in principle a motion, proposed by Hahnmark and seconded by Skarsind, to levy a new Wintermark army, following an earlier version of the motion that had been withdrawn.

Raise a glass.o: In the summer of 380YE the Empire prepared to celebrate the coronation of a new Empress from the League, and the Senate was offered the chance to fund grand celebrations. Alongside the festivities, the Throne could issue a celebratory message to rally the citizens behind her vision. The Senate voted 40 thrones and appointed Tassato's senator to oversee the preparations.

Raise fourth Wintermark army.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Hahnmark and seconded by the senator for Sermersuaq, to raise a fourth Wintermark army in Sermersuaq, citing the consecration of the Kallavesa marshes in support.

Ratify Axos Treaty Autumn 387YE.o: The Imperial Senate passed a motion in Autumn 387YE ratifying a treaty with Axos, under which Axos committed the Shield of Ipotavo to the conquest of the Sarangrave in exchange for Imperial recognition of its claim to Thornfen.

Ratify Coiled Krait Treaty.o: In Summer 387YE the Senate considered a motion, proposed by Karov and seconded by Karsk, to ratify a treaty with the Coiled Krait, a Druj sept formerly of the Banded Snake clan. The motion failed.

Ratify Sungold Treaty.o: In Summer 383YE the Senate passed a motion ratifying a treaty with the Thule, drawn up by Ambassador to Otkodov Yevgeni Katzev, ceding the Sungold Pass and paying 300 Thrones in return for the release of Imperial captives and Thule defence of Ossium.

Ratify Thule Treaty Spring 387YE.o: The Senate ratified a treaty with the Thule of Otkodov in Spring 387YE, presented by the Ambassador to Otkodov. It ceded the Mieriada region of Miekarova and committed Imperial food supplies in exchange for resources and a five-year peace.

Ratify Thule peace treaty.o: In Summer 382YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Holberg and seconded by Hahnmark, ratifying a five-year peace treaty with the Thule of Otkodov presented by the Ambassador to Otkodov.

Ratify treaty with Salt Lord Kaliact.o: In Winter 384YE the Ambassador to the Grendel presented the Senate with a treaty with Salt Lord Kaliact, covering peace with the Grendel of Spiral, and the Senate rejected it.

Ratify treaty with Salt Lord Kaliact Spr.o: The Senate ratified a treaty agreed at the Spring Equinox 385YE under which Salt Lord Kaliact ceded the territory of Spiral and all its holdings to the Empire.

Ratify treaty with Thule Winter 383YE.o: The Senate ratified a treaty with the Thule of Otkodov, ceding the regions of Webwood in Ossium and Miechernya in Miekarova in exchange for three Thule armies to fight alongside the Empire against the Jotun in Sermersuaq for a year.

Ratify treaty with the Axos Autumn 383YE.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate passed a treaty with Axos, proposed by the senator for Therunin, committing the Empire to share maps, intelligence, defence arrangements, academic exchange and land rights with the Axou.

Ratify treaty with the Grendel Autumn 38.o: In Autumn 383YE the Senate ratified a peace treaty with the Grendel, presented by the Imperial Fleet Master, ceding five regions in Feroz and Spiral in exchange for two years of peace, the release of Imperial slaves and a Grendel pledge not to aid the Druj.

Ratify treaty with the Iron Confederacy.o: The Senate ratified a treaty with the Iron Confederacy, prepared by Ambassador Lord Colwynn de Rondell, under which the Empire provided maps of the Bay of Catazar and banned the sale or gifting of liao to the Confederacy.

Ratify treaty with the Sarcophan Delves.o: The Senate passed a treaty with the Sarcophan Delves, presented by the Ambassador to the Sarcophan Delves, conceding the Alivetti estate in Sarvos to the Delves as an enclave for the Bedelaar Huisbaas Vandersaar.

Reap what you sow.o: In Autumn 379YE the miners of Skarsind, believing their lands were soon to be handed to the Imperial Orcs, began strip-mining to take what they felt they were owed before leaving. Wintermark's National Assembly and the Assembly of Loyalty condemned the practice as unvirtuous, curbing it at a cost to local morale.

Rebellion's Ridge.o: With Rebellion's Ridge completed in honour of the leaders of the Ore Hills Rebellion, the Pride Assembly upheld a writ of consecration, leaving the General Assembly to decide at the Autumn Equinox 388YE whether to consecrate it with true liao. Either choice would inflame the centuries-old feud between the miners and farmers of the Mournwold.

Rebels and loyalists.o: After the Autumn Equinox 386YE, two Synod developments unsettled the Marches: the Pride Assembly's recognition of the six leaders of the Ore Hills Rebellion as exemplars, and the Marcher Assembly's revocation of Hal Talbot as Senator for Mitwold for apparent disloyalty to the nation.

Rebirth in Reikos.o: In Summer 380YE, as a wave of fungal new life swept Reikos, the Synod-authorised priests Yael and Jared of the Suns of Couros preached that Yael was the First Empress reborn, drawing Golan's followers away and forming the Congregation of the First Empress.

Rebuild Aleksandra's Watch.o: In Winter 381YE the Senate passed a motion to undertake reconstruction work on Aleksandra's Watch, a fortress in Karsk, at a cost of 20 Thrones.

Rebuild Binding Oak Spire.o: In Autumn 388YE the Senate passed a commission to rebuild the Binding Oak Spire, an edifice in Proceris, Zenith. The spire increases the output of the Arch of the Sky quarry and lets its custodian buy more white granite.

Rebuild Drycastle.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion to rebuild the town of Drycastle in Dawnguard, the Barrens, after its liberation from the Druj. The motion also created the titles of Knight of Dawnguard and Reeve of Drycastle.

Rebuild First Voice Glade.o: Nemae Splitroot, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave, announced a great work to rebuild the ruined First Voice Glade and School in Oakways, Miaren, as an inspirational site honouring Gerallt Brackensong, exemplar of Pride.

Rebuild Great Library of Ankarien.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 387YE to rebuild the Great Library of Ankarien on its original site in Ankra, Spiral, fulfilling an ambition two centuries old.

Rebuild Roads of Kahraman.o: In Spring 385YE the Senate passed a motion to rebuild the roads of Kahraman and build a series of Kamkrag across the territory, following the Time and time again wind of fortune. Despite delays and theft by Lasambrian Jotun raiders, the project was eventually completed.

Rebuild the Colossus of Sarvos.o: In Winter 381YE a Senate motion to repair the damaged Colossus of Sarvos passed, announced by Shauni di Vergo as bearer of an Imperial Wayleave.

Rebuild the Storm Vault.o: In Summer 386YE the Storm Vault in Proceris, Zenith, a mana sinecure the Druj had sacked and turned into an infested vault, was rebuilt following the Write your own ending wind of fortune.

Rebuild the Towers of Anduz.o: The Senate gave permission in principle to restore the Towers of Anduz in Segura, a great work intended to promote trade and good relations with the Faraden; no funding was requested from the Imperial treasury.

Rebuild the roads of Karsk.o: In Autumn 379YE the Senate passed a motion to commission a great work rebuilding the devastated road network of Karsk, intended to boost the territory's mines and forests and allow Varushka to support a third army.

Received with a strange delight.o: At the Summer Solstice 384YE, several groups of visitors made their way to Anvil, including an Axou narcotics trader, Axou travellers claiming Terunael descent, former Free Mark fighters from Sermersuaq, Urizeni refugees, a pair of Grendel traders on an urgent errand and a Sarvosan art guild's merchant prince.

Reclaimers.o: With the Druj driven from Holberg and the animate trees subsided, Holberg faced widespread devastation in Spring 380YE, and its citizens put forward rival proposals to clear the ruins of Holmauer, rebuild and expand the territory's walls, and manage the spreading Morass. Unnatural briars also continued to grip the northern forests.

Recognise Sand Fishers as foreigners.o: In Winter 382YE the Senate passed a motion declaring that those Sand Fishers of Ossium who wished to remain part of their tribe were foreigners rather than enemies of the Empire.

Recognise ducal quality.o: In Summer 381YE the Senate passed a motion recognising the ducal quality of Kalino of the Iron Confederacy and calling for an ongoing dialogue to the benefit of both nations.

Recognise the House of Guiscard.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 381YE recognising the Iron Confederacy's House of Guiscard as the rulers of Kalino, reaffirming a similar motion from the Summer Solstice.

Reconstruct Gardens of Pallas.o: In Summer 385YE an Imperial Wayleave was used to commission the reconstruction of the Gardens of Pallas in Proceris, Zenith, creating a sinecure under the Restoration and renewal wind of fortune. The work was completed after a year of donations.

Reconstruct Golden Cascade.o: In Winter 384YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by Mournwold and seconded by Zenith, to reconstruct the Golden Cascade in Proceris, Zenith, following the Write your own ending wind of fortune.

Reconstruct Starlight Drift of Shimmerin.o: The Legion Engineer, Bleakshield Groza, announced the commission of a mana sinecure, the Starlight Drift of Shimmering Snow, at Endsmeet in Zenith, following the Write your own ending Wind of Fortune. It was completed after the Summer Solstice 385YE.

Reconstruct the Tower of the Fall.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 385YE to reconstruct the Tower of the Fall in Occursion, Zenith, as a mana sinecure joined to the Proffered Hand network, self-funded by Herminius of the Temple of the Wanderer.

Red phoenix down.o: An unknown party placed the Urizeni territories of Morrow, Redoubt and Zenith under the Winter curse Icy Maw Devours the Spark of Essence. Cold rain fell, Urizen's magicians suffered a debilitating malaise, and every mana site produced only half its usual crystal mana.

Red skies.o: In Winter 387YE the Red Wind Corsairs, joined by over a hundred and fifty Imperial ships, destroyed the Gathered Storm, the navy of the Children of Wrecks, off Sarvos and in Calvos Sound, capturing its flagship. Meanwhile a Suranni navy and two armies from the Iron Confederacy crushed the Wreckers in the Cazar Straits and claimed the islands.

Red star.o: In Winter 379YE the constellation of the Phoenix began to seem to waver and wane, a tiny new star was seen following the Wanderer, and houses of healing across the Empire and beyond reported a rise in madness.

Redesign Pallas Docks.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion to redesign the unused Pallas Docks ministry in Limus, Redoubt, so that weirwood could be bought from the Sarcophan Delves, renaming it the Debruin Docks.

Reed of fortune.o: In Autumn 379YE Reed, the Reckoner of Hours and herald of the eternal Ephisis, moved through the Empire conducting an apparent audit of its wealth-producers. He then asked the Conclave for one hour of amity so that he could address it. The Conclave granted the amity, heard him, and then returned him to neutrality.

Reestablish Herds of Afar.o: In Winter 386YE the Senate passed a motion to restore the herds of Afar in Afarjasse, Feroz, at a cost of 300 crowns, and to create the Dhomiro of Afar to oversee them. The motion followed the 'Send for me' Wind of Fortune.

Refusal of the ceding of territories to.o: In Spring 380YE the Senate passed a motion refusing to cede the Freeborn territories of Segura and Feroz to the Hierro Clan, who had laid claim to them.

Reikos flux.o: In Summer 379YE a virulent flux broke out in Druj-held Reikos, striking the Imperial armies campaigning there and the local population, amid suspicion that the retreating Druj had turned to foul magics and pestilence.

Relinquish Brilliant Shore.o: The Senate passed a motion, with a constitutional majority and ratified by the Throne, to relinquish the Brilliant Shore, the National Bourse position in Skarsind, making it available for allocation.

Relinquish Skarsind.o: In Spring 379YE the Senate unanimously passed a motion, proposed by the senators of Sermersuaq and Skarsind, renouncing Wintermark's claim to Skarsind so that it could become the first home of the Imperial Orc nation. It required ratification by the Throne and could be vetoed by the Synod, including the Wintermark National Assembly.

Remodel Virtue's Rest.o: The Senate passed a motion in Winter 386YE to remodel Virtue's Rest in Bastion, turning its pilgrim hostels into a place where soldiers of the War of Thorns and Flowers could recover, overseen by a new annually elected Exarch of Virtue's Rest.

Repair Berechiah's Basilica.o: In Autumn 387YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Bastion and seconded by Karsk, to commission repairs to Berechiah's Basilica in Bastion as a rallying point for the vigilant against foreign threats.

Repair Blood Red River Museum.o: In Summer 384YE the Imperial Senate passed a motion to repair and rebuild the Blood Red River Museum in Tassato and to create the tenured title of Curator of the Blood Red River. The work was completed after the Spring Equinox 385YE.

Repair Capodomus Cathedral.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate commissioned the long-overdue repair of the Capodomus Cathedral in Sarvos, damaged during the Grendel sack of the city. The work also created the Archbishop of Capodomus, a sinecure appointed by the League National Assembly.

Repair Celesti Lighthouse.o: The Senate passed a motion in Autumn 387YE to restore the Celesti Lighthouse in Oranseri, Feroz, including a magically infused lamp, a watchstone, empowered by Kimus. It was self-funded by prosperous Brass Coast citizens and has been completed.

Repair Great Pits of Ennerlund.o: The Senate passed a motion, proposed by Sermersuaq and seconded by Mitwold, to repair the Great Pits of Ennerlund in Holberg, which the Druj had collapsed in Winter 378YE. The repairs were funded and the pits were eventually restored to full production.

Repair Holberg defences.o: In Spring 377YE the Senate passed a motion for the emergency repair of the gates and walls of Holberg, and the walls were restored to full strength even though the territory was not then under Imperial control.

Repair the Sapphire Stair.o: In Summer 386YE the Senate passed a motion, proposed by the senator for Tassato and seconded by Karsk, authorising the repair of the Sapphire Stair in Tassato after it was damaged in Eisa Winterborn's raid.

Repair the Spider's Dream.o: In Spring 377YE the Senate passed a motion to repair the Spider's Dream, the decaying bridge linking Sarvos and Madruga, and the work was completed using 20 wains of weirwood.

Repair the cargo dock at Caricomare.o: The Senate passed a motion to repair the cargo dock at Caricomare in Sarvos, damaged during the Grendel invasion of Winter 380YE, so that trade in white granite with Asavea could resume. The work was completed, creating the title Overseer of the Cavabianca Dock.

Repair the docks at Caricomare.o: In Winter 377YE the Senate considered a motion to restore the ruined Caricomare Quays in Sarvos to basic functionality, but it was defeated in principle by 14 votes to 10.

Research Aneira Dancewalker and her brot.o: Eleri Bronwen's Rest, Dredgemaster of Feverwater, commissioned historical research through the civil service into Aneira Dancewalker, believed to have been General of the Quiet Step during the fall of Liathaven, and her brother Eurion, who forged Aneira's Talon.

Research Apaayuqiu King.o: In Winter 380YE the Minister for Historical Research, Ioseph, authorised civil service research into Apaayuqiu King, a figure of pre-Wintermark history in the Sermersuaq area. The inquiry focused on a bronze chain said to mark her position as chief of chiefs.

Research Fire from the Heavens.o: In Winter 381YE Ioseph, Minister of Historical Research, announced a commission to research "Fire from the Heavens", an enchantment associated with an old coven in Willstone, Redoubt.

Research Mfanwy.o: In Autumn 381YE the Dredgemaster of Feverwater commissioned historical research through the civil service into Myfanwy of Hercynia, her travels and her relationships with the First Empress.

Research Sungold Pass.o: In Winter 382YE the Minister of Historical Research announced a commission of historical research into the Sungold Pass mine, which the Thule were laying claim to on the boundary of Otkodov in the eastern foothills of Opascari.

Research the Terunael site of Ghita's Ve.o: In Spring 383YE Harwyn Hollowwatcher, Proxy of Siân Eternal, commissioned the Civil Service to research the Terunael site known as Ghita's Veil in Segura, along with similar locations such as Sobral's Stand.

Research the vallorn for the Academy.o: In Autumn 378YE the Senate passed a motion commissioning the Civil Service to research the origin of the vallorn on behalf of the Academy, at a cost of 5 Thrones.

Resonance and mitigation.o: After the Imperial Conclave upheld declarations at the Summer Solstice 385YE to investigate mitigating the harms of Empire-wide enchantments and to complete the omnihedron sequence, magicians across the Empire questioned the Conclave's judgement. The questions were sharpened by the deadly incursion of Cold Sun's heralds, which was linked to Bright Eyes Gleam in the Depths.

Restoration and renewal.o: In Summer 385YE the Varushkan prognosticator Lutomysla Niegoslava appraised restoring the Gardens of Pallas in Zenith, which the Druj had utterly destroyed. She found nothing left to rebuild but set out several improvements that could be added if the gardens were recommissioned during the Summer Solstice.

Restore the Throne Room.o: In Summer 387YE the Senate passed a motion to restore the throne room of the Castle of Thorns in Withy, Astolat, at a cost of 15 white granite and 45 crowns. The work was completed.

Restraint.o: Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra answered the Senate's request for an appraisal on defending the Empire against raids. She concluded that stopping all raids was impossible but offered partial measures, and Freeborn families warned against further deals with Tharim that drain their Prosperity.

Resupply the Quiet Step.o: In Autumn 377YE the Senate unanimously passed a motion to resupply the Navarr army the Quiet Step with 25 wains of weirwood, funded at 23 thrones, 3 crowns and 10 rings.

Right now.o: Ahead of the Winter Summit 381YE, the Colossus of Sarvos was rammed by a League merchant ship, and the civil service identified Sentinel Gate conjunctions against threats across the Empire. Those threats were drowned dead in Sermersuaq, Grendel raiders in Madruga and Spiral, Druj skirmishers in Semmerholm and Feni bands in Hahnmark and Upwold.

Rimbaud eyes.o: Following Spiral's adoption into the League, the former Grendel followers of Kaliact, now calling themselves Apulians, settled into League life as citizens flooded into Apulus. A contested senatorial election loomed, building costs soared, and the Apulians adapted their faith to the Synod's mixed judgements.

Rings and crowns.o: Highguard's priests continued reaching out to the other nations. The Seventh Wave uncovered a Grendel espionage ring in Necropolis, the last Druj miasma pillars in Zenith were destroyed, and the Constitutional Court stripped three titles of their power to draw on the Virtue Fund.

Ripple of echoes.o: A spring roundup of strange magical happenings across the Empire: Llofir's renewal overran Ossium and Hahnmark, the Night Below pressed on Varushkan lands, Navarr cannibals fled Hercynia, a regio at the Castle of Thorns turned hostile, and a Navarr song kept spreading.

Ripples and shadows.o: In Winter 385YE the Druj were driven from the Barrens. The Great Forest Orcs and the Navarr reclaimed the Heart of Peytaht, and Varushkan armies destroyed the Montanians and beheaded the Black Wind's leadership. Meanwhile the Karass slaughtered the Vendarri of Saltmarsh.

Rise of Terunael.o: In Autumn 383YE the Silent Bell, sent by the Assembly of Nine to investigate the Heirs of Terunael, found the briar-led conspiracy regrouping in Hercynia, Therunin, Liathaven and possibly Sküld to rouse the vallornspawn against the Navarr. The Empire was given a season to prepare a defence before the attacks.

Rise of the Fellowship of Purple Sails.o: In Autumn 379YE the Fellowship of Purple Sails, a new sodality of League and Brass Coast merchants and captains backed by Highborn benefactors, pledged fifty Thrones each season to the Senate for as long as civil servants stayed aboard Imperial fleets. Meanwhile Imperial trade abroad stayed troubled in Jarm, Sumaah and the Commonwealth.

Rising in Runegrott.o: In Autumn 386YE the Rising Tide, a would-be sodality led by Gethyn Blood-and-Sweat, offered several Imperial titles the chance to buy items from the artisans around Isenbrad's shrine in Runegrott for orichalcum or ambergelt. They also arranged for two Great Forest Orcs to meet a Wintermark delegation in Anvil, with Navarri mediation, to talk about weirwood.

Road out of nowhere.o: At the Autumn Equinox 385YE the Senate asked Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra to appraise linking unconnected territories with roads or other transport, and she returned several proposals: highways, marshways, Urizeni skyways, a Barrens road and Navarr roadwardens.

Road to Bramar.o: The Iron Confederacy delivered just short of a hundred freed former Imperial slaves to the port of Bramar in Feroz, in apparent keeping with an agreement with the Imperial Ambassador to the Suranni. Having claimed the conquest of Kalino and so gained a land border with the Empire, the Suranni then requested a closed Senate session at the Winter Solstice to discuss a treaty.

Rock and a hard place.o: After the Conclave gave the cursed Anvil of Silence, dredged from Westmere, to the Autumn eternal Estavus, her heralds dismantled and reclaimed it. Returning the stone voided the ancient bargain with the Marcher smiths, who came home, and the Marcher Assembly then reconciled the nation with their lost tradition.

Rocks and gravel.o: In Summer 381YE a vast sinkhole opened where Miaren, Hahnmark, Temeschwar and Upwold meet, swallowing land and Woodhall and permanently cutting army routes between those territories. It exposed ancient mine workings holding large stockpiles of weltsilver, guarded by angry trogoni.

Roll and fall.o: In Summer 384YE, a Grendel entrepreneur, Paymaster Muireall of the North Mareave Trading Consortium, offered Imperial military units paid work on a raid into the Mountains of the Moon, while the Dawnish Order of the Gilded Sceptre, backed by Purple Sails merchants, sought defenders for the people of Tsark. Both courses were illegal unless the Senate acted.

Root and branch.o: In Summer 387YE two Imperial forces advanced through Sarangrave, taking Turan Flats and Bloodwater Marsh and trapping the Druj armies with the Glass Labyrinth. Meanwhile a Druj host poured out of Therunin, seized Lustri and destroyed Stork's Gaze, and the Sept of Masks raised a colossal 'God in the Lake' in Kroll.

Root hog, or die.o: In Winter 381YE the vallorn of Liathaven stirred and began spreading out of Westwood and Liath's Heart towards West Ranging, because no Navarr steadings or Jotun remained to cut it back. Following the Solstice, the Quiet Step, the Tusks and the Bounders fought the expansion and blunted it.

Rope and iron.o: In Winter 382YE the Empire hosted a summit at Anvil with the Commonwealth, Sumaah, the Sarcophan Delves and Axos to seek a united stand against slavery. It ended with the Senate ratifying the Liberty Pact.

Rose grow the rushes o'.o: In Winter 387YE the Strong Reeds rose in Bregasland and, joined by the Drakes, Bounders and Bloodcloaks with knights of Eleonaris, pushed four-fifths of the way to retaking Gravenmarch. Meanwhile eight Jotun armies swept into Mitwold, conquering Oddmire, Meade March and the city of Meade.

Rose of Astolat.o: In Autumn 379YE a potent Winter curse struck the Castle of Thorns in Astolat, crumbling its stone, killing its famous roses and afflicting the civil servants who work there, sharply raising the cost of its upkeep. During the Autumn Equinox an Urizen coven's repair ritual and Dawnish efforts to restore national pride saw the castle restored and the malaise lifted.

Roses in the snow.o: Imperial explorers pressed north of Warriors' Gate in Tsirku but fell short of fully mapping the nameless, icy region there. Wintermark forces captured Wemba the Bloody and dragged him towards Anvil in chains, while the Whisper Gallery destroyed the Silent Bell sodality.

Round here.o: At the Spring Equinox 385YE a host of visitors converged on Anvil, including Tamazi ritualists, heralds of Janon, Axou drug merchants, Sarcophan cursed-relic traders, Yerende orcs and the Friends of Eduardo Boschetto. The season also saw a round of Bourse auctions and national appointments by Tally of the Votes.

Rubies in the snow.o: In Winter 387YE six Imperial armies invaded Skallahn from Sermersuaq, conquering Greenwall and most of Bjarkey and breaking the gates of Kierheim. Queen Yrsa Jansdóttir and her jarls drove them back and held the city, though its walls were badly damaged.

Ruin.o: In Summer 385YE astronomancers reported two conjunctions: the Lock and the Key, entangled with the Web and the Spider, coming to a head, and a greater conjunction of the Wanderer, Claw and Three Sisters bringing violence, sorrow and family strife. Mysterious blue-sashed warriors were also reported moving to attack three magical sites in Kallavesa, Astolat and Miaren.

Rumblings in the Gullet.o: In Winter 386YE a small earthquake shook the shores of the Gullet, after which coral-studded husks began emerging from the sea, attacking lone travellers and dragging victims into the depths. Three opportunities arose for heroes to confront the threat in Bregasland, Kallavesa and Sermersuaq.

Saint of Bees.o: After Cold Sun's invasion, bees began vanishing from Karov and then across southern Varushka, threatening the nation's prosperity. Highborn answering a call to aid Varushka joined the beekeepers of Zoloto, devotees of the exemplar Kvetmir Kvetmirovic, to find remedies, and the Highborn Assembly upheld a mandate to spread his inspiration.

Salt lions.o: In Autumn 388YE the Empire rotated fresh armies into Mareave and pressed the Grendel there, but the dug-in Salt Lords held their ground and no land changed hands. Highborn scouts also uncovered a Grendel scheme to build makeshift quays beneath the cliffs of Icarion and open it to attack from the sea.

Say her name.o: In Spring 386YE Wintermark's addition of Yulia Kasimirova Voronov and Eska Crowspeaker to the Chronicle of Heroes drew outside interest, prompting the Thule to court Wintermark and inspiring a possible relief effort to the former slaves of Rachensgrab. Inspired Loyalty also brought Sermersuaq a three-season bounty.

Scarlet sands.o: In Winter 387YE three Imperial armies, the Winter Sun, the Towerjacks and the Seventh Wave, entered Mareave and drove the Grendel invaders out of Clisearn, relieving the Fundindelve mithril mine and the besieged Golden Pyramid Grand Lodge, and pushed on into Fleisardh. A battle opportunity at Capstone Veld followed.

Schools and sawmills.o: With one season left in Fransesca di Matos' contest to see which League city invests most in itself, Sarvos narrowly led Holberg and Temeschwar. A renewed push for education opened opportunities for sword academies, a Diora University College of the Arts, a military academy in Tassato and a highway to a planned Sand Fisher port, while a changed mercenary company threatened a Temeschwar mining settlement.

Scuppernong.o: The Navarr egregores spread word of the vines, a proposed new Navarr archetype of healers, after the Navarr Assembly's Autumn Equinox 384YE statement of principle. They returned with three key questions for the vines to answer at Anvil. A conjunction also called Navarr volunteers into Brocéliande to aid trapped Marchers.

Sea-wood fed with copper.o: In Spring 386YE the Golden Axe, Winter Sun, Seventh Wave, Towerjacks and Citadel Guard took Clisearn and the Fundindelve mithril mine, making Mareave an Imperial territory, and pushed two-fifths of the way into Fleisardh. Salt Lord Ehsan then sued for recognition of Beoraidh and Sinfoyard as neutral foreigners.

Seals and stars.o: In Autumn 381YE the stars remained absent over most of the Empire and Spring regio stayed beyond Imperial reach, while Imperial covens raised magical citadels and the hylje seal-folk left Atkonaroq to bless Sermersuaq. Richard of Holberg offered to design three mana structures for the Conclave, which chose Morrow, Mournwold and Tassato.

Search high and low.o: Following the Marcher Assembly's call to empower the Breadbasket, the Marches were offered the chance to complete the Breadbasket with a great work in the Mournwold, along with offers of materials from three wealthy Marchers and a proposed sinecure, the Keeper's Cottage.

Second star.o: In Winter 386YE the great race of Rhianos, Regent of the Eternal Sea, reached its half-way point: captains who turned widdershins by riches returned to Anvil with treasure and a single brilliant gem, while those sailing deosil to mystery or straight on for glory were urged to stay their course.

Secret meeting.o: In Winter 386YE six eternals answered the Imperial archmages' plenipotentiary messages: Meraud, Sorin and the Whisper Gallery agreed to meetings, while Yaw'nagrah, Estavus and Zakalwe sent offers, opportunities or gifts instead. The Prefects of the Conclave also proposed a voluntary way for archmages to publish their plenipotentiaries.

Secure Wunderkind Woods.o: In Autumn 384YE the Senate passed a motion to secure Wunderkind Woods in Holberg, recognising the Rebeshi Players as Guardians of the Wood and creating the Imperial title of Tender of the Blood Orchard.

Seeds of discord.o: A diplomatic roundup of the Empire's lesser neighbours in Summer 388YE. Axos completed its claim on Thornfen, Faraden executed an Asavean financier of the Cinders, the Iron Confederacy proposed treaty talks while keeping its Brass Coast island conquests, Tsark sent an adept to Occursion, and the Marracossans sought help over the Theist Heresy proscription.

Seize the fire.o: After the Winter Solstice Synod adopted the Doctrine of the Howling Abyss and the Doctrine of the Ancestors, recognising the orcish soul within the Way, the Imperial Orcs were deeply affected. The changes opened opportunities for a seminary and foreign missionaries, and prompted the Sumaah to send an inquisitor.

Seize the moments.o: After the Imperial Orc Assembly declared its ambition to claim the Barrens, this Wind of Fortune offered several assemblies mandates to shape a campaign against the Druj there. Dawn's challenge, that the nation taking the most Barrens regions holds the rightful claim, was enacted, while a Vigilance mandate was upheld but never funded.

Send for me.o: Answering a Senate appraisal on seed banks and companion planting, the Freeborn prognosticator Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra proposed adapting the Marcher Breadbasket to aid devastated territories. She also set out the ruined state of Feroz and a series of opportunities to begin restoring it, while wreckers moved to destroy the Celesti Lighthouse.

Sense and sensibility.o: After the Spring Equinox 385YE, a nightly magical vision of a giant golden-haired miner bearing the words "Mine" and "Free" appeared over the Ore Hills of the Mournwold. It stirred old grievances over miners' enfranchisement, unsettled the Mournwold Orcs, and inspired romantic speculation.

Series of dreams.o: In Summer 381YE a collection of magical happenings swept the Empire: the starless skies persisted over most lands, the storm over the Icy Crag ended, koboldi built a theatre in Karsk, and Llofir kept its fungal castle in Tamarbode. The Ribbon of Salt in Redoubt was transformed into a fountain of Night embers, and Night heralds harvested dead orcs in the Mournwold.

Serpent's tooth.o: In Winter 380YE a Druj delegation led by a figure styled a "Tepel" came to Anvil under a flag of truce to negotiate a peace treaty, seeking Murderdale and the Carmine Fields in exchange for recognising Dawnish control of Dawnguard and offering a mithril trade.

Set a twisted thing straight.o: In Spring 384YE seven Imperial armies, spearheaded by all three Highborn armies on their first virtuous crusade, pressed the Druj in Zenith despite stiff resistance, while the Highborn Assembly accepted Dawn's challenge to a race for the Barrens. Freed Winter spirits began raising the dead across Clypion.

Set in stone.o: After the Conclave allowed Rivers Run Red to be cast despite its interdiction, the landskeepers of the Mournwold worked with the ageing architect Richard of Holberg to offer the Marchers four menhir proposals that would shield the Mourn, or the whole Marches, from curses. They hoped to pay for them with the stockpiled mithril of the newly allocated Singing Caves.

Set my lands in order.o: After the Senate assigned Mareave to the Imperial Orcs at the Spring Equinox 386YE, the civil service set out the territory's challenges: an inaugural senatorial election, six regional and structural problems, a looming Grendel threat, and opportunities in sept mandates, trade with Beoraidh and the Fundindelve mithril mine.

Seven locks.o: Following the Summer Solstice 386YE, seven eternals sent emissaries to Anvil, apparently answering plenipotentiary messages from the Imperial archmages. Four arranged meetings for the Autumn Equinox and the other three sent messages, opportunities or gifts.

Seven lords of virtue.o: In Spring 380YE the Asavean Plenum petitioned the Senate for permission to build a temple to Balo of the Foam and the Black Bull on the Bay of Catazar. In return it offered to let the Empire build a temple of the Way in Nemoria.

Shadow in the grass.o: In Winter 387YE Sermersuaq emerged from its recent crises: the Cult of the Falconer was broken, Big Icebarn was driven back into Sydanjaa, and two of Agramant's heralds were exposed in the Suaq Wastes. The civil service also confirmed that the Empire could build a spy network in, or appraise, the unknown territory of Tsirku.

Shadow in the west.o: In Summer 379YE Jotun raiders struck farmsteads and halls along the Empire's western border, from the Marches to Tassato and western Wintermark. The interrogation of a captured Jotun scout revealed plans for major raids on Kallavesa, Bregasland, Upwold and Tassato, and Imperial armies were sent to blunt them.

Shadowed boughs of twilight.o: In Autumn 388YE an enchantment of Wondrous Forest magic spread across Ossium after the Summer Solstice, bringing strange dreams, treacherous woodlands, the attention of Night eternals, and stirring Varushkan sovereigns such as the Dubik and the Stranger.

Shake it off.o: In Winter 384YE several eternals sought to involve themselves in Imperial affairs. Chief among them was Sadogua, who asked for crystal mana and magical help to bring persecuted Suranni magicians from the Iron Confederacy to sanctuary in the Empire.

Shallow days.o: In Spring 385YE, with the two-year peace treaty due to end, Grendel diplomats were expected at Anvil to discuss extending it. Grendel navies lingered off Necropolis and Madruga, and the Grendel half-fortified Oran in Feroz. Questioners and a mysterious Spiral dignitary also sought meetings with Imperial citizens.

Shallows and miseries.o: Six Imperial armies drove the Jotun out of Kahraman and stormed Fort Braydon, while Jotun warbands raided Tassato, the Mournwold, Madruga and western Kahraman, wrecking the Sapphire Stair and part of the Spider's Dream.

Shelter from the storm.o: Grendel pirates and slavers discovered the Isle of Zemress, a Freeborn-descended community in the Bay of Catazar, and massed to plunder it and enslave its people. The islanders sent a desperate plea for help, opening a single-season opportunity for Imperial fleets to evacuate them.

Shimmerglisten.o: An Imperial force of roughly ten thousand, mostly Navarr, surrounded the Feni settlement of Hotters Mire in Liathaven. After a letter from three Imperial citizens warned the Feni, their leader Urhalin let the Empire ambush and all but destroy the Heirs of Terunael when they arrived to break the Wither the Seed curse.

Shining like fire.o: Urizen covens laid the Imperial enchantment Bright Eyes Gleam in the Depths over the Empire at the Summer Solstice 385YE, enriching mines and revealing lost things and hidden flaws. It also brought damaging side effects, most notably drawing the attention of Cold Sun.

Ship to wreck.o: In Autumn 385YE the Grendel peace treaty was due to expire after the Equinox, with Grendel raiders poised to strike at Imperial shipping across the south. The wind also reported on the strained Liberty Pact, food purchases by the Thule, Faraden concessions to the Jotun, turmoil in Asavea, and an arranged visit by a delegation from Skoura.

Shovels and spades.o: In Summer 387YE the Tusks drove the Jotun out of the Chalkdowns, leaving only Greensward in Jotun hands in the Mournwold. In Bregasland the Jotun took Ottermire and completed their conquest, while the Strong Reeds stayed hidden and organised resistance.

Signal fire.o: Emperor Vesna used the Throne's power to address the Empire to let Rane Shard-Bearer, Senator for Kallavesa, deliver a message urging citizens to weigh the true costs of sending missionaries to preach the Way in Asavea. At the Autumn Equinox the Synod upheld its veto, striking down the law criminalising such preaching.

Signs and sigils.o: Senate-commissioned appraiser Graciana i Lòpez i Guerra found the Sign of Tamar in Reikos threatened by the forest Llofir left behind, with its Spring regio gone, but discovered strong Winter potential and proposed three grim commissions. At the Winter Solstice the Highborn Assembly enacted a mandate urging Highborn chapters to preserve the Sign.

Silver clouds with grey linings.o: In Autumn 382YE the Sumaah Republic ended its war with the Empire but rejected Bastion and the Synod, sending missionaries to preach against them. The same report updated relations with Asavea, Jarm, Faraden, Axos, the Iron Confederacy, the Commonwealth and the Sarcophan Delves, and announced that Cargo had been fortified and the Mountains of the Moon scouted.

Sinews of the heart.o: In Spring 381YE the Faraden priesthood, led by Lady Khotol of the Tsagaan family, denounced the Empire over the deaths of three Freeborn sisters adopted into her house and announced an investigator would come to the Empire. The wind also reported warming ties with Jarm, continued high Axou demand for liao, Asavean goodwill over a temple in Feroz, and cool Sumaah and Commonwealth relations.

Sing a sad song.o: In Summer 379YE a stream of bird-heralds of the Night eternal Lashonar emerged from a regio in Axmure and followed the Dawnish Golden Sun army, singing a mournful commissioned song that sapped soldiers' fighting spirit while driving them towards priests and alehouses.

Sing a song.o: Following the true consecration of the Great Library of Hacynian to Wisdom, priests gained the option to encourage pilgrimages there, the Singer of the Silence gained unique abilities, and the eternals Phaleron and Sung offered bargains requiring the Conclave to align the library's regio to them.

Sing your name.o: The Heirs of Lepidus established that the Silent Sentinel in Casinea was most likely the abode of the paragon the Sentinel, despite attacks on their scholars by a mysterious red shadow. The General Assembly mandated its true consecration and the Senate voted to build the tower of the Sentinel there.

Sitskrieg.o: In Autumn 379YE the Jotun raids across the Western Empire suddenly stopped, and scouting reports dried up from Wintermark to the Brass Coast. Military historians recognised the silence as a warning: the clan warriors had been recalled by their Kings, and the Jotun were about to invade the Empire.

Six sheets to the wind.o: For the Summer 388YE summit, the heralds of the Iron Duke offered two new challenges to citizens who had received the Challenge the Iron Duke ritual: a grand melee called Domination in the Anvil Arena and a simulated boat race in a Summer chamber.

Skeleton key.o: In Spring 386YE a round-up of magical incidents and eternal offers reached the Empire, from lingering memory-altering effects and oddly aura-touched magic items to bargains offered by Roshanwe, Tharim, Janon and others. Boggarts fleeing a war in Arhallogen also spilled into Weirwater, Upwold and Hercynia.

Skull beneath the skin.o: In Autumn 388YE the Sarangrave remained in turmoil after the Druj collapse: Winter spirits wearing the corpses of the fallen and tormented souls stalked the north, Druj remnants regrouped in hiding, and thousands of freed slaves and exiles faced a deadly winter. The Axou army the Shield of Ipotavo held back the husks in the Turan Flats before falling back towards the Tower of the Skink.

Small but nearby.o: A Wind of Fortune set out the state of the Empire's relations with its smaller neighbours (Axos, Faraden, the Iron Confederacy and Otkodov) at the start of the Autumn Equinox 383YE. It covered the rebuilding of Kaban, the plight of Axou orcs, a Faraden bounty on three Imperial citizens, and a Suranni delegation coming to discuss the Way.

Small things and large.o: In Summer 380YE, after a failed harvest and a blighted Spring planting under Naeve's Twisting Blight, the market towns led by Meade proposed a great network of granaries and seed stores across the Marches, and the Imperial Senate voted to commission it.

Smash it up.o: In Spring 383YE the Wardens of the Souls Road, a warden brotherhood from Kosti in Karsk, illegally destroyed the statue of the eternal Janon in Hanuri, Temeschwar. They then wrote to the Assembly of Nine offering to destroy further idolatrous constructions if the Cardinal of Courage raises judgements naming them.

Smile like you mean it.o: After Lady Eleanor Novarion was recognised as an exemplar of Pride, the Free Folk of Dawn gathered in Astolat to honour the 'Lady of Compassion'. They divided over three ways to celebrate her example and asked the Synod for guidance.

Smoke and oakum.o: In Winter 383YE the Marches responded coolly to Synod calls for yeomen to leave their farms and fight the Jotun, but Sister Elspeth's call to strike back opened the way for a Marcher raid into Jotun lands, and Henry Fletcher's mandate set that raid against Skallahn. A separate proposal offered to revive the title of Convener of the Assembly, housed in a new monastery in Ashbrook.

Snap rope and pass foil.o: With a scouting network commissioned by the Imperial Spymaster now in place on the border, the mystics of Ishal reported to the Witan on the many obstacles to exploring the frozen wastes of Tsirku. They set out a range of opportunities to help Wintermark explore and eventually claim it.

Snow and rain.o: In the Winter before Spring 380YE the Empire suffered one of its worst winters in thirty years, with blizzards across the north and snowmelt swelling the Vassa and Scorrero rivers in the south. Skarsind was found to be under a Winter curse, Naeve's Twisting Blight.

Snow might fall.o: Four of the five tasks towards building a runeforge at Runegrott beneath Northspires in Hahnmark were complete, and the runesmiths enslaved by the Thule had returned home. Wintermark's National Assembly was offered a mandate to consecrate Isenbrad's tomb with true liao, which would establish the Runesmith's Law.

So far so fast.o: The Lasambrian orcs, with Jotun agreement in principle, offered the Empire a final Treaty of Lasambria recognising them as an independent nation in exchange for helping retake the Brass Coast and receiving Segura, Gambit and Morajasse. The Senate voted against ratifying it, after which the Empire invaded Reinos and the Lasambrians joined the Jotun in conquering Bregasland.

So little I wanted, so little I got.o: The Fellowship of Purple Sails announced it would no longer pay for civil service observers on Imperial fleets, apparently in protest at the Senate's lukewarm attitude to the Court of Far Horizons. The wind also surveyed Imperial diplomacy with Asavea, the Sumaah, the Marracossan exiles, the Grendel and the Protectorate of Morajasse.

So our path is laid.o: In Autumn 387YE the Jotun tightened their grip on conquered Bregasland, with Queen Yrsa's Lion of the North using veteran hunters and Raðljóst to expose and unravel the hidden Strong Reeds, leaving the Marcher army increasingly vulnerable. A battle opportunity at Leakey Moss in the Grey Fens offered the Empire a chance to blunt the Jotun campaign.

Some heavenly music.o: Several Urizen spires and groups offered their private grimoires for inclusion in the new Urizen Lore, most of them on conditions. At the Winter Solstice 383YE four of the five books presented were added: A Year of Perfect Stillness, The Well of Nine Stars, A Single Strike and The Guardian Gate.

Some kind of fight.o: In Spring 384YE, as the hunt for Yaw'nagrah's cultists continued, Navarr scouts entered Liathaven seeking the Heirs of Terunael.
